jobs.title: Associate Revenue Operations Manager, India
Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben. 

Als Netzwerkingenieur (m/w/d) bei FlixTrain verantwortest du die Technologie, die bestimmt, wie unsere Fahrgäste an Bord verbunden sind, navigieren und jede Reise erleben - von WLAN und Netzwerk-Infrastruktur über On-Board-Units bis hin zu mobilen Endgeräten für unser Zugpersonal. In einer Bahnwelt, in der Konnektivität zum entscheidenden Differenzierungsmerkmal wird und Technologien wie Starlink neu definieren, was möglich ist, prägst du unmittelbar, wie FlixTrain vorne bleibt und weiterhin hochwertige, unvergessliche Reisen bietet. 

Als Teil des Product-Development-Teams im Bereich Rolling-Stock & Maintenance sorgst du dafür, dass unsere On-Board-Hardware ein herausragendes Reiseerlebnis für unsere Fahrgäste, einen reibungslosen Betrieb und eine gute Arbeitsumgebung für unser Zugpersonal ermöglicht. Deine Arbeit beeinflusst direkt, wie FlixTrain im Wettbewerb um Konnektivität an Bord die Nase vorn behält und verlässliche, hochwertige Reiseerlebnisse liefert. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Operations, Customer Product und FlixTech sowie mit externen Partnern wie Talgo, ECMs und Lieferanten (z. B. Icomera, Advantech) zusammen.

Über die Rolle

  • Du verantwortest das gesamte On-Board-Technologie-Ökosystem von FlixTrain - WLAN, Netzwerke, On-Board-Units und mobile Endgeräte - und gibst dich nie mit dem Status quo zufrieden 
  • Als zentrale technische Ansprechperson für alle On-Board-Systeme bewertest du Spezifikationen, wägst Trade-offs ab und triffst fundierte, gut begründete Entscheidungen 
  • Kontinuierlich überwachst du die Performance unserer On-Board-Technologie, erkennst Probleme frühzeitig und treibst Verbesserungen voran, die jede Reise reibungsloser machen 
  • Cross-funktionale Projekte rund um Konnektivität, Netzwerk-Performance und die Integration mobiler Endgeräte in die Fahrzeugflotte leitest du eigenverantwortlich und mit klarem Fokus auf Wirkung 
  • Technische Spezifikationen und Netzwerkarchitekturen definierst du so, dass sie ambitioniert und zugleich umsetzbar sind und nahtlose Schnittstellen zu unserer Fahrzeugflotte gewährleisten 
  • Testszenarien und funktionale Validierungen entwickelst du - besonders an der kritischen Schnittstelle zu Kund*innen und Zertifizierungsstellen – und stellst so sicher, dass unsere Lösungen im echten Betrieb funktionieren 
  • Neue Technologien wie 5G, IoT und Starlink behältst du im Blick und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Empfehlungen für die Technologie-Roadmap von FlixTrain 

Über Dich

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Telekommunikation, Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich 
  • Mit mehr als zwei Jahren praktischer Erfahrung in Netzwerkarchitektur, WLAN-Systemen oder Mobile Device Management überzeugst du - idealerweise im Umfeld von Schienenfahrzeugen oder einer vergleichbar komplexen technischen Umgebung 
  • Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz zeichnet dich aus, ebenso wie nachweisliche Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerksysteme unter Zeitdruck 
  • Verantwortung übernimmst du gern: Du bringst Themen eigenständig zum Abschluss und leitest cross-funktionale Initiativen mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Teams und Disziplinen souverän 
  • Klar und überzeugend kommunizierst du mit technischen Expert*innen wie auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern, ohne dabei an Präzision zu verlieren 
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse bringst du mit, da du in einem internationalen Team arbeitest und mit deutschsprachigen Lieferanten und Behörden zusammenarbeitest 
  • Von Vorteil ist Erfahrung mit Lieferanten von Schienenfahrzeugsystemen sowie Vertrautheit mit dem vertraglichen, technischen und regulatorischen Umfeld der Bahnbranche 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.
  • Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

jobs.title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities.  This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company.

As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience.

About the Role

You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash's data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.

As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company's exponential growth.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company
  • Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting
  • Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes.
  • Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources.
  • Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality.
  • Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines.
  • Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners.
  • Participate in defining the Company's data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems.
  • Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team.

Our humble expectations

  • You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role.
  • Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows.
  • Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools.
  • You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake.
  • Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines.
  • Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.
  • You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • You're an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates.
  • Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.title: Manager SAP EWM – Logistics / Supply Chain (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
What you can expect from us

As the business-side EWM project lead, you take overall responsibility in our client projects for the planning, management and successful implementation of our SAP EWM initiatives from a Logistics perspective.

You ensure that our clients’ operational requirements define the framework for the solution. To achieve this, you define functional objectives together with the client, set priorities and steer internal IT, external SAP consultants and other service providers so that robust, practical and sustainable solutions are delivered.

You act as the central interface between Logistics, IT and implementation partners and represent our clients’ business interests clearly and consistently.

Your Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for the overall functional management of SAP EWM projects for our clients, including implementation, roll-out, optimization and, where applicable, migration from SAP WM to SAP EWM, from a Logistics / Supply Chain perspective.
  • Together with our clients, you define the functional objectives, requirements and success criteria for warehouse and intralogistics processes and ensure that these are implemented consistently by IT and implementation partners.
  • You coordinate and lead functional key users, process owners and, where applicable, internal EWM experts on the client side and support the development of a strong and reliable business team around EWM.
  • You manage external SAP implementation partners, developers and technical service providers from a functional perspective: you define requirements, priorities and acceptance criteria and monitor the quality of delivery.
  • You are responsible for functional test management, including test design, test cases, UAT and sign-off, as well as business-side cutover planning and the preparation and support of go-live and the hypercare phase.
  • You establish clear project governance from a business perspective, including decision-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting to Logistics management and the steering committee, as well as issue and change management.
  • You drive change communication, training and employee enablement on the client side and ensure that a capable and sustainable business organization is in place after project completion.


Who you are

You combine strong logistics and process expertise with a good understanding of SAP EWM and the ability to translate business requirements into robust, practical solutions. You are comfortable navigating complex project and decision-making environments, manage different stakeholders with clarity and commitment, and challenge existing approaches with confidence. At the same time, you are comfortable working in a consulting environment and take ownership in demanding client projects.

In addition, you bring the following:

  • At least 5 years of experience in management consulting or in relevant industry roles with a focus on Logistics, Intralogistics or Supply Chain, ideally with responsibility for warehouse, distribution or production logistics.
  • A university degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering or a comparable qualification.
  • A strong understanding of warehouse and intralogistics processes, including goods receipt, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, inventory and returns, as well as their interfaces with Production, Sales and Quality Management.
  • Experience in leading or playing a key role in the management of digitalization or SAP projects, ideally with a focus on SAP EWM and/or SAP S/4HANA.
  • A good practical understanding of SAP EWM and related logistics modules such as MM, SD, PP, QM and, where applicable, TM, without the need for deep technical customizing expertise.
  • Proven expertise in requirements management, process design, test management, change management and stakeholder management.
  • Experience in managing external SAP implementation partners and interdisciplinary teams, as well as the ability to provide clear functional leadership to IT teams and consultants.
  • A structured, solution-oriented and dependable way of working, combined with assertiveness, diplomatic skills and a hands-on mindset.
  • Very good German and good English skills, both written and spoken.


Who we are

We are a global digital transformation consulting firm with offices in Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Munich, Vienna, Atlanta, Singapore, and Shanghai. Since 2006, we have primarily advised DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies on digital transformation issues at the intersection of business and IT. Our strength lies in a comprehensive management-level consulting approach that ranges from IT strategy to the optimization and implementation of digitalization and transformation processes. For this, we have repeatedly been recognized by our clients and the business magazine BrandEins as “Best Consultants” and by Wirtschaftswoche as the winner of the “Best of Consulting” competition.

  • A "Duz-Kultur", short communication channels, and many fantastic, experienced, and international colleagues

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines

  • Flexibilität: Wähle das Arbeitsmodell, das zu dir passt und arbeite entweder in unserem Berliner Office oder an einem Ort deiner Wahl in Deutschland. Bis zu sechs Wochen im Jahr kannst du auch remote im Ausland arbeiten.
  • Kostenloses Mittagessen: Dreimal wöchentlich bekommst du bei uns im Office eine kostenlose Mahlzeit serviert - auch vegetarische und vegane Gerichte.
  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Dein persönliches Wachstum ist uns wichtig! Wir gestalten gemeinsam deinen individuellen Entwicklungsplan und besprechen ihn in regelmäßigen Feedbackmeetings. 
  • Peak Ace Academy: Nutze unsere internen und externen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um deine Entwicklungsziele zu erreichen und deinen eigenen Karriereweg zu formen.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Finde deinen idealen Rhythmus mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitoptionen und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr (Heiligabend und Neujahr sind zusätzliche freie Tage).
  • Vielfältige Kund:innen: Arbeite mit internationalen Kund:innen aus verschiedenen Branchen an innovativen Kampagnen und bringe deine Ideen ein, um gemeinsam zu wachsen und Digital Marketing neu zu denken. 
  • Vergünstigungen: Spare bei zahlreichen Shops und anderen Anbietern über unser Corporate-Benefits Portal.
  • Gemeinsam stark: Werde Teil eines Teams aus einzigartigen und leidenschaftlichen Digital-Marketing-Expert:innen. Zusammen arbeitet ihr an herausfordernden Projekten, könnt euch austauschen und voneinander lernen.
  • An die Zukunft denken: Peak Ace bezuschusst deinen Sparbeitrag zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit zusätzlichen 20 %.
  • Office-Leben: In unserem Berliner Office findest du alles, was du zum Arbeiten brauchst – erstklassige technische Ausstattung, Obst, Getränke und viel Platz für die Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Kolleg:innen.

  • Starke Hands-on-Expertise mit AWS
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Engineering und ETL-Architekturen
  • Erfahrung mit Generative / Agentic AI Projekten
  • Sehr gute Python-Skills

  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung
  • Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit AWS Connect
  • Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar)
  • Erfahrung mit LLM Customization / Fine-Tuning und Distillation
  • Praktische MLOps-Erfahrung (Model Deployment, Monitoring, Lifecycle)

First-class benefits for your career!

jobs.title: Product Manager, Music Content and Catalogue
jobs.description:
Your mission

You own what learners actually play. Our catalogue is the heart of the Skoove experience, and it is also our largest content cost and our most constrained resource. Every song in the app exists because someone negotiated the right to put it there, modelled what it would cost, and judged what it would do for the learner.


That is your job. You own the songs in our piano learning apps end to end: which music we license, what it costs, what each licence permits, and what it does for our learners. Our didactics lead owns the teaching content, and the two of you decide together which songs carry the didactics.


You work alongside a didactics lead and a content producer, and you are the voice of content in our product owner round. You bring the commercial and rights lens. They bring pedagogy and production.


This is not an internally facing product role. You will sit across the table from music publishers and labels, model the deals, and understand what each licence allows in the app. Our CEO leads negotiations with you at the start and an external licensing advisor supports the specialist work. You grow into owning it.


And you care about the music itself. Getting the songs people actually want to play into a learning app, at a cost that works, is one of the most satisfying puzzles in this company.


You have a real passion for AI tools: prototyping, analysis, modelling, experimentation. You bring new thinking on AI-first product work and model that mindset for others.


Your job

  • Own the song catalogue for the Skoove apps: what we add, what we retire, and why. You have a point of view on which music learners want to play, and the evidence to back it. 

  • Co-own the song selection inside the didactics together with our didactics lead. Their pedagogy, your rights and catalogue view.

  • Own the commercial modelling of content: licence cost per subscriber and per song, revenue share, catalogue coverage against learner value, and the conversion effect of licensed content. 

  • Own the rights picture: which repertoire we hold, under what terms and territories, and what each licence permits in the product. Keep the clearance gate current so no song ships uncleared.

  • Represent us with publishers and labels. Prepare the position, evaluate term sheets, identify the assumptions worth challenging, and document the relationship. Supported by the CEO and an external advisor, with the aim of taking full ownership.

  • Be accountable for contractual reporting to partners: usage reports in the agreed format by the contract deadline, payments, audits and disputes. Colleagues in Commercial and Finance build and contribute to those reports. You own that they land on time.

  • Monitor usage against plan: usage share per publisher, dilution against targets, and act when the numbers move. Translate licensing constraints and opportunities into product decisions, and carry product's catalogue requests back into licensing.

  • Own the content unit's backlog and work closely with the team's engineer to turn priorities into progress. Prototype with AI coding tools where you can rather than waiting for a sprint, and contribute to the product owner round, sharing context and supporting the other product owners when useful.


Where is the role heading:

You start with the catalogue and the licensing relationships we have. Over the first year you take full ownership of negotiations as the CEO steps back, and you shape how our content strategy scales across further products and partner apps. The right person wants to own a domain, not administer one.


Your profile

Must have:


  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, with at least 2 years in a role with clear ownership and responsibility. Product management experience is preferred, but we also welcome backgrounds in music licensing, rights, catalogue, partnerships or commercial roles.

  • A working understanding of the music licensing world. You know what a publisher, a PRO and a mechanical licence are, you have seen how rights affect a product, and you are curious about the rest. We will teach you the depth.

  • You play piano, or you have learned it far enough to remember exactly what was hard. You understand the learner's journey from the inside: what motivates beginners, what makes them quit, what keeps them coming back.

  • Strong partner and stakeholder management skills. You are comfortable working directly with external partners and taking part in negotiations. You are also highly reliable when it comes to contractual obligations and recurring deadlines — when something needs to land on time, you make sure it does.

  • Strong analytical and commercial skills. You are comfortable with cohort data, experimentation and commercial modelling. You can build the case for an investment in a spreadsheet, understand what the data is telling you and defend the assumptions behind it.

  • Product management skills. You are comfortable with prioritisation, balancing user and business needs, and turning them into clear decisions and outcomes. You are outcome-oriented and entrepreneurial: you take ownership of results, not tasks.

  • AI fluency and curiosity. You are confident in using AI/LLM tools to support data analysis, modelling, reporting, presentations and day-to-day product work, with a strong willingness to experiment and rapidly develop new AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.


Strong plus:


  • Hands-on experience in music rights, publishing, licensing, royalties or catalogue work.

  • Content or catalogue product experience at a streaming, media, audiobook or games company.

  • Strong product discovery skills. You go from user problem to hypothesis to test to decision, using qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • Experience negotiating with suppliers or rights holders.

  • Financial modelling depth.

  • German language skills in addition to English.

  • Music tech, e-learning, gaming or consumer entertainment background.


What's in it for you?

Profitable, growing music-tech company at a pivotal moment. Lean hierarchies, fast decisions. International team in Berlin-Friedrichshain. EUR 2,500 learning budget. Up to 60% remote. Yearly offsites. 28 vacation days.


Eligibilty

  • Cover letter and resume

  • European work permit

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate

  • 30 to 40 hours per week, your preference

  • Bonus: Examples of product work. Products you built, decisions you made, results you drove


Job Start

mid-November 2026

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Incident Response
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast.

This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Incident Response

 - Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

 - Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken.

 - Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

 - Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation.


Investigation & Forensics

 - Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts.

 - Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents.

 - Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected.


IR Automation & Tooling

 - Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage.

 - Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible.

 - Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain.



Detection & Continuous Improvement

 - Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion.

 - Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment.

 - Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure.

 - Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking).

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads.

 - Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse).

 - Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes.

 - Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms.

 - Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers.

 - Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research.

 - Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

 - Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience.
   


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curiosity & initiative: Strong desire to understand attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and how they apply to real-world systems.
   

 - Speed & analytical rigor: Ability to quickly assess high-risk vulnerabilities with clear, evidence-based reasoning.
   

 - Collaboration: Comfort working across cross-functional teams spanning Security, SRE, Engineering, and Infrastructure.
   

 - Clear communication: Ability to explain findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels.
   

 - Ownership mindset: Takes initiative to drive investigations, improvements, and remediations to completion.
   

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying up to date on new vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and cloud-native security best practices.
   





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

jobs.description:
Your Role

Du arbeitest an der Konsolidierung unserer Konzerngesellschaften, optimierst universelle Finanzprozesse und agierst als Ansprechpartner für externe Wirtschaftsprüfer und Berater. In dieser Schlüsselrolle prägst Du maßgeblich die finanzielle Skalierung und Zukunftsfähigkeit der FINN-Gruppe.


Your Mission

  • Konzernabschlüsse: Du erstellst die monatlichen, quartalsweisen und jährlichen Konzernabschlüsse nach IFRS inklusive Anhang (Notes).

  • IFRS-Framework & Policies: Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unseres IFRS Financial Reportings sowie die konzernweite Durchsetzung einheitlicher Accounting Policies (insbesondere IFRS 16: Leasing und IFRS 9: Finanzinstrumente).

  • Konsolidierung: Du übernimmst die Konsolidierung aller Konzerngesellschaften (in LucaNet) und treibst die Automatisierung und Verbesserung unserer Prozesse voran.

  • Audit & Externe Stakeholder: Du arbeitest mit internationalen Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften, Aufsichtsbehörden und externen Beratern und vertrittst die FINN-Gruppe souverän in IFRS-Prüfungs- und Bilanzierungsfragen.

  • Fachliche Beratung & Governance: Du berätst interdisziplinäre Teams in allen komplexen Bilanzierungs- und Reportingfragen nach IFRS. Außerdem wirkst Du an verschiedenen Projekten mit.


    • Your Profile

    Must-have:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften (oder vergleichbar) mit Schwerpunkt Finance, Accounting oder Auditing.

  • Fundierte Berufserfahrung in einer namhaften Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft (Big4 ist ein Plus) oder im Group Accounting / Konzernrechnungswesen eines internationalen Konzern / Scale-ups.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1/C2-Niveau) sowie starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit gegenüber externen und internen Stakeholdern.

  • Umfassende Anwendererfahrung mit LucaNet. Erfahrung mit SAP S4 Hana ist ein Plus.

    • WHY FINN

Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor. Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!

jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta inom industrin och få möjlighet att utvecklas i en praktisk arbetsmiljö? Lernia söker nu industriarbetare för ett kortare uppdrag med enklare arbetsuppgifter hos våra kunder i Kalmarregionen. Här får du chansen att samla erfarenhet, prova olika arbetsuppgifter och vara en viktig del av produktionen.

Om tjänsten

Som industriarbetare arbetar du med varierande uppgifter inom produktion och industri. Arbetsuppgifterna kan anpassas efter verksamhetens behov och din tidigare erfarenhet.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter kan vara:

    

Enklare montering och paketering

    

Sortering, avsyning och kvalitetskontroller

    

Av- och pålastning av produkter

    

Lagerhantering och andra praktiska arbetsuppgifter

    

Att följa arbetsinstruktioner och säkerhetsföreskrifter

Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, noggrannhet och ansvar är viktigt. Beroende på uppdrag kan arbetet vara förlagt på dagtid, skift eller annan arbetstid.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är arbetsvillig, engagerad och trivs med praktiska arbetsuppgifter. Du behöver inte ha lång erfarenhet från industrin – det viktigaste är att du har rätt inställning och vilja att lära dig.

Du är noggrann, ansvarsfull och van vid att arbeta efter tydliga instruktioner. Du bidrar till en god stämning på arbetsplatsen och samarbetar bra med andra, samtidigt som du kan ta ansvar för dina egna arbetsuppgifter.

Formell kompetens

    

Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

    

Förmåga att följa instruktioner och säkerhetsrutiner

    

Fysisk förmåga att utföra praktiska arbetsuppgifter

    

Körkort B och tillgång till bil

    

Tillgänglig för omgående start

Meriterande

    

Tidigare erfarenhet från industri, produktion eller lager

    

Truckkort

    

Erfarenhet av montering, paketering eller kvalitetskontroll

    

Tekniskt intresse

Om uppdraget

    

Placeringsort: Kalmarregionen

    

Anställningsform: Visstidsanställning med möjlighet till förlängning

    

Omfattning: Heltid

    

Tillträde: Omgående

    

Treskift

Uppdraget är en del av Lernias bemanningsverksamhet, vilket innebär att du blir anställd av Lernia och arbetar ute hos någon av våra kunder i Kalmarregionen.

Som en av oss

Som anställd bemanningskonsult hos oss får du marknadsmässig lön, semester, pensionsavsättning, försäkringar och anslutning till vårt kollektivavtal. Vi vill att du ska trivas och må bra hos oss och erbjuder därför bland annat friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Under din anställning har du en konsultchef som stöttar dig i ditt uppdrag och följer din utveckling.

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på kort och lång sikt.

Hur du söker tjänsten

För att söka tjänsten, scrolla ner till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

Bakgrundskontroll

jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description:
About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

 

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation.

 
 

The role

You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you.

Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you.

 

What you'll do

 

Own French payroll

  • Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks

  • Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations)

  • Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium

  • Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis

  • Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise

  • Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships

  • Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes

 

Run the employee lifecycle

  • Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data

  • Keep Workday data accurate and compliant

  • Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects

  • You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP.

 

What you bring

  • 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it

  • Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar)

  • Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased

  • A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better

  • Comfort working in English in a multicultural team

  • Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope

 

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

 

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

 

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

jobs.title: Välkommen som specialistläkare till Mentis Psykiatri och Mentis Unga
jobs.description:
Specialistläkare i psykiatri välkomnas till Mentis Psykiatri och Mentis Unga

Om verksamheten

Mentis Psykiatri är en privat psykiatrisk verksamhet som etablerades 2023 på Carlanderska Sjukhuset i Göteborg. Vi utreder och behandlar psykiatriska tillstånd såsom depression, ångestsyndrom, bipolär sjukdom, PTSD, utmattningssyndrom samt neuropsykiatriska tillstånd som ADHD.

Vi arbetar med privatbetalande patienter och patienter med sjukvårdsförsäkring. Mentis är medlem i Vårdföretagarna och har kollektivavtal.

Under 2025 växte verksamheten genom etableringen av Mentis Unga, en särskild verksamhet för barn, ungdomar och unga vuxna från 12 år. Verksamheten är belägen i nya lokaler på Carlanderska Eklandagatan.

Idag består vårt team av tre psykiatriker, sex psykologer och två administratörer. Vi är en mindre verksamhet där nära samarbete, hög kvalitet och ett personligt bemötande genomsyrar det dagliga arbetet.

Vår ambition är att erbjuda evidensbaserad vård med hög tillgänglighet, med ett personligt och professionellt omhändertagande och skapa goda förutsättningar

Om tjänsten

Vi söker en kompetent och empatisk Specialistläkare i psykiatri som kan arbeta främst med vuxna patienter, men vid behov även äldre unga. Rollen innefattar ansvar för bedömning och uppföljning av psykiatriska tillstånd, diagnostiska bedömningar, läkemedelsbehandling samt medicinsk del i neuropsykiatriska utredningar.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Genomföra psykiatriska bedömningar och uppföljningar hos vuxna patienter.
    Utföra fördjupade diagnostiska bedömningar vid behov (inklusive ADHD, autismspektrumtillstånd och andra neuropsykiatriska frågeställningar).
    Ansvara för läkemedelsbehandling: insättning, justering och uppföljning av psykofarmakologisk behandling.
    Genomföra läkarbedömningar som en del av neuropsykiatriska utredningar, i samarbete med övriga teammedlemmar.
    Delta i utbildning och handledning av medarbetare, samt bidra till utveckling av vårdprocesser och riktlinjer.
    Dokumentation i elektronisk journal och uppföljning av behandlingsmål.
    Engagera dig i verksamhetens kvalitets- och utvecklingsarbete.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som:

    Är legitimerad läkare med specialistkompetens i psykiatri.
    Har erfarenhet av vuxenpsykiatri och gärna erfarenhet av neuropsykiatriska utredningar.
    Har goda kunskaper i psykiatrisk läkemedelsbehandling och farmakoterapi.
    Vill arbeta självständigt i en flexibel och utvecklingsfokuserad organisation.
    Har god samarbetsförmåga och uppskattar ett tvärprofessionellt arbetssätt.
    Har god kommunikationsförmåga och ett empatiskt bemötande.

Vi erbjuder

    En meningsfull roll i en växande verksamhet med tydlig vision.
    Flexibla arbetsformer och möjlighet till deltidstjänstgöring.
    Centralt belägna, moderna lokaler i vacker miljö.
    Kompetensutveckling och möjlighet till stort inflytande över det kliniska arbetet.
    Konkurrenskraftiga villkor och en stödjande arbetsmiljö.

Plats och arbetstid

    Placering: Mentis Psykiatri och Mentis Unga.
    Heltid eller deltid (vi är öppna för flexibla lösningar som passar både klinikens och kandidatens behov).
    Öppna uppdrag inom vardag/kväll, enligt överenskommelse.

Ansökan

Skicka din ansökan med CV och ett personligt brev där du beskriver din erfarenhet av vuxenpsykiatri och neuropsykiatriska utredningar, samt varför just Mentis passar dig. Urval sker löpande.

Sista ansökningsdag: 8 november 2026

Ansökan skickas till: kontakt@mentispsykiatri.se

Kontakt

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:

Marzia Dellepiane, Verksamhetschef

Vi letar efter dig som sätter kvalitet, noggrannhet och service i första rummet – varje dag, varje leverans.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

VAD FÖRVÄNTAS AV DIG

Som budbilschaufför är du företagets ansikte utåt och ser till att varje leverans når fram i tid med ett leende. Vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull, serviceinriktad och trivs med ett självständigt arbete ute på vägarna. Du har god fysik, är punktlig och noggrann, samt sprider en positiv stämning i mötet med kunder. Med flexibilitet och lösningsfokus ser du till att varje körning blir en smidig upplevelse.

KRAV

    Erfarenhet: Minst 1 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av hemleveranser, bud- eller distributionskörning. Du är van att arbeta strukturerat och självständigt.
    Körkort: Giltigt B-körkort och mycket god körvana i stadstrafik, på landsvägar och motorvägar. Du navigerar smidigt även under tidspress.
    Språk: Goda kunskaper i svenska – både i tal och skrift. Kommunikation med kunder och kollegor är en central del av jobbet.
    Fysik: Fysisk uthållighet och vana vid ett aktivt arbete. Du har inga problem att bära paket, matkassar och annat gods uppför trappor när det behövs.
    Teknik: Trygg med teknik. Du arbetar bekvämt med appar och digitala verktyg för att hantera rutter, aviseringar och leveransbekräftelser.

MERITERANDE

    God lokalkännedom om Göteborg och övriga delar av Västra Götalands län.
    Tidigare erfarenhet av just kyltransporter eller livsmedelsdistribution.

VI ERBJUDER

    En trygg anställning i ett företag med engagerade och trevliga kollegor.

    Konkurrenskraftig ersättning enligt branschpraxis

ANSTÄLLNINGSFORM & ANSÖKAN

jobs.title: CE-Chaufförer till Göteborgs Hamn (Arendal)  Containrar & Trailers
jobs.description:
Trivs du bäst ute på vägarna med frihet under ansvar? Vill du utgå från Skandinaviens största hamn och vara en nyckelspelare i Sveriges godsflöde? Då har vi platsen för dig!

Vi på SMT Logistics är ett väletablerat åkeri som just nu expanderar. För att möta vår ökade orderingång söker vi nu flera erfarna, ordningsamma och självgående CE-chaufförer.

Om uppdraget och din arbetsvecka

Din utgångspunkt är Arendals hamn (hjärtat av Göteborgs hamn). Härifrån hämtar du standardiserade sjöcontainrar och löstrailers som du levererar till företagskunder och terminaler.

Körningarna sker i huvudsak inom Västra Götaland, men rutter till andra delar av Sverige förekommer regelbundet. Körningar utomlands kan också dyka upp, och då är det i regel Oslo som gäller. När godset är lossat och lastat rullar du tillbaka mot hamnen, alternativt tar du dig an nya körningar under dagen om det är ett kortare uppdrag.

Vem är du?

För att trivas hos oss gillar du att sköta dig själv och ta eget ansvar, samtidigt som du håller en rak och tydlig kommunikation med vår trafikledning. Du ser till att din lastbil och trailer alltid hålls i toppskick och du har en professionell och serviceinriktad inställning mot våra kunder.

Krav för tjänsten:

    CE-körkort & Giltigt YKB
    Digitalt färdskrivarkort
    Goda språkkunskaper i svenska eller engelska (tal och skrift)
    Trygg yrkeserfarenhet på vägarna

Starkt meriterande (inget krav, men ett stort plus):

    Erfarenhet av sjöcontainrar, chassin och trailerbyten.
    ADR-intyg (farligt gods).
    Vana av att köra i Norge.

Vi erbjuder dig

Ett tryggt jobb i ett expansivt företag med en modern och välskött fordonspark. Du får ett varierande arbete med stor frihet under ansvar, stöttad av en lyhörd trafikledning.

Ansökan

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så tjänsterna kan tillsättas direkt. Du kan välja att skicka ditt CV och några rader om dig själv till: kontakt@smtlogistics.se eller ansöka direkt via vår annons på Indeed.

Välkommen att rulla med oss på SMT Logistics!

jobs.title: Technical Lead - AI Ops
jobs.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The Role

Brevo is transforming all of its operations to become AI native: We are redefining the way we work internally, the way we consume data (analytical and operational), the way we interact with each other.
From customer support teams to RevOps, from Analytical engineer to finance team, all our jobs will be transformed and we becoming manages of agents. The AI Ops team drives this transformation: it builds and operates AI agents, applications, and the associated tooling, in production. We bring impact at high speed.
We're looking for a Tech Lead to set the technical direction of AI Ops and lead the engineers who build it. You'll own the architecture of our agent platform and raise the bar on how we ship, while staying hands-on in the code.
This is not a research-oriented role: we're looking for a builder with experience making systems work in production.

Why join us ?

  • A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture.
  • A fast paced organisation able to redefine itself quicker than any other
  • Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production.

Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Design, build, and operate AI agents in production.
  • Integrate internal data to build relevant context accurately and in a controlled way (context engineering).
  • Discover needs directly with business teams (CX, RevOps, Data), hand agents over in forward-deployed-engineer mode, and contribute to the architectural vision of the agent platform.
  • Own the architecture of the solutions we build, and make the key technical decisions (multi-agent design, pre-processing, deterministic routing, LLM-as-judge, observability, human in the loop surface of interaction)
  • Own deployment and operations: CI/CD, sandbox/production environments, monitoring, and agent observability.
  • Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, evals, testing, and deployment. Make sure the team follows them.
  • Mentor and grow the engineers on the team

    • Who you are:
    Must-have:
  • Proven tech lead experience: you've set the technical direction for a team, made architecture calls, and mentored engineers.
  • Whole-system thinker: you challenge architecture decisions and weigh the business impact of technical choices.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you turn a fuzzy problem into a shipped solution without a pre-written spec, and help your team do the same.
  • DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies).
  • Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation.
  • You build with AI daily (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and push the team to do the same.
  • Fluent in French and English.

    • Nice to have:

  • ADK v2 (Google Agent Development Kit) and the A2A protocol.

  • Langfuse or an equivalent LLM observability tool.

  • LLM cost optimization at scale (caching, routing, model selection).


    • Our candidate journey:
  • 30 min call with Talent Acquisition
  • Vision & systems interview with the Chief Data and AI Officer
  • Technical assessment
  • Team meet-and-greet

    • Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

jobs.title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
jobs.description:
About Scality

Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
 
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. 
 
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
 
ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.

About the role
Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.
 
This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.
 
The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work.

You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region.

What you will be doing
  • Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing
  • Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting
  • Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after
  • Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up
  • Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels
  • Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce
  • Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region
  • Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration
  • Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact
  • Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost

    • What you bring to the table
  • Ten years or more of experience in lead generation, demand generation, or digital marketing, running integrated campaigns end to end
  • International experience: you have run campaigns across several regions, ideally including the US, and understand how buyers and channels differ by market
  • Experience in B2B enterprise software, ideally in storage, data management, backup, or adjacent data infrastructure markets
  • A track record of campaigns that produced measurable pipeline, with the numbers to back it up
  • Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search, and with webinar and event campaigns 
  • Strong command of HubSpot and Salesforce and of campaign analytics
  • The ability to shape a plan from a pipeline target while staying hands on in execution
  • The creativity to generate demand where buyers rely on AI over traditional channels and gated content no longer carries the funnel
  • Native or near-native English, written and spoken. You write campaign copy for US and international audiences
  • Comfort working with colleagues across time zones, with regular overlap with the US team in the afternoon

    • Life at Scality
  • We offer careers with an opportunity to bridge international borders, an intensely fun environment with smart people.
  • We encourage promotion and elevation through training and development programs.
  • We care for our employees through company supported programs such as sports and wellness programs, social responsibility programs, and generous benefits packages.
  • We support team building and get together events across all of our locations around the world.
  • Life at Scality is exhilarating. Our internal motto is: work hard, play hard, eat well and amaze the customer!

jobs.title: Performance and Data Engineer F/H - CDI - Toulouse, Montpellier, Paris
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

 

Vos missions : 

 

Rattaché.e au Responsable Asset Management and O&M, vous aurez pour objectifs d'analyser les performances des centrales éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage et d'en garantir la fiabilité des données. 

 

Vos missions principales seront :  

 

  • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’actifs (Asset Managers) pour suivre et analyser les performances des parcs éoliens, photovoltaïques et des systèmes de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Garantir l’intégrité des données collectées, les analyser et les partager afin d’assurer une gestion efficace des tableaux de bord.  
  • Travailler avec les différents départements de Q ENERGY afin d’optimiser la rentabilité de nos projets éoliens, solaires et de stockage ainsi que la performance des centrales.  
  • Mettre en place des tableaux de bord automatisés à destination des parties prenantes.  
  • Administrer les bases de données et exploiter les outils MySQL et Power BI.  
  • Assurer le support dans la gestion quotidienne des données ainsi que dans la création des politiques et autorisations d’accès.  
  • Être responsable de l’historisation SCADA et des plateformes de supervision.  
  • Assurer la supervision des systèmes SCADA et des réseaux, réaliser les diagnostics SCADA, détecter les anomalies et les corriger pendant la phase d’exploitation.  
  • Être le référent technique pour toutes les questions liées au SCADA et à la gestion des installations éoliennes, photovoltaïques et de stockage en exploitation.  
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Développement, Achats et Construction afin d’améliorer les outils de suivi et de partager les bonnes pratiques.  
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue : fiabilité des installations, animation de groupes de travail.  
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations contractuelles du prestataire SCADA en phase d’exploitation. 

 

 

HSE : 

 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

 

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

  

 

 

 

Qualité : 

 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs 

Requirements

Votre profil : 

De formation ingénieur généraliste, vous disposez de solides compétences techniques et aimez évoluer dans des environnements à la croisée de plusieurs expertises. 

Vous avez notamment de bonnes connaissances en automatisme, ainsi qu’en informatique et réseaux de communication. Des bases en électricité HT/BT vous permettent également de comprendre les principaux enjeux techniques liés aux installations. 

À l’aise dans les échanges, vous êtes reconnu.e pour vos qualités de communication, votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité à travailler de manière autonome. Vous savez également prendre des décisions rapidement lorsque la situation l’exige. 

Un bon niveau d’anglais technique est attendu afin de pouvoir évoluer dans un environnement professionnel international. 

Une première expérience dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables serait un véritable atout, mais c’est avant tout votre curiosité, votre autonomie et votre envie de relever des défis techniques qui feront la différence ! 

 

Localisation et déplacements : 

Le poste implique des déplacements réguliers sur les différents sites de l’entreprise à travers la France, représentant environ 25 % du temps de travail. 

Vous êtes donc mobile et appréciez le fait de pouvoir alterner entre travail au bureau et interventions directement sur le terrain.

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

 

 

 

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • 4 jours de congés par an offerts pour des actions de bénévolat    
  • L’abondement de vos dons aux associations à hauteur de 500€ par an    
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité  
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)

jobs.title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker/in (Vollzeit) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns mit ihrer fachlichen Expertise unterstützen. Du möchtest in einer der führenden Steuerkanzleien in Düsseldorf tätig sein und die Kanzlei bei Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und stabilen IT-Prozessen unterstützen?

Wir suchen Wirtschaftsinformatiker/-in - Vollzeit (m/w/d), die unser Team in Prozessaufnahme, Systemeinführung, Schnittstellenanbindung und im IT-Betrieb zuverlässig unterstützen. Während der Einarbeitung lernst du unsere digitale Arbeitsweise, das Dokumenten- und Fristenmanagement sowie unsere Automatisierungs- und DATEV-Systeme kennen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

  • Betreuung der eingesetzten SaaS-Anwendungen (User-/Lizenzverwaltung, Konfiguration, Berechtigungen)

  • Einrichtung, Installation und Konfiguration von Standard-Software

  • Dokumentation und Konzeption digitaler Geschäftsprozesse (SOPs, Checklisten)

  • Planung und Einführung neuer Software- und IT-Lösungen

  • Verbinden von Standardlösungen über Schnittstellen

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Automationen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben (z. B. Zapier/Mirror/ähnliche Tools)

  • Anwenderschulung und -betreuung (First/Second Level), Erstellung von Leitfäden

  • Fehleranalyse und Störungsbeseitigung über Ticketsystem

  • DATEV-Support-Themen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Dienstleistern

Zusätzliche Aufgaben (je nach Erfahrung)

  • System- und Rechteverwaltung, Basis-Administration (Benutzer, Endgeräte)

  • Mitarbeit an IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance-Standards (Richtlinien, Backups)

  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Dienstleister; Lizenz- und Asset-Management

  • Ausbau von Low-Code/No-Code-Automationen

  • Prozessoptimierung und Projektmanagement in enger Abstimmung mit Fachabteilungen

Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Klare Strukturen und Prozesse:
    Bei uns findest du eine eindeutige Aufgabenverteilung, standardisierte Abläufe und dokumentierte Prozesse. Du erhältst praxisbewährtes Fachwissen und kannst dich auf eine planbare Einarbeitung verlassen. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind klar definiert und nachvollziehbar. 

  • Attraktive Vergütung:
    Du erhältst von Beginn an ein überdurchschnittliches, festes Gehalt. Zusätzlich gibt es je nach Stelle transparente und messbare Bonusregelungen für besonders gute Leistungen.

  • Professionelle Mandate:
    Du arbeitest in einer der führenden Kanzleien in Düsseldorf und hilfst bei der Betreuung von renommierten Mandanten. Du arbeitest mit strukturierten und professionellen Mandanten aus dem Mittelstand und aus etablierten Branchen. Dadurch hast du ein stabiles, planbares Umfeld in deiner täglichen Arbeit.

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz
    Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Wir haben nur unbefristete Arbeitsverträge in Vollzeit. Durch unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und die stabile Auftragslage bieten wir dir eine langfristige Perspektive mit hoher Arbeitsplatzsicherheit.

  • Hochmodernes Büro:
    Du arbeitest bei uns in einem voll verglasten Büro mit atemberaubender Aussicht über Düsseldorf und mit den neuesten Geräten. Unser Büro ist klar strukturiert, technisch auf dem neuesten Stand und bietet dir eine ruhige, professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Blick über den Rhein und Medienhafen.

  • Digitale Arbeitswelt:
    Wir arbeiten vollständig digital, sind von DATEV als Digitale Kanzlei ausgezeichnet und nutzen automatisierte Prozesse, damit du dich auf deine Kernaufgaben konzentrieren kannst. Wir sind eine innovative Kanzlei im Bereich Digitalisierung.

Eckdaten zur Stelle:

  • Gehalt: 42.000 - 54.000 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt

  • Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: vorhanden

  • Einarbeitungsphase: in der Regel 2–4 Monate

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (z. B. IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, Informatikkaufmann/-frau) oder Studium (Wirtschaftsinformatik o. ä.)

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Support, IT-Administration oder Software-Implementierung

  • Erfahrung mit Integrations-/Automation-Tools (z. B. Zapier, Mirror/Make o. ä.) und Routine im DATEV-Umfeld

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; Erstellung/Pflege von Formularen und Dokumenten

  • Sehr gute Ausdrucksform in Wort und Schrift; hohe Verlässlichkeit und Diskretion

  • Strukturierte, vorausschauende und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise; souverän in dynamischen Situationen

  • Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und serviceorientiertes Auftreten

  • Von Vorteil: Grundverständnis für Online-Marketing/Consulting-Prozesse
