jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Autocom is a high-tech company that develops advanced diagnostic equipment for vehicles. Our end customers include vehicle repair shops and inspection companies. Our Autocom products are available in most European countries, and we work with several major companies worldwide in the automotive aftermarket. Our economic growth is stable, which allows us to continue to hire new employees, and we currently have around 120 employees. Autocom is part of the Würth Group, which has over 90,000 employees globally. More information about AUTOCOM can be found at www.autocom.se.

About the role

Autocom is undergoing a major technological transformation, with our entire product portfolio gradually moving to the cloud. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be part of our Cloud Enablement Team, responsible for the shared infrastructure and technical building blocks that enable our development teams to build, deploy and operate their services efficiently.

Our development teams are responsible for their own services and databases, while you and the Cloud Enablement Team provide the underlying platform, network and tools they need to work effectively. You will work with modern cloud technologies in AWS and play an important role in building the foundation for the next generation of our products, with a strong focus on security, scalability, automation and a great developer experience.

The role includes:

    

Developing and managing scalable and reliable AWS cloud infrastructure, including networking, load balancing and service mesh.

    

Automating and standardizing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), while developing CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure.

    

Building self-service solutions and reusable modules to enable efficient DevOps practices across development teams.

    

Managing observability, monitoring and security, including platform modernization and TISAX-related controls.

    

Troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and driving improvements in scalability, stability, performance and cost efficiency.

You will also have the opportunity to influence the future direction of our cloud platform and work with technology supporting a broad product portfolio, including Windows, iOS and Android solutions, as well as hardware that communicates with the cloud.

#LI-DNI

Your profile

We are looking for someone with:

    

A university degree in engineering, IT, computer science or a related field.

    

Experience working in a larger cloud environment, such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

    

Comfortable working in Linux environments

    

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.

    

Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

    

A good understanding of networking, cloud infrastructure and how different services communicate with each other.

    

Experience with CI/CD and automated development and delivery pipelines.

You don't need to have many years of experience to be successful in this role - we are also open to more junior profiles with a strong technical foundation, relevant experience and, most importantly, a genuine drive to learn and develop. You enjoy taking ownership, solving technical challenges and understanding how different parts of a technical platform fit together. You are curious about new technologies and motivated by the opportunity to help build something that is continuously evolving.

Application

In this recruitment process, Autocom is collaborating with Skill. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, please contact Johan Zizala at Skill, johan.zizala@skill.se / 0721-43 93 42.

jobs.title: Barnevernskonsulent
jobs.description:
Barnevernstjenesten har ledig én fast 100 % stilling som barnevernskonsulent. Stillingen er knyttet til team for undersøkelse og oppfølging.  

Ønsker du å jobbe i et spennende og faglig sterkt miljø, sammen med gode kollegaer som støtter og løfter hverandre i en viktig – og tidvis krevende – arbeidshverdag? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg.

Vi søker fortrinnsvis deg som har erfaring fra første- eller andrelinjetjenesten.

Barnevernstjenesten i Nesodden kommune er organisert under virksomheten Barn, unge og familie og har 19,6 årsverk. Tjenesten ledes av barnevernsleder, som har det faglige og administrative ansvaret.

Barnevernskonsulentenes hovedoppgave er å bidra til at barn og unge får trygge oppvekstsvilkår. Vi møter barn, unge og familier med respekt og forståelse, og samarbeider for å finne gode og helhetlige løsninger.

Nesodden kommune er en TIBIR-kommune (Tidlig innsats for barn i risiko). Ansatte i flere av kommunens tjenester bidrar inn i dette arbeidet. Vi arbeider forebyggende og i et livsløpsperspektiv, og samarbeider tett med andre hjelpeinstanser, blant annet kommunale tjenester, statlige aktører, politi og BUP.

Vi er opptatt av god struktur, tydelige rutiner og høy faglig kvalitet. Fagmiljøet vårt kjennetegnes av et særdeles godt arbeidsmiljø. Arbeidet innebærer ofte alvorlige problemstillinger, men vi har også rom for smil, humor og støtte i hverdagen.

Tjenesten er organisert i tre team:

  • Mottak
  • Team for undersøkelse og oppfølging
  • Team for omsorg og ettervern

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene innebærer saksbehandling etter barnevernsloven. Du vil ha mye kontakt med barn og unge, foreldre, nettverk og samarbeidspartnere. 

Team for undersøkelse og oppfølging
Som kontaktperson i team for undersøkelse og oppfølging får du en variert arbeidshverdag. Aktuelle arbeidsoppgaver er blant annet:

  • Saksbehandling etter barnevernsloven
  • Samtaler og møter med barn, unge og deres familier
  • Møteledelse og koordinering av tiltak
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid med blant annet skole, skolehelsetjeneste, barnehage, helsestasjon, BUP og spesialisthelsetjenesten
  • Representasjon på vegne av kommunen i Barneverns- og helsenemnda og øvrige rettsinstanser

Stillingen kan ved behov bli tillagt andre oppgaver. Noe kveldsarbeid og reisevirksomhet må påregnes.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Bachelorutdanning som barnevernspedagog eller sosionom. Annen relevant treårig høyere utdanning kan vurderes
  • Relevant videreutdanning på minimum 30 studiepoeng er ønskelig 
  • Det er ønskelig med bred erfaring fra førstelinjetjenesten
  • Svært gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Førerkort klasse B er ønskelig
  • Gyldig politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse
Vi ser etter deg som:
  • Har erfaring med saksbehandling i barnevernstjenesten
  • Har god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne
  • Er trygg og tydelig i barnevernsfaglige vurderinger, har høy faglig integritet og evne til å ta ansvar og beslutninger
  • Har gode samarbeids- og relasjonsferdigheter, og evner å etablere tillit i møte med barn, unge, familier og samarbeidspartnere
  • Er utholdende, løsningsorientert, ikke redd for å ta i et tak og evner å se muligheter og finne gode løsninger i komplekse saker
  • Er fleksibel og har evne og vilje til å stå i endring
  • Ønsker å tilegne deg ny kunnskap og utvikle deg faglig
  • Bidrar aktivt til et godt arbeidsmiljø, med engasjement og godt humør

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Individuell veiledning
  • Interessante og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode faglige og personlige utviklingsmuligheter
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø  
  • Medarbeidere med høyt faglig nivå
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger


Lønn etter avtale.

For korrekt vurdering av ansiennitet og lønn, ber vi om at vitnemål og attester legges ved søknaden. Søknader uten nødvendig dokumentasjon kan bli betraktet som mangelfulle. Dette kan påvirke både vurdering og lønnsplassering.

KontaktinformasjonMona Stensen , Avdelingsleder, 40034716
ArbeidsstedKongleveien 1
1450 Nesoddtangen
Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Nesodden kommune

Referansenr.: 5190213872
Stillingsprosent: 100%
Fast
Søknadsfrist: 19.10.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nesodden kommune er en grønn halvøy i Oslofjorden, med kort vei til både natur og storbyliv. Kommunen har unike kvaliteter i form av skog, strand og fjord, og et rikt kunst- og kulturliv. Nesodden er en kommune i vekst som satser på samfunns- og næringsutvikling. Kommunen har omkring 1300 ansatte, som sørger for gode tjenester til våre 20.000 innbyggere.

Vi arbeider for et likeverdig og inkluderende samfunn, som åpner for deltakelse og engasjement hos innbyggerne. Kommunen skal være sosialt, økonomisk og miljømessig bærekraftig, og har som mål å være foregangskommune innen miljø- og klimaarbeid. I Nesodden kommune jobber medarbeidere og ledere sammen for at kommunen skal være en attraktiv og fremtidsrettet arbeidsplass. Kommunen tilbyr spennende og trygge jobber, med muligheter for faglig utvikling.

Sammen skaper vi det gode livet!

Nesodden kommune vil aldri be om innlogging med Bank-ID til søkerportalen Webcruiter, dette for å redusere risikoen for dataangrep (phishing).

Ergoterapeut/ spesialergoterapeut for barn og unge
jobs.description:
Ved Fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten 0-18 år har vi ledig:

  • Vikariat som ergoterapeut/spesialergoterapeut (snarlig oppstart).

Er du en engasjert ergoterapeut med hjerte for barn og unge? Ønsker du å bli en del av et stabilt og positivt arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig kompetanse? En av våre spesialergoterapeuter skal ut i permisjon, og vi har derfor ledig vikariat i 100% stilling fra snarest til 10.12.2027 som ergoterapeut med stillingskode 6517 eller spesialergoterapeut med stillingskode 6617.

For å ivareta pasientgruppen barn og unge under 18 år med behov for ergoterapi og/ eller fysioterapi, er det i dag 5 ergoterapeuter, 13 fysioterapeuter og 1 turnusfysioterapeut ansatt i Fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten 0-18 år som ledes av egen avdelingsleder. Begge faggrupper tilbyr tjenester i barn og unge sitt naturlige miljø som i barnehage, skole, hjem og avlastning. Ergoterapi gis både individuelt og i grupper, som enkeltstående tiltak eller som en del av tverrfaglig habilitering/rehabilitering. Avdelingen er organisert under enheten Tverrfaglig ressurs i seksjon barn og familie i avdeling for oppvekst, utdanning og kultur.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ergoterapi til barn og unge under 18 år i form av enkeltstående tiltak og tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • Observere, kartlegge og gjennomføre tiltak knyttet til aktivitet og deltagelse.
  • Praktisk tilnærming til faget og stor variasjon i oppgaver; fra kontorarbeid til tilpassing av hjelpemidler, fysisk deltakelse i terapisituasjoner sammen med barn og unge både innen daglige gjøremål (ADL), grov- og finmotoriske aktiviteter og sansemotorisk tilnærming.
  • Ergoterapitiltak utøves primært i barnehager, på skoler og i egne behandlingsrom.
  • Formidling og tilpasning av tekniske hjelpemidler.
  • Vurdering og tilpasning av bolig og bil.
  • Lede/-delta i tverrfaglig team og koordinering av individuell plan.
  • Veiledning, informasjon og undervisning til pasienter, pårørende, samarbeidspartnere og studenter.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som ergoterapeut for tilsetting i stillingskode 6517- ergoterapeut.
  • Norsk autorisasjon som ergoterapeut, samt 60 Stp relevant videreutdanning som ergoterapeut for barn og unge, for tilsetting i stillingskode 6617-  spesialergoterapeut.
  • Erfaring fra kommunehelsetjenesten og/eller spesialisthelsetjenesten som ergoterapeut for barn og unge, for tilsetting i stillingskode 6617- spesialergoterapeut.
  • Dersom du har annet morsmål enn norsk, må du vedlegge dokumentasjon på at du har språknivå tilsvarende B2. 

       Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant videreutdanning/kurs i ergoterapi for barn og unge.
  • Erfaring fra tverrfaglig samarbeid. 
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med formidling av tekniske hjelpemidler og søknader om bil, samt tilrettelegging av bolig og omgivelsene for barn og unge.
  • Erfaring med veiledning av studenter.
  • Erfaring med alternativ supplerende kommunikasjon (ASK).
  • Kjennskap til og erfaring med individuell plan.
  • Førerkort klasse B.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du har fokus på brukermedvirkning og trives med å jobbe med barn og unge.
  • Du er faglig engasjert og kan veilede ut ifra din kompetanse.
  • Du trives med å jobbe selvstendig og i team.
  • Du har gode evner i kommunikasjon og samarbeid med andre. 
  • Du evner å skape tillit.
  • Du er positiv og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Du trives med å arbeide i et hektisk fagmiljø og ønsker utfordringer.
  • Du må kunne identifisere deg med Tromsø kommunes verdigrunnlag; respekt, åpenhet, mot, anerkjennelse og tillit.
    Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt ved ansettelse.
Vi tilbyr
  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid på dagtid, og gode velferdsordninger.
  • Selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Internundervisning, faglig kontorfellesskap med kollegaveiledning og fadderordning. Du vil få støtte av både fadder og kollegaer i prosessen med å komme inn i stillingen.
  • En spennende hverdag i et tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø, som er i stadig utvikling.

jobs.title: Fysioterapeut for barn og unge
jobs.description:
Ved Fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten 0-18 år har vi ledig:

  • Vikariat som fysioterapeut (oppstart snarest). 

Er du en engasjert fysioterapeut med hjerte for barn og unge? Ønsker du å bli en del av et stabilt og positivt arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig kompetanse? En av våre fysioterapeuter skal ut i permisjon, og vi har derfor ledig vikariat i 100% stilling som fysioterapeut, stillingskode 7066.

For å ivareta pasientgruppen barn og unge under 18 år med behov for fysioterapi og/ eller ergoterapi, er det i dag 5 ergoterapeuter, 13 fysioterapeuter og 1 turnusfysioterapeut ansatt i Fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten 0-18 år som ledes av egen avdelingsleder. Begge faggrupper tilbyr tjenester i barn og unge sitt naturlige miljø som i barnehage, skole, hjem og avlastning. Avdelingen er organisert under enheten Tverrfaglig ressurs i seksjon barn og familie i avdeling for oppvekst, utdanning og kultur.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Fysioterapi til barn og unge under 18 år i form av enkeltstående tiltak, gruppetilbud i basseng og tverrfaglig samarbeid, i tråd med tjenestens funksjonsbeskrivelse for stillingen.
  • Fysioterapi utøves primært i barnehager, på skoler og i egne behandlingsrom.
  • Veiledning og rådgivning til barnet/ungdommen, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Lede/delta i tverrfaglig team rundt barnet/ungdommen.
  • Koordinering av individuell plan.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som fysioterapeut.
  • Gode norskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig. Søkere med annet språk enn norsk som morsmål må vedlegge dokumentasjon av språknivå tilsvarende B2.

     Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Allsidig erfaring fra kommunehelsetjeneste som fysioterapeut for barn og unge, eller annen relevant erfaring.
  • Relevante kurs/etterutdanninger som fysioterapeut for barn og unge.
  • Erfaring med veiledning av studenter.
  • Kjennskap til og erfaring med individuell plan.
  • Førerkort klasse B. 
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er faglig engasjert, og liker godt å være sammen med barn og unge.
  • Du har gode evner i kommunikasjon og samarbeid med andre. 
  • Du evner å håndtere flere ulike type arbeidsoppgaver og skape en god struktur i arbeidet ditt.
  • Du trives med å jobbe selvstendig og i team. 
  • Du er nytenkende, fleksibel og løsningsorientert.
  • Du er positiv og bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Du må kunne indentifisere deg med Tromsø kommunes verdigrunnlag; respekt, åpenhet, mot, annerkjennelse og tillit.
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt ved ansettelse.

Vi tilbyr
  • Ordnede pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • Selvstendige arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Gode faglige utviklingsmuligheter.
  • Internundervisning, faglig kontorfellesskap med kollegaveiledning og fadderordning.
  • En spennende hverdag i et tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø, som er i stadig utvikling.
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid, og gode velferdsordninger.
  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariffavtaler 7066 fysioterapeut (med særaldersgrense) (årslønn 545 400-639 900 kr.).

 

Annet

  • Tilsetting skjer i henhold til gjeldende lover, reglement og tariffavtaler.
  • Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste, selv om søkeren har bedt om anonymitet. Dette blir du så fall varslet om.
  • Ved tilsetting må gyldig politiattest iht. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven §5-4 fremlegges. 
  • Ved tilsetting kreves tuberkuloseundersøkelse for søkere som i løpet av de siste tre årene har oppholdt seg sammenhengende mer enn tre måneder i land med høy forekomst av tuberkulose iht. tuberkuloseforskriftens § 3.1 og 3.2.

  • Attester og vitnemål legges ved søknad før intervju.
  • Referanser registreres på forespørsel.
  • Søknad sendes elektronisk via Webcruiter. 

    Kjenner du deg igjen i dette - da blir vi svært glad for å høre fra deg!

jobs.title: Senior Purchaser
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Through strong engineering expertise, cutting-edge technology, and close collaboration, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment where talent can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make a difference.

VARD Electro is a leading supplier of maritime electrical systems, automation, integration, and energy solutions for vessels operating worldwide. With a strong focus on innovation, digitalization, and sustainability, we develop advanced technologies that help our customers improve efficiency, safety, and environmental performance. As part of the VARD Group, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to shape the future of the maritime industry.

We are currently looking for a Senior Purchaser, to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Manage purchasing activities within the navigation equipment area, including DP systems, sensors, positioning and related navigation and bridge equipment.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers.
  • Lead supplier negotiations on price, delivery, commercial terms and contracts.
  • Develop and re-negotiate framework agreements, price lists and other commercial agreements.
  • Evaluate supplier offers and perform commercial analysis.
  • Ensure competitive pricing and support cost reduction and procurement improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with Engineering and other stakeholders to ensure technical and commercial alignment.
  • Follow up supplier performance, deliveries and commercial topics.
  • Analyze purchasing and spend data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure correct procurement data, pricing and supplier information are maintained in SAP/ERP.
  • Support continuous improvement of procurement processes and ways of working. 
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education within procurement, supply chain, business, engineering or a related field.
  • Several years of relevant procurement experience, preferably within marine, maritime, offshore or industrial equipment.
  • Competence and experience within navigation equipment, ideally including DP systems, sensors, positioning and related systems is preferred.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
  • Good analytical skills.
  • Experience with contracts, supplier management and commercial agreements.
  • Good understanding of technical products and the ability to work effectively with Engineering and other technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Commercially minded and results oriented.
  • Structured and analytical.
  • Independent and proactive.
  • A strong communicator and negotiator.
  • Comfortable working across different functions and with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Able to take ownership and drive activities to completion. 
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you 
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your career

 

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

Vard Electro is a globally recognized and trusted provider and advisor of marine electrical systems. Established in Norway in 1997, Vard Electro has today approx. 900 employees based in Norway, Romania, Brazil, Singapore, India, Italy, UK, Canada, USA and Vietnam, and operating worldwide.

In close cooperation with the customer, Vard Electro offers ­effective and environmentally friendly solutions with a focus on optimization of the operational performance. Vard Electro works with all established brands in the market, thereby giving customers smart solutions with a high degree of flexibility. jobs.title: Content Editor
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you.

What you will work on

  • Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text;

  • Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product;

  • Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases;

  • Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links;

  • Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak;

  • Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar;

  • Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series;

  • Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish.

Your must haves

  • English as your native language;

  • A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it;

  • An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't;

  • The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer;

  • An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen;

  • Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up.

Nice to have

  • Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product;

  • Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice;

  • Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use;

The deal

  • Competitive salary in USD;

  • Fully remote position;

  • Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally;

  • Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential.

jobs.title: Process Excellence Support in Logistics for BSH Northern Europe
jobs.description:
BSH Home Appliances is a global leader in the home appliance industry, committed to creating innovative solutions that enhance the quality of life at home. BSH Northern Europe oversees the Nordic countries as well as Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. We take pride in offering top-quality brands, including Bosch, Siemens, NEFF, and Gaggenau.

If you are passionate about operational efficiency and eager to contribute your expertise in logistics, join us in shaping the future of home appliances at the BSH-operated warehouse in Nykvarn.

In your role as Process Excellence Support, you will be responsible for addressing the bugs, gaps and enhancements of logistics systems and processes for BSH Northern Europe. You will play a vital role in ensuring seamless daily operations and fostering continuous improvements.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Your success will be defined by:

    Driving sustainable system and process solutions that enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs
    Timely and successful completion of projects within scope and targets

You will achieve these by:

    Provide first line support for system bugs and process gaps
    Analyze data and carry out direct observations to identify root causes and opportunities
    Map processes, create flow charts and gap analyses to define improvement scope
    Lead and execute "system and process changes", "new implementations", and "optimization initiatives"
    Coordinate and communicate with internal and external stakeholders
    Identify and initiate AI and automation opportunities

YOUR PROFILE

    Degree in industrial engineering or similar
    Foundation knowledge in logistics including warehouse and transport processes
    Analytical ability, agile and proactive mindset with excellent problem‑solving skills
    SAP-S4 Hana: transport management system - TMS/TM invoicing, last mile control - LMC, warehouse management - WM/EWM, forklift management – ITM, track and trace system – GTT, data tables, interfaces, EDI/API connection, carrier connector
    Experience leading continuous improvement projects and applying AI/advanced analytics
    Proficient in office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, Power BI)

jobs.title: Jeg søker en trygg og engasjert BPA-assistent til en aktiv hverdag på gård
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast stilling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Ettermiddag, kveld og helger

Hei! Jeg er en positiv gutt på 13 år som bor på gård sammen med familien min. Jeg er glad i alt som har med friluftsliv og praktiske aktiviteter å gjøre, og bruker gjerne tiden min på jakt, fiske, snekring, møbelsnekring, ATV-kjøring, crosskjøring og skyting. Jeg bryr meg om menneskene rundt meg og trives best når dagene inneholder aktiviteter, mestring og gode opplevelser sammen med andre. Nå ser jeg etter en assistent som kan bli en naturlig del av hverdagen min og være med på både små og store aktiviteter sammen med meg og broren min på 10 år.

Jeg har ADHD, autisme og Tourettes syndrom. Dette gjør at jeg til tider kan ha utfordringer med regulering av følelser og reaksjoner. Jeg kan være rigid i enkelte situasjoner og trenger mennesker rundt meg som klarer å bevare roen, skape trygghet og stå stødig også når dagene ikke går helt som planlagt. Derfor ser jeg etter en assistent med tålmodighet, forståelse og evne til å møte meg på en positiv og respektfull måte.

Vi har behov for 1-2 assistenter i en turnus hvor det jobbes annenhver uke. Arbeidstiden vil i hovedsak være fra jeg kommer hjem fra skolen rundt kl. 14.00 og utover ettermiddag/kveld, samt i helger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Delta på aktiviteter som jakt, fiske, snekring og andre fritidsinteresser

  • Være med meg i hverdagen hjemme og ute på aktiviteter

  • Bidra til gode opplevelser

  • Være en trygg person som støtter og veileder ved behov

  • Praktisk hjelp i hjemmet og rundt aktiviteter

Personlige egenskaper vi ser etter

  • Rolig og trygg i krevende situasjoner

  • Tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • God til å bygge relasjoner med barn og ungdom

  • Selvgående og initiativrik

  • Fleksibel og løsningsorientert

  • Fordel om du har interesse for friluftsliv, motorinteresser eller praktiske aktiviteter

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Gode norskkunnskaper

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Egen bil tilgjengelig i arbeid

  • Erfaring med barn eller ungdom er en fordel

  • Erfaring med lignende diagnoser eller atferdsutfordringer er positivt, men ikke et krav

  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges sterkt

Vi har også hund i hjemmet, så du bør ikke være allergisk mot hund.

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Da håper jeg du sender inn en søknad. Jeg ser frem til å bli kjent med en trygg og positiv assistent som ønsker å være en viktig del av hverdagen min! 🐟🔨🏍️🌲


Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Henriette Leistad på epost: henriette.leistad@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At Seco, we’re looking for a Solution Architect with a strong domain focus who connects business needs with scalable, secure, and future-ready technology solutions. In this position, you play a key role in shaping architecture within a specific business domain and ensuring that technology investments support strategic goals, operational excellence, and long-term growth.

About the job

As a Solution Architect, you design and guide the implementation of technology solutions within a dedicated business domain. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and IT, you translate strategic direction and business requirements into practical solution designs that align with enterprise architecture principles, technical standards, and business objectives. You report to the Director CIO Office.  

Job responsibilities

    Build a strong understanding of your assigned business domain and translating business requirements into scalable, reusable technology solutions.
    Define architecture visions, roadmaps, and high-level solution designs that support both current and future business needs.
    Evaluate applications, technologies, and solution alternatives to ensure the best fit for business requirements.
    Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure alignment with enterprise standards and best practices.
    Create and maintain architectural documentation, including blueprints, integration plans, and technology roadmaps.
    Support delivery teams, ensuring compliance with security, data, and governance requirements while managing risks and technical debt.

Location

The primary location for this position is Fagersta. However, candidates based in other locations across Sweden may also be considered.

Your profile

You bring a combination of business understanding, architectural expertise, and strong stakeholder management skills. With experience from complex technology environments, you enjoy translating business challenges into practical and sustainable solutions while collaborating across organizational boundaries.

Your background includes:

    Experience working with architectural frameworks, such as TOGAF.
    Knowledge of cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
    Understanding of architecture domains such as integration, data, network, and security.
    Experience translating complex business requirements into solution designs and architectural blueprints.
    Familiarity with Agile and DevOps ways of working.

Experience with domain-driven design, product-centric organizations, enterprise architecture frameworks, cloud certifications, or domain-specific platforms such as ERP, CRM, or data platforms is considered an advantage.

Success in this position comes from combining strong analytical thinking with collaboration and communication. You’re comfortable navigating complex environments, building relationships across functions, and explaining technical concepts to a variety of audiences. A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and a drive to continuously improve help you create lasting impact.

Our Seco culture  

At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.

jobs.title: Nu söker Novelia heltidsanställda till våra HVB-hem i Vikmanshyttan!
jobs.description:
Om Novelia

Novelia-koncernen grundades 2021 ur en vilja att göra skillnad och tillsammans med andra arbeta utifrån drivkraften att skapa meningsfullhet. Vår värdegrund speglas av att vi alla är lika värda och där vårt uppdrag är att skapa förutsättningar för en trygg omsorg och ett individanpassat stöd. Genom delaktighet, samarbete och dialog är målet att var och en ska kunna leva ett gott liv utifrån sina egna förutsättningar, behov och vilja.

Novelia strävar efter att skapa en vårdkedja inom området barn och unga för att på så sätt kunna möta upp barns olika behov av stöd och insatser utifrån rätt nivå och tidpunkt i livet. Inom Barn och Unga bedriver vi idag behandlingshem, stödboende och familjehem.

Vi erbjuder även stöd till personer inom socialpsykiatrin genom att erbjuda gruppbostäder med särskild service, stödboende och träfflokal.

Tillsammans skapar vi en meningsfull vardag och livskvalitet dygnet runt. Välkommen att göra skillnad.

Om tjänsten

Novelia bedriver idag två HVB-hem för barn och unga beläget i Vikmanshyttan som heter Hyttan och Viken. Nu söker vi personal, till fasta rader på heltid, till båda boenden. Arbetet är förlagt dagtid, kväll och helg på rullande schema - i arbetstiden ingår arbetspass med sovande jour.

Vi har 9 platser per boende och vi bedriver både utredning, vård och behandling för flickor 13–17 år gamla, som uppvisar anknytningsproblematik, neuropsykiatriska beteendeproblem, självdestruktivitet, sociala beteende- och samspelsbrister, som vistats i olämpliga miljöer, som har begått enstaka brott, som har provat att ta droger, som har ett hotfullt beteende och hamnar i konflikt med andra människor. Flickorna kan ha stor frånvaro från skolan och även ha sociala samspelssvårigheter och sociala färdighetsbrister.

Verksamhetens förhållningssätt strävar mot att skapa en trygg, trivsam och förutsägbar miljö för de inskrivna ungdomarna i HVB-hem. Det miljöterapeutiska arbetet inriktas mot att involvera ungdomarna och göra dem delaktiga i att skapa fungerande rutiner i vardagen och i sin behandling. Vi individanpassar behandlingen så mycket som möjligt och har tillgång till kvalificerad specialistkompetens inom det sociala och psykiatriska området.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har en minst två-årig eftergymnasial utbildning inom socialt arbete, t.ex. som social- eller behandlingspedagog. Meriterande om du har högskolepoäng inom KBT, MI, ACRA, neuropsykiatriska funktionshinder eller pedagogik.

Du har erfarenhet av arbete inom omsorg och/eller socialt arbete. Du har även erfarenhet av arbete med barn och ungdomar samt kan uttrycka dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Tidigare arbete på HVB med klienter som har utåtagerande beteende är starkt meriterande.

Tjänsten innefattar behandlingsinsatser genom samtal, aktiviteter, strukturerade vardagsrutiner och grundläggande omsorg för de barn som bor i våra verksamheter. Du ansvarar för att skapa relation med både barnet och viktiga personer i dess nätverk.

Tjänsten innefattar också sedvanliga hushålls-och städuppgifter som förekommer på ett boende. Krav på B-körkort för att vara aktuell för tjänsten.

Registerkontroll

Om du blir kallad på intervju så förutsätts att du har med dig ett utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregistret. Du kan gå in på: https://polisen.se/service/blanketter-belastningsregistret/blankett-4427-hvbhem-belastningsregistret/ och hitta blanketten där.

Kollektivavtal, förmåner & ersättning

Alla bolag i Novelia-koncernen är medlemmar i Almega/Vårdföretagarna och har kollektivavtal enligt Bransch E, för denna roll tillämpas kollektivavtal mellan Almega/Vårdföretagarna och Vision.

Novelia erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag om 3000kr/per arbetat helår.

Lönesättningen är differentierad och individuell enligt överenskommelse.

Tillträde & omfattning

Intervjuer kommer ske löpande. Vi kommer endast att svara på de ansökningar som uppfyller kraven.

För dessa tjänster applicerar vi inledande provanställning som löper över i tillsvidareanställning, tillträde är efter överenskommelse.

jobs.title: Master thesis - Structural Analysis
jobs.description:
Company Description

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable society.

Job Description

AFRY Technical Analysis is the largest consulting CAE-department in Sweden, with extensive experience within structural and fluid mechanics from a wide range of clients in several industries. We are deeply involved in many interesting projects, both national and international, and provide our clients with market leading CAE-competence.

This master thesis will be a collaboration between AFRY and AFRY´s clients within automotive, defense or energy-industry. The student will develop new methodology, with respect to structural analysis and FEA, to facilitate more efficient product development for AFRY´s clients. The results can pave the way for new modelling guidelines (often calibrated against test data), a more efficient way of working and increased simulations accuracy.

FEA tools such as ANSYS, ABAQUS and LS-Dyna will be used with MATLAB and Phyton as a complement for post-processing and automatization. Analytical calculations are performed mainly to verify the analysis models and results.

Qualifications

You are specialized in solid mechanics and have good theoretical knowledge in general. You have a clear grasp of the basics with respect to strength, fatigue and dynamic analysis, and have performed some finite element analysis during your education. You have used commercial software before and are familiar with the basic FEA-approach, with respect to pre-processing, analysis, and post-processing.

As a person you are meticulous, ambitious, curios and eager to learn. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you appreciate the value added by working together with your colleagues to find the best solution. Lastly, you also have good communicative skills, both oral and in writing, and can explain complex issues in a comprehensible manner.

Additional Information

AFRY will most likely offer you a position as a CAE-Engineer after a successful completion of this master thesis.

Last day of application is 2026-10-31. This is an ongoing recruitment process, which means that the role might be filled before last day of application. We do not accept applications via email.

jobs.title: Er du god med mennesker og liker å finne de beste løsningene for kunden?
jobs.description:
Toyota Haugesund søker kunderådgiver

Du trenger ikke å kunne alt om bil for å lykkes som kunderådgiver hos Toyota Haugesund. Det viktigste er at du liker mennesker, trives med ansvar og motiveres av å skape gode kundeopplevelser.

Som kunderådgiver blir du bindeleddet mellom kundene våre og verkstedet. Du følger kunden gjennom hele besøket, fra bilen leveres inn til nøklene gis tilbake, og sørger for god kommunikasjon og en trygg opplevelse underveis.

Du får en variert arbeidshverdag hvor kundekontakt kombineres med koordinering, salg og administrative oppgaver. Noen dager handler det om å finne den beste løsningen for en kunde, andre ganger om å sørge for at deler er på plass, følge opp en verkstedordre eller sikre at kunden vet hva som skjer med bilen.

Du vil blant annet:

  • Ta imot kunder ved innlevering og utlevering av bil
  • Veilede og følge opp kunder gjennom verkstedbesøket
  • Identifisere behov og tilby relevante verkstedtjenester
  • Følge opp deler og bestillinger
  • Håndtere ordre og fakturering
  • Sørge for god kommunikasjon mellom kunde og verksted
  • Bidra til at kundene våre får en best mulig opplevelse
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som naturlig setter kunden først. Du er god til å lytte, forstå behov og finne løsninger, samtidig som du klarer å holde oversikt når det er mye som skjer.

Du trives med mennesker og kommuniserer godt med ulike typer kunder. Samtidig har du interesse for bil og en teknisk forståelse som gjør at du raskt kan sette deg inn i kundens behov og problemstillinger.

Erfaring fra bilbransjen er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Har du jobbet med kundeservice, rådgivning eller salg og kjenner deg igjen i rollen, ønsker vi også å høre fra deg.

Vi tror du:

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner og liker kundekontakt
  • Har interesse for bil og god teknisk forståelse
  • Er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av gode kundeopplevelser
  • Er strukturert og løsningsorientert
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og tar ansvar
  • Er komfortabel med IT som arbeidsverktøy
  • Trives med både selvstendig arbeid og samarbeid
Hvorfor Toyota Haugesund?

Hos Toyota Haugesund blir du en del av en komplett bilforhandler hvor salg, verksted, karosseri, lakkering, klargjøring, deler og dekk er samlet under samme tak.

Du får jobbe med en av verdens mest kjente bilmerkevarer og blir en del av et fagmiljø hvor kvalitet, kontinuerlig forbedring og gode kundeopplevelser står sentralt.

Hos oss får du blant annet:

  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Opplæring og faglig utvikling gjennom Toyotas opplæringsprogrammer
  • God støtte fra dyktige kollegaer
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste og tilgang til personalhytte
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på gode arbeidsforhold
  • Muligheten til å utvikle deg i en solid virksomhet og en bilbransje i stor utvikling
Om Toyota Haugesund

Toyota Haugesund er en del av Jæger Automobil AS og er en komplett bilforhandler på Haugalandet. Fra anlegget i Salhusvegen tilbyr vi blant annet nye og brukte biler, verkstedtjenester, deler og tilbehør, dekkhotell, karosseri, lakkering og klargjøring.

Jæger Automobil er en del av Jægergruppen, Vestlandets største bilforhandler, og representerer Toyota, Lexus, BMW og MINI. Konsernet har over 250 ansatte og en årlig omsetning på 1,6 milliarder kroner.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

As Etraveli Group rapidly expands its agentic AI ecosystem, we are looking for a hands-on engineer to serve as the core technical muscle for our AI Optimization team. In this role, you will rapidly build, test, and evaluate agentic MVPs using Python, APIs, and LLM frameworks. You will design rigorous evaluation pipelines to prove accuracy, latency, and ROI, ensuring all agents align with company principles. Once validated, you will act as the key technical stakeholder translating prototypes into clean specifications for our core Technology team to scale.

Responsibilities

Rapid Prototyping & MVP Engineering

    Build functional end-to-end agents using Python, LLM frameworks, APIs, and databases.
    Spin up infrastructure (vector/relational databases, docker containers) for real-world testing.
    Select architectural patterns (API wrappers, lightweight RAG, function calling).
    Iterate based on business feedback and discard when concepts prove unviable.

Data Rigor & Technical Evaluation

    Design evaluation pipelines to benchmark accuracy, hallucination rates, latency, and cost.
    Build ground-truth labeled evaluation sets with business owners to validate production readiness.
    Analyze discrepancies between agent outputs and human decisions during pilots.
    Support business stakeholders in taking responsibility for prompts and business logic.
    Continuously test new AI models and tools against internal benchmarks.

Feasibility & Technical Discovery

    Assess operational workflows with strategy teams to determine agentic feasibility and scope difficulty.
    Evaluate new agent architectures and AI tooling to recommend core platform adoption.

Handoff & Platform Stakeholder

    Serve as the primary technical stakeholder to the core technology AI platform team.
    Translate validated MVPs into clear technical specs, architecture diagrams, and data flows.
    Partner with AI platform team to ensure seamless absorption of MVP logic into internal SDKs.

Requirements

Must Have

    3+ years software engineering experience with strong Python and rapid prototyping skills.
    Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration (tool use, RAG, structured outputs via LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM, or APIs).
    Proficiency in API design, SQL, and relational/vector databases.
    Experience using evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith) to benchmark performance.
    Agile, pragmatic mindset for fast experimentation outside traditional sprint cycles.
    Ability to convert complex business logic into concise specs for engineering teams.

Nice to Have

    Background as a Forward-Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or similar fast-delivery role.
    Familiarity with modern deployment stacks (FastAPI, Docker, serverless).
    Domain experience in travel tech, airline distribution, or payments.
    Basic product management understanding (ROI tracking, KPIs, user validation).

Benefits

The culture at Etraveli Group embraces complexity and we like to keep the entrepreneurial spirit even as we grow into being a larger company. With us you can enjoy:

    A flexible working environment. We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you will have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location.
    Modern office in the heart of the city – A bright and central location with great access to public transport, lunch spots, and parks just around the corner.
    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.
    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.
    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

jobs.title: Chef De Partie
Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Lendo, we are on a mission to empower people to make smart, conscious financial decisions. We are entering an exciting growth phase, expanding our offerings to launch new products and help even more people navigate their financial journeys.

We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer to join our Product & Tech Sweden team, reporting directly to the Head of Product & Technology Sweden and joining the Product & Tech Leadership Team. In this role, you will lead and mentor our team of 3 UX designers and establish an elevated, user-first design culture across the company. You aren't just managing UI outputs you will champion service design, facilitate cross-departmental alignment, and shape holistic digital experiences that drive both user delight and business value.

About the role

As Lead Product Designer, you set the design vision and lead the end-to-end design practice across our ecosystem. You stay close to the daily design reality without micro-managing. You understand operational context, keep track of design deliverables, and step in to help your team navigate blockers, balance priorities, and refine their execution flow.

You combine empowering leadership with high standards for design craft. Whether coaching UX designers in deep problem framing, driving service design initiatives, or actively managing performance, you raise the bar for how design decisions are made across the company. You will be an integral part of the Product & Tech Leadership Team, working within a collaborative product-tech-design triad operating model.

Key Responsibilities

People, Leadership & Culture

    

Lead, mentor and coach a team of 3 UX designers, setting high standards for craft, feedback, and continuous learning.

    

Provide direction and clear guidance through regular feedback, development talks, and career progression planning.

    

Cultivate an inclusive, safe team culture with high psychological safety where innovation and craft excellence go hand in hand.

    

Manage performance, individual growth plans, and seniority adjustments in line with company frameworks.

Service Design & Cross-Functional Facilitation

    

Lead service design initiatives and facilitate cross-departmental discovery workshops to uncover root problems rather than build feature requests.

    

Partner closely with key non-design stakeholders (such as call agent managers and operations) to convert complex operational friction into intuitive software solutions.

    

Act as an operational bridge between teams, stakeholders, and departments to resolve friction and align user needs with business value.

Design Strategy & System Leadership

    

Articulate the strategic value of a design system, leading its evolution, governance, and adoption to ensure consistency, speed, and quality across all digital touchpoints.

    

Champion user research and structured frameworks (such as the Double Diamond), compiling research into compelling narratives that articulate the "why" to secure organizational buy-in.

    

Collaborate within the Product-Tech-Design Leadership Team, partnering with Lead Product Managers and Engineering leads to align user needs with technical feasibility and business goals.

    

Explore and integrate modern workflows and AI-driven tools across design, prototyping, and front-end collaboration to accelerate discovery, iteration, and delivery.

About you

    

Experienced Design Leader: You bring at least 10 years of experience in digital product design, with at least 3 years of direct people management experience leading UX or Product Designers.

    

Master of Design Craft & Service Design: You have deep expertise in service design methodologies, end-to-end journey mapping, usability research, and modern frameworks like the Double Diamond.

    

Operational & Present: You stay close to the design flow, understand sprint dynamics, and support your team through both high performance and performance management needs.

    

Systemic & Strategic Thinker: You look beyond quick feature fixes to understand the broader ecosystem, articulating the strategic value of design systems and scalable user experiences.

    

Decisive & Compelling Communicator: You turn complexity into clarity, confidently navigating stakeholder discussions and inspiring teams through research-backed storytelling.

Ready to join us?

If you are a design leader who cares deeply about strategy, modern service design, and empowering high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you. Apply today with your CV or LinkedIn profile.

About the recruitment process

As part of our recruitment process, we may use psychometric testing through HI Assessments. We also perform a mandatory background check on all final candidates. We will always inform you as a candidate before the check is carried out.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Sales development
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated full-time sales professional to join our commercial team. In this role, you will work with the CamReach platform, run outbound campaigns, follow up with prospects by phone, and support the development of our commercial pipeline.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role with a strong focus on outbound calling, but you will not be working alone. You will have a support structure around you with pre-sales research, target selection, prospect data, campaign messaging, and the CamReach platform helping you prepare for and follow up each conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound cold calls to selected Nordic SMB prospects based on structured pre-sales research and qualification

  • Follow up on prospects already engaged through CamReach campaigns across email and LinkedIn

  • Work from prepared target lists, company research, contact data, campaign messaging, and call support provided by the wider sales operation

  • Use the CamReach platform to understand prospect activity, engagement, and relevant context before and after calls

  • Qualify interest, identify sales opportunities, and move relevant prospects into the next stage of the sales process

  • Maintain accurate CRM and campaign records, including call outcomes, follow-up actions, and prospect feedback

  • Work closely with the sales team to continuously improve targeting, messaging, call scripts, and campaign performance

Mindset & Work Style

  • Self-managed and target-driven, and comfortable taking responsibility for your own activity and results

  • Comfortable working in an early-stage company where processes continue to evolve

  • Confident speaking with new prospects and starting commercial conversations

  • Professional and comfortable using LinkedIn as part of the sales process

  • Commercially minded and interested in understanding how different businesses sell and acquire customers

  • Willing to learn, test different approaches, and use feedback to improve

Skills

  • Fluency in Norwegian or one of the Scandinavian languages is a must

  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence on the phone

  • Ability to independently research, understand, and qualify prospects

  • Ability to communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different companies and decision-makers

  • Comfortable using CRM systems, sales platforms, and digital tools

  • Confident handling objections and progressing conversations towards a meeting or next step

Experience

  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or a similar commercial role

  • Experience with outbound calling and prospecting

  • Experience with cold outreach across channels such as phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • A track record of working towards activity, pipeline, or sales targets


Perks and benefits

  • Full-time position

  • Flexible working hours

  • Remote work allowed

  • Office location near public transport

  • Opportunity to grow with an early-stage technology company and take on increasing responsibility as the team expands

Working at CamReach AS

CamReach is a B2B sales platform built around three core capabilities: Discover. Qualify. Engage.

The platform helps companies identify the right prospects, qualify which opportunities are worth pursuing, and engage them through coordinated outreach across channels such as email and LinkedIn. The aim is to give sales teams a more structured and effective way to build pipeline, with better data, better preparation, and more relevant outreach.

CamReach comes from a strong software development and technology background. The platform has been developed by a team of experienced developers, data analysts, and data scientists with deep experience in building digital products, data-driven systems, and business applications.

The wider team combines this technical capability with senior commercial and executive experience across technology, international business development, sales, and company building. This means we approach the product from both sides: how the technology should work, and how it needs to perform in a real commercial environment.

We are an early-stage Norwegian technology company with paying customers and an active commercial pipeline. We also have an ambitious product and growth roadmap ahead of us, with plans to expand both the capabilities of the platform and the markets we serve.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at an early stage, grow with the team, take on increasing responsibility, and be part of building the commercial side of a technology company with significant ambitions for the years ahead.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

CamReach is a B2B outbound sales platform built for Nordic and European SMBs. We help sales teams find the right prospects, run multichannel outreach across email and LinkedIn, and book more meetings, without adding headcount or relying on expensive agencies. The platform is built around a simple idea: precision beats volume. Instead of blasting thousands of generic messages, CamReach helps companies identify the right targets, craft relevant outreach, and learn from every campaign to get sharper over time. We are an early-stage Norwegian startup with paying customers, an active pipeline, and a team that moves fast. GDPR compliance is built into the core of what we do, which matters increasingly for companies selling into European markets. We are now expanding our go-to-market engine and looking for driven people to join the team.

jobs.title: PhD position in cancer chromatin biology
jobs.description:
About the position

Applications are invited to apply for a 100% 3-year PhD position in cancer chromatin and structural biology in the research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, project group of Dr. Marie Rogne, at the Department of Molecular Medicine, Division of Biochemistry, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is funded through the Norwegian Research Council. The successful candidate will collaborate with partners at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU).

Within the Institute, the Division of Biochemistry consists of a young and active community of nine research groups working on cancer biology, chromatin and nuclear dynamics, nuclear architecture, membrane trafficking, and adipocyte, muscle and vascular biology, using human, fly and mouse models. 


More about the position

The overall goal of the project is to establish knowledge of the innovative therapeutic potential of microproteins in advanced prostate cancer. In this context, the successful applicant will, in collaboration with the rest of the team and external partners, examine how specific microproteins regulate the activity of the transcription factor SOX2 using cell-based and epigenomic assays, and resolve the SOX2 microprotein complex using a crystallographic approach.

To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow, admission to the Medical Faculty's PhD program is required, or there must be a binding agreement for admission. Normally, one must apply for admission within 3 months after the start of the research project leading to the Ph.D. degree. The PhD fellow is expected to complete the project within three years.


Responsibilities
  • Plan and execute experiments in genomics (RNA‑seq/ATAC‑seq/ChIP‑seq), proteomics and recombinant protein expression/purification.
  • Design and perform cellular assays.
  • Maintain accurate electronic lab records, analyze and interpret data.
  • Present results at group meetings and scientific platforms, and contribute to manuscript writing.
  • Take the required doctoral coursework.

Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • To be admitted to the PhD programmes at the University of Oslo, an applicant must have a five year master's degree or equivalent studies in molecular biology, epigenetics or a related field, minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent.
  • Experience in cell and molecular biology, including vector design, cloning, engineering cell lines, cell-based assays
  • Knowledge and experience in chromatin, transcriptional regulation or microproteins.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience in proteomics (wet-lab and data analysis) will be a strong advantage. 
  • Some background in bioinformatics analysis of epigenetic data (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, etc) is a plus.
  • Experience with electronic lab-journal systems (e.g. Benchling or E-lab) is valued.
  • Previous publishing experience is positive. 

Personal skills
  • You are independent but enjoy working as part of a team towards shared, ambitious goals.
  • You are positive, structured, solution-driven and accurate, with grit and determination.
  • You have a result-oriented mindset and contribute scientific and practical inputs to projects.
  • You are eager to learn and develop your scientific thinking.
  • Communication with other team members is important: you will therefore have excellent communication and collaborative skills. 

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues - could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550.800 to 607.500, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • If the person appointed does not have skills in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish at level A2 at the time of employment, we will offer Norwegian language courses with the aim of achieving Norwegian language skills at least this level.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities. 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter statement of your research interests and motivation for the position
  • CV summarizing education, positions, and academic work 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only)
  • Copy of relevant certification(s) for laboratory animal work, if this applies
  • List of publications and academic works; do not include the publications themselves or your dissertation.
