jobs.title: Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

A temporary position as Researcher in mathematical modelling of hub molecules is available within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) network HubMOL. The position is for a period of two years and three months. It will be affiliated with the Bioinformatics and Systems Biology Group at The Department of Arctic and Marine Biology at UiT. The candidate will be enrolled in the Ph.D. program at the faculty. The research project will be on mathematical modelling approaches targeting mitochondrial metabolism of hub molecules with focus on metabolic flux analysis.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. 


The position's field of Research

The main task of the project will be the reconstruction of models of mitochondrial biochemistry with strong focus on transport and dynamics of hub molecules and related post translational modifications and the development of new approaches for metabolic flux analyses to unravel the impact of changes in hub molecules on protein modification dynamics. 


Qualifications

Marie Skłodowska-Curie (MSCA-DN) education program enrollment requirements:

  • The candidate must not have completed a PhD. 
  • The candidate must not have lived, studied or worked for more than12 months in Norway within the last 36 months. 
  • The candidate should describe his/her motivation to join the project and how his/her prior experience will help to develop the project.
  • The position requires to spend several month in other research institutions within the network. 

Required qualifications: 

  • Successfully completed a master in biochemistry, biophysics, or mathematical biology or similar qualification.
  • Strong background in mathematics as well as programming experience in Python.
  • Good understanding of biochemistry.
  • Documented good written and oral  proficiency in English language.
  • We are looking for a colleague with excellent cooperation skills, and a positive attitude towards collaborative research, education and outreach. The successful candidate must have ambitions for a Ph.D. and be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

Additional desirable qualifications, knowledge and experience: 

  • experience in the use of advanced AI models
  • working experience in mathematical modelling of biological pathways beyond the master, especially metabolic flux analysis - 
  • experience in the interpretation of metabolomics mass spectrometry data

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Application

The applicants may be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants'
qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position. The application must include the following:

  • Cover letter including a description of interests, motivation and reasons for applying for the position.
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work. 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all relevant degrees, in original language and translated). 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable.
  • Two references with contact details. 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important.
  • Documentation of English proficiency. Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 
    • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
    • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
    • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
    • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
    • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 
    • Or, by using alternatives listed here.

All of the documentation in the application has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no. The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations.


We offer
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good career opportunities
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund

The remuneration for Researcher is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1108, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 540.000,- to 590.000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases a higher salary might be considered. As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes availiable. For more information see: spk.no.

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics. The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: Automasjonsingeniør
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

På grunn av økende oppdragsmengde, er vi på jakt etter deg som har erfaring med design av elektriske systemer, styresystemer og programmering/igangkjøring av styresystemer (PLS).

De fleste arbeidsoppgaver utfører vi fra kontorsted. Nordkontakt har kunder over hele landet, så noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk, igangkjøring nye anlegg og serviceoppdrag må påregnes.

Vi har kontorsted i Bodø, men kan også vurdere andre lokasjoner om rette søker dukker opp.

Automasjonsavdelingen vår har i dag 40 ansatte, med en god bredde med tanke på bakgrunn og grunnutdanning. Her kan nevnes ingeniørutdanning/bachelor og master innen automasjon/cybernetikk, elkraft, mekatronikk og datateknikk. I tillegg har flere fagbrev som automatiker, elektriker, maskinist, kjølemontør og lignende som basis før høyere utdanning. En herlig blanding som gjør at vi sammen finner gode løsninger i et bredt spekter av oppdrag. Nordkontakt har som mål å være blant de fremste i bransjen på å teste ut og utvikle nye tekniske løsninger.


Som ingeniør i Nordkontakt

 Får du :

  • Jobbe med spennende kunder
  • Utvikle deg faglig i et sterkt teknisk miljø
  • Være med å teste ut nye systemer og tekniske løsninger
  • Ta et tydelig teknisk ansvar i prosjekter
  • Et spennende fagmiljø innen moderne og avanserte automasjonssystemer
  • Bred teknisk eksponering fra design til ferdig anlegg
  • Et kompetent og uformelt fagmiljø
  • Reell påvirkningsmulighet
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig
  • Korte beslutningsveier og høy grad av tillit

Arbeidsoppgaver

• Prosjektering automasjonsanlegg.

• Programmering styresystemer og sikkerhetssystemer

• Konfigurering/programmering/design HMI og driftskontrollanlegg. Alarmhåndtering, datalogg og rapportering. 

• FAT- og SAT-prosesser - igangsetting nye anlegg

• Dokumentasjon 

• Serviceprosjekter - feilsøking, vedlikehold og ombygging eksisterende anlegg

• Oppsett servere/nettverksutstyr for automasjonsanlegg og driftskontroll

Avhengig av din kunnskap og erfaring, kan det også være aktuelt med arbeidsoppgaver/støttefunksjon opp mot andre funksjoner og fagfelt i bedriften. Våre leveransen stiller store krav til både IT- og OT sikkerhet.


Kvalifikasjoner

Vi søker deg som har :

Bachelor eller Master innen automasjon, kybernetikk, elektro eller tilsvarende. 

Du kan også ha teknisk fagskole innen elektro/automasjon.

Kan vise til arbeidserfaring fra lignende type arbeid.


Vi ser etter deg som
  • Er systematisk og strukturert.
  • Har lyst å jobbe direkte mot kunder.
  • Er faglig trygg og kunne jobbe selvstendig under tidspress.
  • Har god skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne.
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk skriftlig/muntlig.
  • Har mulighet for noe reisevirksomhet ifm. kundebesøk og igangkjøring av anlegg.
  • Har arbeidserfaring med lignende type arbeid.

Gode grunner til å jobbe i Nordkontakt

Gode grunner til å jobbe hos oss

Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med utfordrende arbeid i en bedrift i vekst. Foruten et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og en stor dose godt humør kan vi også tilby:

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med god spredning i alder og kompetanse
  • Stor påvirkningskraft over din egen arbeidshverdag
  • Å delta på våre gøye sosiale tiltak
  • Treningsavtaler
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
  • En attraktiv bonusavtale

Vår viktigste kapital er våre medarbeidere! Vi setter derfor utvikling og kompetanseheving hos våre ansatte veldig høyt. Det forvalter vi som best vi kan i opplæringsplattformen vår Elektroakademiet. Les mer om hvordan vi legger til rette for at medarbeiderne våre kan søke ny- eller friske opp sin kunnskap via denne linken.


Vi trenger flere kvinner!

Vi og resten av Elektrogruppen anser mangfold som en styrke, og oppfordrer derfor spesielt kvinner til å søke. Les mer om våre målsettinger og hvordan vi arbeider med å styrke mangfoldet i vår likestillingsredegjørelse.


Vi tar bærekraft på alvor

For oss er bærekraft en del av alt vi gjør. Vi utvikler løsninger som reduserer utslipp og fremmer energieffektivitet, samtidig som vi skaper trygge og gode arbeidsplasser for våre ansatte. Les mer i vår bærekraftsrapport.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordkontakt er en ingeniørbedrift med 105 ansatte som jobber med automasjon, tavleproduksjon, digitalisering, informasjonsteknologi og elektro. Vi har hovedkontor i Bodø, avdelingskontor i Ørsta/Volda og er ledende innfor våre områder med en historikk tilbake til1966.

Vi er i dag en betydelig aktør innenfor automatisering av landbasert settefisk- og oppdrettsanlegg. Vi har også kunder innen slakteri, vei, jernbane, gruvedrift, forskningsfartøy, fiskebåter, bygg, industri, VA-anlegg og energi. Nordkontakt tilbyr også skybaserte tjenester ifm. SD-anlegg (NK-sky) til våre kunder. 

Vi har en stor IT-avdeling som leverer kameraløsninger samt bistår med OT-sikkerheten til våre kunders anlegg. 

Nordkontakt leverer produkter og tjenester på alle nivå i prosessen, fra enkle komponenter til ferdige idriftsatte anlegg. Vi har flere ulike testverksted tilknyttet våre ulike fag. Og om vi ikke har funnet komponenter som dekker kundenes behov, så har vi faktisk bare utviklet disse selv. 

Vårt verdigrunnlag er tuftet på at vi er en bedrift som opptrer Fremtidsrettet Ansvarlig Løsningsorientert og Kompetent. Vi løser våre oppdrag med målsetting om å skape trygghet for våre kunder, så vel som våre medarbeidere og samfunnet vi er en del av, og i Nordkontakt, holder vi det vi lover!

Vi er en del av konsernet Elektrogruppen, en av landets største private tekniske entreprenører med virksomhet fra Trøndelag i sør til Vesterålen i nord.  Samlet er nesten 700 ansatte, fordelt på 15 entreprenører. Effektivt tverrfaglig samarbeid og erfaringsutveksling bedriftene imellom gir positive effekter for våre kunder lokalt.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller - regnskap og rapportering - Osland AS
jobs.description:
Osland-konsernet er et av landets eldste akvakulturselskaper, med virksomhet innen genetikk, settefisk og matfiskproduksjon. Vi søker nå en erfaren Senior Financial Controller som vil få en sentral rolle i videreutviklingen av konsernets økonomifunksjon.

 

Rollen er knyttet til Osland AS-delkonsernet, som består av Osland AS og fem datterselskaper, i tillegg til løpende oppfølging av fire produksjonsregnskap. Dette gir et bredt og komplekst økonomisk landskap med behov for god forståelse av sammenhengen mellom selskapsregnskap, produksjon, rapportering og styringsinformasjon. Dette er en bred seniorrolle for deg som har solid regnskapsforståelse, liker å skape struktur og kvalitet, og samtidig motiveres av utvikling, systemer og smartere arbeidsprosesser.

 

Du vil arbeide tett med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller og regnskapsførerne, og få en viktig rolle i å sikre kvalitet i regnskap og rapportering på tvers av selskaper og produksjonsområder.

 

Stillingen spenner fra operative og regnskapsnære oppgaver til rapportering, budsjett, internkontroll, systemutvikling og forbedring av økonomiprosesser. Vi ser derfor etter en erfaren person som trives med bredde og variasjon, og som er komfortabel med at prioriteringene kan variere gjennom året.

Om rollen

Som Senior Financial Controller vil du være en sentral fagressurs i økonomiteamet og bidra til at regnskap, tallgrunnlag og rapportering holder høy kvalitet. Du vil arbeide tett med regnskapsførerne og Business Controller i den månedlige lukkingen av regnskapene, og bidra til gode rutiner, avstemminger, periodiseringer og regnskapsmessige vurderinger. Samtidig vil du ha en viktig rolle innen konsolidering, rapportering, budsjett og prognoser, og være med på å videreutvikle konsernets økonomiske styringsinformasjon.

 

En viktig del av rollen er også løpende arbeid med å styrke internkontroll og strukturkapital. Det innebærer å bidra til tydelige rutiner, dokumenterte arbeidsprosesser, god ansvarsdeling og etterlevelse av etablerte prinsipper og kontrollaktiviteter. Vi arbeider tett med robuste prosesser som er forståelige, etterleves i organisasjonen og er mindre personavhengige.

 

Du vil også bidra til å utvikle måten vi arbeider på gjennom bedre utnyttelse av ERP-system, rapporteringsløsninger, data og automatisering.

 

Rollen passer godt for deg som liker kombinasjonen av regnskap, kvalitet, internkontroll, systemforståelse og utvikling. Dette er en seniorrolle som krever at du arbeider selvstendig, tar eierskap til dine ansvarsområder og selv ser hvor det er behov for oppfølging eller forbedring. Vi ser etter en person som tar initiativ, driver saker fremover og bidrar der behovet er størst.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Delta aktivt i månedlig regnskapsavslutning for selskapene og sikre god kvalitet og fremdrift i closingprosessen
  • Kvalitetssikre regnskap, avstemminger, periodiseringer og vesentlige regnskapsmessige vurderinger
  • Bidra til konsolidering og konsernrapportering
  • Kvalitetssikre og videreutvikle månedlig rapportering og styringsinformasjon
  • Ha en sentral rolle i omfattende budsjett- og prognoseprosesser
  • Følge opp balanse, arbeidskapital, kontantstrøm og grunnlag for likviditetsprognoser
  • Følge opp internprising, internfakturering og konserninterne avregninger
  • Arbeide med verdsettelse og kontroll av beholdning og varelager
  • Delta sentralt i årsoppgjør og revisjon
  • Videreutvikle internkontroll, rutiner, dokumentasjon og kontrollaktiviteter
  • Bidra til at etablerte rutiner, fullmakter og prosesser etterleves i organisasjonen
  • Bygge og vedlikeholde strukturkapital gjennom tydelige arbeidsprosesser, ansvarsdeling og dokumentasjon
  • Redusere personavhengighet og bidra til robuste og skalerbare økonomiprosesser
  • Bidra til videreutvikling og bedre utnyttelse av ERP- og rapporteringssystemer
  • Identifisere muligheter for standardisering, automatisering og effektivisering
  • Bidra i økonomirelaterte utviklingsprosjekter på tvers av konsernet
  • Være en faglig sparringspartner for kollegaer i økonomiteamet
Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en erfaren og faglig trygg økonom som liker å ta ansvar for at tallene er riktige og prosessene fungerer godt.

 

Du er strukturert og nøyaktig, men samtidig pragmatisk og løsningsorientert. Du evner å gå ned i detaljene når det er nødvendig, samtidig som du ser helheten og forstår hvordan selskapsregnskap, produksjon, systemer, internkontroll og rapportering henger sammen.

 

Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:

  • liker en variert arbeidshverdag og et bredt ansvarsområde
  • er selvstendig, initiativrik og komfortabel med å ta faglig ansvar
  • er fleksibel og håndterer både faste prosesser og problemstillinger som oppstår underveis
  • tar eierskap, jobber åpent og følger opp oppgaver til de er løst
  • ser forbedringsbehov og tar initiativ uten å være avhengig av detaljerte bestillinger
  • liker å skape struktur og sikre at avtalte arbeidsmetoder faktisk etterleves
  • har forståelse for betydningen av gode rutiner, dokumentasjon og internkontroll
  • er opptatt av å bygge robuste prosesser som ikke er avhengige av enkeltpersoner
  • er nysgjerrig på systemer og hvordan teknologi kan brukes til å forenkle og forbedre økonomiarbeidet
  • liker kombinasjonen av operative oppgaver og mer langsiktig utviklingsarbeid

Vi ser ikke etter en person som kun ønsker å arbeide med én avgrenset del av økonomifaget. Stillingen har stor bredde og krever at du både kan gå ned i detaljene og løfte blikket, samt bidra der behovet til enhver tid er størst.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Høyere utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap, revisjon eller tilsvarende
  • Flere års relevant erfaring fra regnskap, revisjon, controlling eller finansiell rapportering
  • Solid regnskapsforståelse og erfaring med måneds- og årsavslutning
  • God forståelse for resultat, balanse og kontantstrøm
  • God systemforståelse og erfaring med ERP- og rapporteringssystemer, samt interesse for videre læring
  • Gode Excel-kunnskaper
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk

Erfaring med konsernregnskap, budsjett og prognose, varelagervurdering, revisjon, internkontroll, Xledger, One Stop Reporting, Power BI, Power Query eller automatisering er en fordel.

 

Det viktigste er at du har et solid faglig fundament, tilstrekkelig erfaring til å ta et selvstendig faglig ansvar og et ønske om å bidra til å bygge en stadig bedre og mer robust økonomifunksjon.

Vi tilbyr
  • En sentral seniorrolle i økonomifunksjonen i et norsk havbrukskonsern
  • Et bredt ansvarsområde på tvers av selskaper, produksjonsområder og økonomiprosesser
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og påvirkningsmulighet
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hvordan økonomiprosesser, internkontroll, systemer og rapportering videreutvikles
  • En sentral rolle i å bygge robuste arbeidsprosesser og strukturkapital i organisasjonen
  • Tett samarbeid med økonomisjef/CFO, Business Controller, regnskapsførere og ledere i konsernet
  • Moderne systemer og gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Mulighet til å kombinere regnskapsfaglig arbeid med system- og prosessutvikling
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Arbeidssted: Sandviken, Bergen

  • Hjemmekontor: Delvis, etter avtale

     

Har du spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte vår rekrutteringsrådgiver i Lederhuset AS, Bjarne Jacobsen.

jobs.title: Kokk eller kokekyndig lettmatros
jobs.description:
Er du kokk, men vil jobbe mer med tekniske oppgaver? Eller er du lettmatros og skikkelig flink til å lage mat?

Til vår minste LNG tanker med fartsområde norskekysten og Skottland, ser vi nå etter en kokk/kokekyndig lettmatros i fast stilling i 4/4 rotasjon. jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation.

This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues.

Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down.

Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed.

Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries.

Your main responsibilities

  • Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants.

  • Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help.

  • Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals.

  • Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria.

  • Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team.

  • Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap.

  • Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time.

  • Travel to plants and conferences, around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product.

What a great fit looks like

  • Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry, such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar.

  • Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation, presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years.

  • Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem.

  • Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations.

  • Willingness to travel regularly.

You’ll excel if

  • You build trust easily. You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities.

  • You’d rather diagnose than pitch. Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck.

  • You thrive in dynamic environments. Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work.

  • You have experience working in heavy industry, particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar.

Success in This Role Means

  • Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities.

  • Deployments are set up to succeed. We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live.

  • Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems.

  • Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer. Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time.

    💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

    We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

    We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process

  1. Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role.

  2. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our VP of Sales and discuss if this role is a good fit for you.

  3. Technical Onsite (completed on the same day):

    1. Technical interview

    2. Data analysis & presentation

  4. Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other.

  5. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

jobs.title: Commercial Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Customers trust us when things go wrong. We're the software reliability platform built to investigate, respond to and prevent incidents. As a Commercial CSM, you're the partner to our mid-market engineering teams - getting them onboarded, embedded and expanding their usage, and maturing their incident management and reliability as they grow.

What that looks like day to day

Our Customer Success organisation is at the heart of incident.io. We're the team closest to our customers' hardest problems, and we're trusted to solve them. We believe in a customer-led product approach, working hand in hand with Product to uncover and address what each customer really needs. Our goal goes beyond satisfaction: we want to delight customers at every stage of their journey, and build long-term relationships grounded in trust, shared success and mutual growth.

You'll look after 70–80 Commercial customers: growth-oriented tech companies, mostly under 1,000 people, between $30k and $150k ARR each. Industry leaders like Vanta, Monday.com and Loom sit in this segment. Some are steady, some are scaling fast, and much of the job is knowing which is which, and what each one needs from you.

Most of your time goes to mid-market customers on our top-tier plan, where you're their dedicated CSM leading onboarding and adoption. You'll blend 1:1 time with scalable programmes to get teams to value quickly: best-practice sessions, end-user training, partnership and roadmap reviews. You'll also cover a subset of smaller customers in a low-touch capacity, leaning on usage data to spot risk and opportunity early.

Day to day, this is a high ownership role. You'll help customers navigate the product, unpick problems when they hit them, and keep everyone pointed at the outcomes their team actually cares about. You are responsible for proactively identifying expansion and upsell opportunities, and partnering with Sales and Expansion Account Managers to grow revenue within your accounts. Internally, you're the voice of the Commercial customer with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Support.

There's still a lot to build and a ton of opportunity for you to shape this segment. The Commercial motion works, but scaling and automating the customer journey is live work we're ramping up now - refining playbooks, automating the repeatable stuff, building the tooling and content that makes a portfolio this size easier to serve. We're AI-forward in how we approach it, so you'd be shaping this rather than inheriting it.

Who you are

  • You've carried a book of 40 to 100+ accounts and worked out how to be present across all of them without going quiet on half.

  • You've sold to, or supported, technical people, whether that's engineering teams, on-call rotations or developer tools. You can hold your own in a technical conversation without needing to escalate every one of them.

  • You've got commercial instincts. You spot the account that's about to double, you know what a growth signal looks like, and you know how to steer a renewal to a good outcome.

  • You know what scaled CS looks like when it's done well. Playbooks, one-to-many programs, AI-assisted workflows. You don't need to have built them from scratch, but you've worked around them enough to have opinions on what you'd do differently.

  • Half-built process doesn't rattle you. You'd rather fix the documentation than complain about it.

  • You actually like being in a room with customers, and you'll get on a plane for the right one.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £75K – £100K • Offers Commission

  • London • £75K – £100K • Offers Commission

About the position 

The UiO Green Office is looking for a student employee to help strengthen sustainability engagement across student life, education, and research at the University of Oslo.

This position is part of two of our working groups; Education & Research and Dissemination & Dialogue work. They work to connect students, student organizations and researchers to strengthen sustainability engagement at UiO.


Qualifications

Previous experience or education related to organizational work or education is an advantage. You must be enrolled as a UiO student throughout 2026 and 2027

Key responsibilities and tasks include:

  • Collaborating with the Student Parliament, student organizations and other sustainability initiatives.
  • Promoting sustainability-related education and research at UiO
  • Contributing to larger events such as the SDG conference, theme weeks and national and international Green Office networks
  • Supporting projects that connect students, faculties, and researchers

Personal skills

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has an interest in sustainability education and research and student engagement
  • Can work independently and take responsibility for projects
  • Enjoys working collaboratively in a team

  • Has strong organizational skills

    It is an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Student organizations, politics (i.e. program committee), volunteer work, or project coordination.
  • Event planning, communication, or outreach activities

We offer 
  • A 20-30% position (depending on your capacity) 
  • Salary NOK 425 000 - per year for a full-time position (pro-rated for 20–30%).
  • Practical experience with sustainability projects and collaboration across the university
  • Practical experience in sustainability and project development
  • An engaging, creative, and supportive work environment
  • Opportunities to shape sustainability initiatives at UiO
  • Valuable experience in teamwork, leadership, and stakeholder collaboration

Inclusive worklife and diversity at UiO

Inclusion and diversity are a strength. The University of Oslo has a personnel policy objective of achieving a balanced gender composition. Furthermore, we want employees with diverse professional expertise, life experience and perspectives.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, employment gaps or immigrant background, we will invite at least one applicant from each of these categories to an interview.

We hope that you will apply for the position. 


How to apply

Please submit:

  • A CV
  • A short motivation letter (approximately one page)
  • A reference person (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number) is positive, but not a requirement. 

In your motivation letter, we would like you to reflect briefly on:

  • Why would you like to work at the Green Office?
  • How would you engage students and student organizations in sustainability work at UiO?
  • What experience, skills, or interests would you bring to this role?
  • Describe an initiative, project, or collaboration that you are proud of contributing to.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Green Office is UiO's student-driven hub for sustainability initiatives (Green Office - University of Oslo).. We develop projects, events, and collaborations that help make the university more sustainable while creating opportunities for students to get involved. Our team is organized into four working groups that reflect the themes of UiO's Climate and Environmental Strategy (Comprehensive Climate and Environmental Strategy - University of Oslo).

jobs.title: Junior Account Executive
jobs.description:
Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries successfully complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centers, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority


Essential skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent

  • Excellent written and verbal proficiency in English

  • Experience and/or interest in sales or a client-facing role

  • Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

  • Strong presentation skills (both in-person and online)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  • Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

 

Preferred experience:

  • Experience and/or interest in Financial, Professional, Legal or Technology services

  • Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

  • Experience in a B2B sales/business development role

Sounds like a match? We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

The main focus of the role is to utilise your existing knowledge and experience within the Financial Services sector to develop new business relationships and new accounts via a direct sales approach.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in the local language

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C# .NET) | London
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our global team to be responsible for the quality, development, and execution of our software products.

You will be part of a technology department that is comprised of a successful and multidisciplinary group of professionals located across the globe – Barcelona, New York, London, Manchester, Bucharest and India. If you’re ready to join a growing company and make an immediate impact, we want to hear from you!

You will be joining at TransPerfect – TechOps:

The TransPerfect TechOps team has been a vital part of the company’s success since its formation over 10 years ago – delivering technology and services that have drastically simplified the lives of our clients and colleagues – from workflow improvements for colleagues to core services that form the basis of the company’s GlobalLink platform, to creating scalable client interfaces that allow novice users to navigate complex ecosystems.


Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Engage in all phases of application development, with a focus on coding and debugging in alignment with security standards throughout the entire lifecycle

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code/APIs to support applications both for web and mobile

  • Collaborate regularly in a cross-functional team made up of product managers, quality assurance teams, designers and other developers to translate business requirements into technical solutions

  • Collaborate with Front-end developers to integrate user-facing elements with server-side logic

  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address issues

  • Optimize web applications for performance, scalability and security

  • Implement security best practices to safeguard sensitive data and protect against potential threats

  • Develop automation tests/ collaborate with automation engineers to ensure business needs are met, and allow for regression testing

  • Work closely with users to provide personalized software support as needed

  • Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our backend infrastructure

  • Document application support and operational procedures

  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to foster their growth and development

The minimum we’re looking for (show us what you got if you aren’t a perfect fit):

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or related field

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on building scalable and reliable systems

  • Extensive knowledge of DotNet C#, LINQ, MS SQL, Entity Framework and related technologies

  • Capable to use version control software such as GIT

  • Knowledge of SOLID principles

  • Knowledge of clean code practices

  • Experience using web service protocols such as Rest, API design for extensibility and integration

  • Experience debugging complex applications

  • Experience with Agile development project management methodologies

  • Database Development in SQL Server or NoSQL Databases

  • Some familiarity of Docker

  • Experience debugging complex applications

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with a proven ability to work effectively in a team environment

  • Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ and Quartz experience is a plus

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni

Upratujete kuchyňu a zabezpečujete, že je vždy pripravená na ďalšie varenie. Dodržiavate hygienické a bezpečnostné predpisy (HACCP), takže sa naučíte, ako sa starať o bezpečnosť potravín. Po riadnom zaškolení sa samostatne staráte o prípravu raňajok, čo vám dáva možnosť ukázať svoje zručnosti. V prípade potreby a po zaučení zastupujete šéfkuchára. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

At least two years of experience in HR administration, recruitment, or an HR generalist role.
Understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining personnel records.
Basic knowledge of Slovak employment legislation and administrative requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage several priorities and work independently.
Confident use of Excel, Google Sheets, and standard office applications.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Experience in an international or IT company.
Experience with HRIS or applicant-tracking systems.
Familiarity with immigration, relocation, and work-permit processes.
Experience working with contractors and external service providers.

jobs.description:
In this role, you will
Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.
Implement network changes related to customer services and internal infrastructure.
Configure VLANs, physical and logical interfaces, link aggregation, and other network services.
Prepare technical tasks for on-site engineers installing, replacing, or reconnecting equipment.
Coordinate planned maintenance and infrastructure work with data-centre representatives.
Verify completed work and confirm that network services operate correctly after changes.
Handle provisioning requests from internal teams and customers.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and configuration issues related to provisioning activities.
Escalate complex incidents and technical risks to Network Engineering or Network Operations.
Communicate with carriers, data centres, and other service providers regarding technical matters.
Participate in projects involving network expansion, new data-centre locations, and equipment deployment.
Maintain network documentation, equipment records, configuration templates, and internal instructions.
Contribute to the automation and standardization of routine provisioning processes.

At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Practical knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

jobs.title: Dentist
Product Manager, Healthcare (H/F)
jobs.description:
Withings est une entreprise française pionnière de la santé connectée. Depuis 2008, nous concevons des produits et services qui permettent à chacun de mieux comprendre sa santé et aux professionnels de santé de mieux accompagner leurs patients.

Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin.

Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux.

Vos responsabilités

  • Comprendre les besoins des patients, médecins et équipes de soin et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.
  • Concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Healthcare, en particulier autour du Remote Patient Monitoring et du suivi des maladies chroniques.
  • Développer des outils permettant aux professionnels de santé de mieux exploiter les données Withings, de gagner du temps et d'améliorer la qualité du suivi patient.
  • Imaginer des parcours patients favorisant l'engagement, l'éducation thérapeutique et l'adoption de comportements favorables à leur santé.
  • Définir la vision produit, les priorités et la roadmap en collaboration avec les équipes Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
  • Définir et suivre les KPI permettant de mesurer l'utilisation et l'impact réel des fonctionnalités développées.
  • Étudier le marché, les usages et les évolutions du secteur de la santé digitale afin d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
  • Transformer rapidement des idées en prototypes afin de les confronter aux utilisateurs avant d'investir dans leur développement.

Nous recherchons un profil capable d'aller au-delà de la définition fonctionnelle d'un produit.

Les outils d'IA générative transforment profondément la manière de construire des produits. Nous attendons du Product Manager qu'il sache les utiliser pour accélérer son travail : explorer une idée, analyser des données, créer un prototype fonctionnel, automatiser certaines tâches ou tester une expérience utilisateur.

L'objectif n'est pas seulement de produire des spécifications mais d'être capable de rendre rapidement une idée tangible, afin de mieux collaborer avec les utilisateurs, les designers et les ingénieurs.

Requirements

Profil recherché

  • Formation Bac+5, idéalement école d'ingénieur ou formation scientifique/technique équivalente.
  • Environ 3 ans d'expérience ou plus, idéalement dans un environnement produit ou technologique exigeant.
  • Solide culture technique et réelle envie de comprendre comment les produits fonctionnent.
  • Forte sensibilité produit et design : capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à concevoir des expériences intuitives.
  • Maîtrise des outils d'IA générative, notamment pour créer rapidement des prototypes, développer des fonctionnalités ou automatiser certaines tâches.
  • Capacité à prototyper et à manipuler des outils techniques ; savoir coder ou avoir déjà développé des projets personnels est un vrai plus.
  • Intérêt marqué pour la santé, la médecine, la santé digitale et les nouvelles technologies.
  • Forte capacité analytique et aptitude à utiliser la donnée pour prendre des décisions produit.
  • Excellente capacité à collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires : Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
  • Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement rapide où de nombreux sujets restent à inventer.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.

Benefits

Rejoindre l'aventure Withings, c'est :

  • Intégrer l'un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronics Show.
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux visant à construire la santé de demain.
  • Travailler dans un environnement international avec des équipes basées notamment à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong et Shenzhen.
  • Participer directement à l'amélioration de nos produits et services, notamment en les testant avant leur lancement.
  • Approfondir ses connaissances médicales grâce à la Withings Med Academy et aux interventions régulières de professionnels de santé.
  • Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, restaurant d'entreprise, avantages culturels et sportifs, et bien plus encore.
  • Et surtout, rejoindre des équipes passionnées qui cherchent à avoir un impact concret sur la manière dont la santé sera suivie et prise en charge demain.

Wij zoeken iemand met technisch en financieel inzicht, die goed kan onderhandelen en altijd oplossingen weet te vinden. Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en speelt proactief in op vragen van de verkoopafdeling en klanten. Je werkt gestructureerd en blijft rustig onder druk. Dus, als je houdt van afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid, dan is dit dé kans voor jou!

- Leuke activiteiten en bijeenkomsten
- Kansen en ontwikkeling richting een stabiele toekomst.

Luister jij met je hart en handel je met zorg, omdat elke bewoner uniek is?

jobs.title: Administratief medewerker met hands-on mentaliteit
jobs.description:
Sticting Mentorschap Limburg voert de wettelijke beschermingsmaatregel mentorschap uit voor volwassenen die hun belangen op het gebied van zorg en welzijn niet zelf kunnen behartigen. Dat doen wij met ruim honderd geschoolde vrijwillige mentoren, verdeeld over acht regio's in de provincie. Op dit moment lopen er circa honderdvijftig mentorschappen. Het bureau van de stichting is klein en bestaat uit twee coördinatoren/consulenten een administratief medewerker en een vrijwillig bestuur.

Wat wij vragen :
MBO-4 met enkele jaren werkervaring in een brede,zelfstandig administratieve functie
of HBO werk- en denkniveau in een administratieve of secretariële richting;
Goede digitale vaardigheid (Office 365, OneDrive); ervaring met een cliëntvolg- of dossiersysteem is een pré;
Zeer goede beheersing van het Nederlands in woord en geschrift;
Een geldige Verklaring omtrent Gedrag ( verplicht voor deze functie );

Een mentor helpt mensen die moeite hebben de regie over hun leven te houden.
Mentorschap is een wettelijke beschermingsmaatregel. De rechtbank benoemt een mentor om mensen te helpen met het nemen van beslissingen over verzorging, verpleging, behandeling en begeleiding.

Onze stichting ondersteunt meer dan 100 vrijwilligers bij het uitvoeren van het mentorschap.
Wij regelen voor deze mentoren opleiding, koppeling aan cliënten, bijscholing en administratieve zaken.

Dit zijn je taken :
Beheer van de algemene mailboxen en de kantoortelefoon(beantwoording van vragen of doorzetten naar de juiste consulent en de opvolging bewaken);
In- en uitgaande post verwerken en archiveren;
Agenda's, vergaderstukken en notulen verzorgen voor het teamoverleg en
het kwartaaloverleg met regio-ondersteuners;
Dossiers aanmaken en bijhouden in clientvolgsysteem (Myneva) en rechtbankportaal (Aigor);
Aanmeldingen van nieuwe mentoren en clienten registreren,bevestigen en doorzetten naar de consulenten en bewaken dat die worden opgevolgd;
Jaarlijkse mentorverslagen en tussentijdse evaluaties uitzetten bij mentoren, voortgang bewaken en tijdig indienen bij de rechtbank;
Opheffing en omzetting van mentorschappen administratief afhandelen inclusief archivering;
Bewaken dat vrijwilligersovereenkomsten, mandateringen en VOG's compleet en actueel zijn;
Praktische organisatie van basiscursussen voor nieuwe mentoren, regio-overleggen en themabijeenkomsten;
Kwartaalnieuwsbrief opmaken, website en social media bijhouden, kantoorvoorraad en bestellingen beheren;

Je werkt zelfstandig en nauwkeurig en houdt zelf het overzicht bij want er is geen leidinggevende die dagelijks meekijkt;
Je bent een procesbewaker want een flink deel van het werk kent termijnen waaraan de stichting wettelijk gehouden is, je laat niet los tot iets daadwerkelijk is afgerond;
In contacten met vrijwilligers, bewindvoerders en zorginstellingen ben je dienstverlenend en geduldig;
Affiniteit met de zorgsector is een pre;

jobs.title: CNC Kanter (Safan)
jobs.description:
Voor een bedrijf in deze regio zijn wij op zoek naar een CNC Kanter (SAFAN).
De werkzaamheden zien er als volgt uit. Je bedient en programmeert ( indien kennis aanwezig) de CNC kantbank. Je levert producten van een goede kwaliteit, werkt volgens instructie en realiseert de gemaakte planning. Verder voer je alle overige taken uit die worden aangegeven door je leidinggevende.
Dit is een functie in een drieploegendienstrooster ploegen dienst.
Het bedrijf ontwikkelt modules en systemen, in kleine tot middelgrote series bouwt en wereldwijd levert aan gerenommeerde ondernemingen. Deze ondernemingen zijn vooral actief op de medische, document processing, semiconductor en industriële markt.


Onze ambitie is samen met u telkens weer de juiste match te vinden. Een goede verstandhouding tussen ons en u als werkgever of werkzoekende is daarbij van groot belang en essentieel voor het duidelijk in beeld krijgen van elkaars wensen en verwachtingen. Daarnaast zullen wij ons uiterste best doen u waar mogelijk te ondersteunen, begeleiden en van de juiste informatie te voorzien. Door intensief contact te onderhouden met beide partijen zijn wij in staat ons te onderscheiden. Een perfecte match begint tenslotte bij het verkrijgen en verstrekken van de juiste informatie zodat wij vervolgens onze deskundigheid hier op toe kunnen passen. Wij zijn op zoek naar partners die dezelfde denkwijze hebben en net als wij gaan voor kwaliteit, openheid en persoonlijke betrokkenheid.
