jobs.title: Vakleerkracht bewegingsonderwijs
jobs.description:
Om bevoegd te zijn voor het geven van gymlessen in het basisonderwijs dien je in het bezit te zijn van een diploma van de Academie voor Lichamelijke Opvoeding (ALO). Daarnaast heb je 3-5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als gymdocent (vereiste) en heb je affiniteit en ervaring met de doelgroep van het speciaal basisonderwijs (pre).

Als Vakleerkracht Bewegingsonderwijs bij Nationaal Bureau Sport Stimulering doe je meer dan alleen lesgeven. Jij laat kinderen van 4 tot en met 12 jaar ervaren hoe leuk bewegen is en zorgt ervoor dat zij met plezier actief zijn. Je weet hoe belangrijk sport en bewegen is voor de motorische, sociale én persoonlijke ontwikkeling van kinderen. Voor de regio Maarssen zoeken wij een ervaren gymdocent (met ervaring in het speciaal onderwijs) die op twee scholen het bewegingsonderwijs verzorgt binnen het (speciaal) basisonderwijs. Je bent hier niet alleen op een enthousiaste manier bezig met het verbeteren van de motorische en sociale kwaliteiten van leerlingen, maar je draagt vanuit jouw rol ook zorg voor de fysieke, mentale en sociale veiligheid van de leerlingen. Je houdt de voortgang van leerlingen bij en stemt dit desgevraagd af met de schooldirectie, leerkrachten en ouders.

Wie zijn wij?
Als nationale sportaanbieder en uitvoerend specialist werken we bij Nationaal Bureau Sport Stimulering aan het stimuleren én professionaliseren van sporten, bewegen en (buiten)spelen. Samen met partners binnen het onderwijs, de kinderopvang, gemeenten en (sport)verenigingen werken we aan een gezonde toekomst. Vanuit drie initiatieven (Sportdocent, Sportivun en NBSS) zorgen wij voor de mogelijkheid om een leven lang actief te zijn.
-Bij Sportdocent focussen wij ons op het vergroten van de kwaliteit én continuïteit van structurele beweegmomenten binnen het onderwijs en in de kinderopvang. We creëren nieuwe beweegmomenten en leveren een bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling en innovaties op het gebied van bewegen.

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
jobs.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

  • Competitive annual salary

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days for more flexibility

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback, wellbeing tools and everyday savings

What will you be doing?

    Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills gained within a manufacturing or FMCG environment

    The ability to influence, develop and support others while taking ownership of performance and results

At KP Snacks, we're passionate about creating happy snacking moments through our great tasting snacks and iconic brands. What is the job?

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.

  • Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.

  • Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.

  • Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.

  • Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.

  • Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.

  • Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.

What do you need?

  • Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.

  • Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.

  • A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.

  • Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.

  • Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Vi ser først og fremst etter en person vi kan stole på og gi ansvar.

Du bør være:

  • Pålitelig og punktlig

  • Selvstendig

  • Detaljorientert

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Løsningsorientert

  • Komfortabel med kundekontakt

  • Glad i en aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Villig til å lære og utvikle deg

  • En person som tar initiativ når noe må gjøres

Hos oss får du mye tillit, og vi ønsker derfor en medarbeider som ser hva som må gjøres og følger opp oppgavene sine uten at alt må detaljstyres.

Krav:

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Må kunne kommunisere på norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Må være komfortabel med å kjøre forskjellige typer biler

Fordel, men ikke krav:

  • Førerkort klasse BE

  • Erfaring fra kundeservice

  • Erfaring med bilpleie eller klargjøring

  • Erfaring fra logistikk, transport eller lignende

Tidligere erfaring fra bilbransjen er ikke nødvendig. For oss er innstilling og arbeidsmåte viktigere enn hvilken bransje du kommer fra.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Klargjøring av biler mellom utleier

  • Innvendig og utvendig vask

  • Polering og annen bilpleie

  • Kontroll av biler før og etter utleie

  • Registrering og oppfølging av skader og andre avvik

  • Kontroll av kilometerstand, drivstoff/lading og generell tilstand

  • Kundebehandling på telefon, digitalt og ved behov fysisk

  • Oppfølging av bookinger og den daglige driften

  • Utlevering og mottak av biler

  • Hjulskift i sesong

  • Henting, levering og transport av biler

  • Andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til driften

Noen dager vil hovedfokuset være klargjøring og bilpleie, mens andre dager vil innebære mer kundebehandling og drift.

Arbeidstiden er i hovedsak mandag til fredag, hovedsakelig på dagtid, med enkelte faste dager hvor arbeidstiden legges til ettermiddag.

  • Fast 100 % stilling

  • Lønn etter avtale / konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • 4 % pensjon

  • Forsikringsordninger

  • Arbeidsklær

  • Ansattrabatt på bilutleie

  • Full opplæring

  • Variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Stor grad av tillit og selvstendighet

  • Muligheter for utvikling og mer ansvar

  • Kort vei fra idé til beslutning

Vest Bilutleie er i rask utvikling, og du kommer inn på et tidspunkt hvor det fortsatt er mulig å påvirke hvordan vi jobber, hvilke rutiner vi bygger og hvordan rollen utvikler seg videre.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vest Bilutleie er et lokalt bilutleieselskap i rask vekst, med base i Herøysund og flere utleielokasjoner på Vestlandet.

Vi tilbyr utleie av personbiler, varebiler og større kjøretøy til både privat- og bedriftskunder. Selskapet har vokst betydelig på kort tid, og vi jobber kontinuerlig med å utvikle både bilparken, tjenestene våre og måten vi driver på.

Teknologi er en viktig del av satsingen vår. Vi utvikler egne digitale løsninger internt for blant annet booking, drift og kundeoppfølging.

Hos oss er det korte beslutningsveier, stor grad av tillit og gode muligheter til å påvirke hvordan selskapet utvikler seg.

jobs.title: Head of Channel Partnerships (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Channel Partnerships

Luxembourg

Sonata One is a rapidly scaling, regulated fund services and technology (fintech) business.  We're The Private Funds Clearinghouse, connecting more than 53,000 investors with 6,500 funds and 180 fund managers around the globe. Our vision is to change the paradigm of private markets investing through harmonising the end-to-end investment process within one platform. Investors benefit from a seamless, one & done experience across the fund lifecycle (from fund selection and subscription through to settlement and reporting) underpinned by a globally compliant KYC passport and 24/5 support. Fund managers can raise capital faster at a lower cost from a wider pool of pre-approved investors.  Founded in 2015, Sonata One has a presence in eight locations worldwide including the US, UK and Luxembourg, Guernsey, South Africa and Mauritius.    

We operate as #OneGlobalThread in line with our values: We challenge the norm, we change the way we think and work, by connecting systems and people, while committing to our vision and each other. We are now looking to recruit an experienced Head of Channel Partnerships to join our global team.

Position Overview:  

Reporting to the Managing Director – Global Growth, the Head of Channel Partnerships will lead Sonata One's global channel partnership strategy function, driving commercial growth through the development of strategic relationships across the private markets ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity to join Sonata One at a pivotal stage in our growth journey as we invest significantly in building a world-class commercial organisation. You will play a key role in shaping our partnerships strategy, and helping expand Sonata One's presence across the global private markets industry.
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, developing and managing strategic partnerships that generate new commercial opportunities, strengthen long-term client relationships and expand Sonata One's market presence. Working closely with the New Business team, Marketing, Product, Technology and Operations, you will help deliver Sonata One's ambitious commercial growth strategy while ensuring our partner ecosystem continues to create value for clients around the world.

Responsibilities:  

Revenue Generation

• Develop and execute the global channel partnership strategy to support Sonata One's commercial growth objectives.  
• Identify opportunities to generate new revenue through strategic partnerships, cross-selling and partner-led opportunities.  
• Work closely with the New Business team to maximise commercial opportunities generated through partner relationships.  
• Support joint go-to-market initiatives and marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness and generate qualified opportunities.  

Strategic Partnership Development

• Identify, evaluate and establish new strategic partnerships across the private markets ecosystem.  
• Develop long-term partnership strategies aligned to Sonata One's commercial objectives.  
• Expand Sonata One's partner network across key global markets.  
• Assess prospective partners based on market reach, client base, strategic fit and long-term commercial value.  

Relationship Management

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organisations.  
• Act as the primary executive contact for strategic partners.  
• Develop engagement plans that maximise partner success and long-term collaboration.  
• Proactively resolve issues and identify opportunities to strengthen relationships.  

Performance & Growth

• Establish KPIs to measure partnership success.  
• Monitor pipeline performance, commercial outcomes and partner engagement.  
• Use market insights and performance data to continuously improve partnership strategies.  
• Deliver accurate commercial forecasting and reporting to senior leadership.  

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner with Marketing to improve awareness, engagement and partner enablement.  
• Work closely with Product and Technology teams to ensure partner feedback informs future product development.  
• Collaborate with Legal to support commercial agreements and partnership governance where required.  
 

Compensation:
• Industry leading base salary - EUR 130,000 - 200,000 depending on experience.

Qualifications:  
 
• Proven experience in a senior partnerships, business development or commercial leadership role.  
• Demonstrable success developing strategic partnerships within fintech, financial services, fund services or private markets.  
• Strong understanding of the private markets ecosystem, including fund managers, institutional investors and service providers.  
• Existing network across the private markets industry would be highly advantageous.  
• Experience leading and developing high-performing commercial or relationship management teams.  
• Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.  
• Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute partnership strategies.  
• Analytical mindset with experience using commercial data to drive decision making.  
• Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills.  
• Experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce would be advantageous.  
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Finance, Marketing or a related discipline.  

Being part of Sonata One provides a collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation and diversity. We believe in the power of our unique mission and we all work together towards that one single goal. We also believe in being real. We're not a big corporate. Everyone has an important role to fulfil, and your contribution will be an integral part of our success story.   
  
Benefits:   

• Life Insurance – Peace of mind for you and your loved ones 
• Income Protection – Financial support when you need it most 
• Hybrid Working – Supporting work/Life Balance 
• Annual Leave – With extra days that grow the longer you're with us 
• Pension Scheme – Employee matched helping you plan confidently for the future 
• Employee Assistance Program – Confidential, 24/7 support for life's ups and downs 
• Enhanced Maternity, Paternity & Adoption Leave – Because family matters 
• Career Training & Development – Ongoing learning opportunities to help you grow 
• Paid Volunteering Day – Take time to give back to causes you care about 
• Cycle to work Scheme – Employees can benefit from significant tax savings on bicycles and cycling equipment
• Work From Anywhere – Choose your backdrop

jobs.title: Data Governance Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Data Governance Officer (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1168

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

As a Data Governance Officer, you will support the operational implementation of the Bank's Data Strategy and BCBS 239 programme. Reporting to the Senior Data Governance Officer, you will work with Business, Risk, Finance, Data and IT stakeholders to embed effective governance practices across the data lifecycle.

Your next challenge:

• Support the day-to-day implementation of the Bank's Data Governance framework, standards and procedures.
• Contribute to BCBS 239 implementation and related remediation activities.
• Maintain and control Data Governance artefacts, including the Business Glossary, Business Terms, metadata, data ownership and data lineage.
• Support Data Owners and Data Stewards in fulfilling their responsibilities and using Data Governance tools.
• Perform completeness and consistency checks on metadata and governance information, and coordinate the resolution of identified gaps.
• Support the documentation and maintenance of business and technical lineage across business concepts, data fields, applications and source systems.
• Embed Data Governance requirements in data and IT projects throughout the data lifecycle.
• Contribute to the improvement and automation of operational Data Governance processes and controls.
• Maintain evidence supporting BCBS 239, internal control, audit and regulatory requirements.
• Use Microsoft 365, Power BI, Copilot and relevant AI-enabled automation capabilities to improve efficiency and ways of working.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• One to three years of professional experience working with data, preferably in banking or financial services.
• Practical experience with financial, risk, accounting, regulatory or banking data is preferred.
• Previous Data Governance experience is an advantage but is not required.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.
• Good understanding of the data lifecycle, including data sourcing, transformation, storage, mapping and consumption.
• Knowledge of data development processes and the movement of data between systems.
• Working knowledge of data modelling, database and data architecture concepts.
• Ability to use SQL to explore datasets, analyse data structures and support data investigations.
• Knowledge of Data Governance and metadata tools, such as HOPEX, Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview or equivalent solutions.
• Understanding of Business Glossary, metadata management, data ownership and data lineage concepts.
• Practical experience with Power BI, including data analysis and the creation or maintenance of dashboards.
• Strong command of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot and relevant AI-enabled productivity and automation capabilities.
• Knowledge of BCBS 239 or banking regulatory data requirements is an advantage.
• Highly self-driven, proactive and able to take ownership of assigned activities with limited supervision.
• Hands-on and comfortable working directly with data, tools and governance artefacts.
• Analytical, structured and attentive to detail.
• Strong team player who collaborates effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Able to challenge inconsistencies constructively, follow up with stakeholders and drive activities to completion.
• Curious about data, technology and AI, with a continuous improvement and automation mindset.
• Clear communicator who can explain data-related topics to different audiences.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

Mitarbeiter zur Unterstützung bei der Montage von Photovoltaikanlagen (m-w-d)


Der Mitarbeiter unterstützt Monteure insbesondere bei folgenden Arbeiten:

• Mithilfe bei der Montage von Photovoltaikanlagen auf Dächern
• Montage und Vorbereitung von Unterkonstruktionen
• Transport und Bereitstellung von PV-Modulen, Montagematerial und Werkzeug

Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Elektro- oder Montagebereich ist nicht erforderlich. Die Tätigkeit ist als Helfertätigkeit vorgesehen.

• Führerschein B + PKW
• Schwindelfreiheit und Höhentauglichkeit, da ein wesentlicher Teil der Arbeiten auf Dächern stattfindet

• Gute Verständigung auf Deutsch oder Luxemburgisch, da die Kommunikation auf den Baustellen mit unseren Monteuren gewährleistet sein muss

Erfahrungen im Bereich PV, Dachmontage, Bau oder Montage sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.

Vertragskonditionen

• Arbeitsbeginn: nächstmöglich
• Beschäftigungsumfang: Vollzeit
• Einsatzdauer: 3-4 Monate
• Vergütung: 16,0192 € / Stunde + Pauschalbetrag von 10,00 € / Tag für Ihre Transportkosten

jobs.title: ICT Risk & Governance Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
ICT Risk & Governance Officer F/M

Reference: LU879256
Luxembourg
Permanent
Financial Services

We are currently working for a leading international professional services firm providing legal, governance, and corporate services to the financial services industry. The Luxembourg office advises investment funds, private equity firms, asset managers, financial institutions, multinational corporations, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals on complex cross-border transactions and regulatory matters.

In the context of a newly created position, we are looking for a ICT Risk & Governance Officer F/M. This candidate will be responsible for the implementation and oversight of the Company's outsourcing framework in accordance with CSSF Circular 22/806, and provides IT support in Luxembourg. The manager of this role will be the Managing Director of the Luxembourg Office.

The role is responsible for ensuring that all outsourcing arrangements, including ICT services provided by the Group Head Office, are effectively governed, monitored, and properly documented. In addition, the role provides local IT support to Company users, acting as the first point of contact for IT-related incidents and requests.

Key Responsibilities

1. Outsourcing Governance

• Support the deployment and continuous enhancement of the Company's outsourcing governance framework.
• Ensure outsourced activities remain aligned with applicable regulations, internal standards and governance requirements.
• Oversee the maintenance and accuracy of the outsourcing inventory.
• Manage and maintain outsourcing-related records, contractual agreements and service documentation.
• Liaise with key internal and external stakeholders involved in outsourcing activities.

2. Risk Assessment & Supplier Due Diligence

• Facilitate initial and ongoing risk evaluations of outsourced functions and services.
• Conduct or coordinate due diligence reviews on external providers and intra-group entities.
• Ensure outsourcing-related risks are appropriately identified, evaluated and documented within the Company's risk management framework.

3. ICT Vendor Oversight

• Oversee ICT outsourcing arrangements, including services delivered by the Group Head Office.
• Monitor service quality through the review of performance reports, KPIs and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Verify that service providers comply with contractual obligations and operational expectations.
• Collaborate with Group IT teams to address performance, service delivery and operational matters.

4. Service Monitoring & Management Reporting

• Gather and assess operational and performance data from outsourced service providers and intra-group entities.
• Track adherence to agreed service levels and performance metrics.
• Produce regular management reports on outsourcing activities and provider performance.
• Escalate significant incidents, service disruptions or SLA breaches to the designated outsourcing manager.

5. Incident Management & Remediation

• Identify and monitor issues affecting outsourced services.
• Coordinate corrective actions with service providers and relevant stakeholders.
• Maintain accurate records of incidents, remediation plans and follow-up activities.

6. IT Support & Local Coordination

• Serve as the primary contact for end users requiring IT assistance via phone, email or ticketing platforms.
• Coordinate with internal and Group IT teams to ensure timely issue resolution and effective user support.
If this opportunity matches your skills and experience, please do not hesitate to apply. Your application will be handled with the utmost confidentiality by Quentin de Lacoste Lareymondie.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
• Solid experience (4+ years) in information security / ICT risk within financial services, preferably within a Luxembourg PSF, bank, management company, or similar regulated entity.
• Good knowledge of CSSF circular 22/806 and security frameworks (ISO 27001 or similar) and leading practices.
• Solid knowledge of Windows environments and user support.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, effective stakeholder engagement, and a proactive, autonomous, hands-on working attitude.
• Ability to interact and work with senior management and service providers / intragroup companies in a collaborative, clear, pragmatic and risk-based manner.
• Strong written communication skills for clear controls documentation and executive risk reporting, proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint), fluent in French and English.

jobs.title: Senior Business Developer, Asset Servicing, PWM&FO International, SEB Luxembourg (m/f)
jobs.employer: SKANDINAVISKA ENSKILDA BANKEN AB Luxembourg Branch S.A.E.
jobs.description:
The Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) division unites the three business areas - Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO), Asset Management, and Life, and together with the newly established product area Investments & Trading Solutions, the WAM division has a clear purpose to significantly strengthen the offering and grow within the wealth and asset management segments.

PWM&FO offers comprehensive banking services, access to capital markets, financing solutions and individually tailored advisory services. The advisory services are based on SEB's vast range of financing and investment products. PWM&FO has a local presence in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, Luxembourg, Singapore, UK, and representative offices in Nice and Zurich.

SEB in Luxembourg serves as the hub for PWM&FO to Nordic nationals living abroad. We are around 150 employees with more than 20 different nationalities.

About the team

The Asset Servicing team supports clients of PWM&FO International by providing active client service and a solid financial infrastructure for banking products and services, such as cash management, custody, accounting, portfolio solutions and investment structures.
The team was established to manage and develop Asset Servicing solutions to professional clients of PWMFO International. The team manage the relationships with both internal stakeholders and selected external partners that are part of the value proposition that we offer to our clients. Through our broader team of Asset Servicing professionals, we secure a robust service delivery and continuous product development, providing clients of PWM&FO International with access to a comprehensive Asset Servicing offering.  

About the role

In this role as an experienced Business Developer, you will be driving our commercial agenda securing delivery of Asset Servicing solutions fitting to the needs of existing and new clients.  Working closely with our Product Managers and the Coverage teams across SEB Group, you will execute on an ambitious growth and transformation agenda.

Your responsibilities include the following but are not limited to:

• Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities in line with growth strategy
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, partners, and key stakeholders
• Analyse market trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to inform opportunity development
• Develop value propositions, business cases and proposals
• Support negotiation and contracting activities to secure profitable outcomes
• Manage and maintain a qualified pipeline, including forecasting and reporting
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery feasibility and commercial alignment

What we are looking for

• At least 10 years of working experience, ideally within the International Asset Servicing Industry
• Preferably a bachelor's or master's degree in economics or a related field
• Proven commercial track record
• Structured and solution oriented-oriented approach to work
• High degree of personal integrity and ability to handle confidentiality in a professional way
• Strong networking and relationship building skills
• Good communication and interpersonal skills with a genuine interest in banking and finance
• Fluency in English and a Nordic language. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• International opportunities and empowering working environment
• Long-term stability 
• Extensive training and learning opportunities
• A diverse and inclusive workplace culture that values collaboration and individuality 

Ready to join?

Please feel free to send in your application with your CV and Cover Letter in English as soon as possible, but at the latest on 13 October 2026.
Please be informed that candidate selected for this role will need to provide their Criminal Record Certificate and a name screening against sanctions list will be performed as a part of the background check process.

jobs.title: Chef / Cheffe d'unité Service Management (m/f)
jobs.employer: CFL - Société Nationale Des Chemins De Fer Luxembourgeois S.C.L.
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:
Nous sommes aujourd'hui l'un des plus grands employeurs du Grand-Duché et comptons parmi les recruteurs les plus actifs. Attentifs aux besoins de notre Groupe, comme de ceux de nos employés et employées, nous recrutons, intégrons et accompagnons chaque année plusieurs dizaines de nouveaux collaborateurs et collaboratrices de tous horizons, de tous profils. L'expansion de nos activités nous pousse à la recherche incessante de nouveaux talents qui, tous ensemble, nourrissent la diversité de notre grande famille CFL.

Notre Service Informatique se propose d'engager, pour une entrée immédiate, un ou une

CHEF / CHEFFE D'UNITÉ SERVICE MANAGEMENT

Ce poste est à pourvoir à temps plein, bénéficie du flexitime et est éligible au télétravail.

L'embauche est définitive à la suite d'une période de stage rémunérée de 2 ans, comprenant des formations et des évaluations.

Votre mission :

En tant que Chef ou Cheffe d'unité Service Management, vous pilotez l'organisation qui garantit la maîtrise de bout en bout des services IT, de leur prise en charge jusqu'à leur amélioration continue. Vous êtes responsable du cadre ITSM, des processus de Service Management, du support de niveau 1 et 2, ainsi que de la mesure de la qualité de service, en alignement avec les objectifs de la division COO.

Vous veillez à ce que chaque demande, incident ou dysfonctionnement dispose d'un responsable clairement identifié, soit traité selon sa priorité et fasse l'objet d'une communication transparente. Vous mobilisez les unités expertes lorsque nécessaire, tout en maintenant une responsabilité de bout en bout vis-à-vis des utilisateurs et des métiers.

Dans ce cadre, il vous incombera notamment de :



Piloter l'unité et sa transformation

* Vous encadrez les collaborateurs /collaboratrices internes et les prestataires externes, organisez les activités et arbitrez les priorités et les ressources
* Vous définissez la feuille de route de l'unité et accompagnez l'évolution des pratiques, des compétences et de la culture de service
* Vous développez une collaboration structurée entre le support, les unités techniques, les équipes applicatives et les métiers

Garantir la gouvernance du Service Management

* Vous assurez la cohérence et l'amélioration des processus Incident, Request, Change, Problem, Knowledge et Event Management
* Vous confiez leur pilotage opérationnel aux responsables désignés, fixez leurs objectifs et en contrôlez l'efficacité
* Vous clarifiez les rôles et responsabilités afin d'anticiper les besoins et d'optimiser la qualité de service

Piloter la qualité et la performance des services

* Vous définissez les engagements de service avec les métiers et les fournisseurs, notamment les SLA et OLA
* Vous garantissez la qualité des données ITSM, des indicateurs et des tableaux de bord nécessaires au pilotage
* Vous organisez les revues de performance et transformez les constats en plans d'amélioration mesurables

Améliorer l'expérience utilisateur et l'efficacité du support

* Vous développez une prise en charge proactive, transparente et orientée utilisateur
* Vous réduisez les incidents récurrents en renforçant le Problem Management, la gestion des connaissances et l'analyse des causes racines
* Vous développez le shift-left, le self-service et l'automatisation lorsque ces leviers améliorent concrètement la qualité et l'efficacité du service

Gérer les escalades, les crises et la continuité de service

* Vous assurez le rôle de point d'escalade pour les situations dépassant les mécanismes opérationnels standards
* Vous coordonnez la réponse aux incidents majeurs et aux crises avec les unités techniques, les métiers et les autres parties prenantes
* Vous pilotez les processus de continuité et de reprise des services, et veiller à leur mise à l'épreuve régulière avec les responsables techniques

Garantir la conformité et l'amélioration continue

* Vous veillez à la conformité, à l'auditabilité et à la discipline opérationnelle des activités de l'unité
* Vous intégrez les exigences de sécurité et de résilience, notamment celles liées à NIS2, en collaboration avec les équipes spécialisées
* Vous faites évoluer en permanence l'organisation, les processus et les outils sur la base des résultats mesurés et des retours des utilisateurs



Votre profil :

* Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de Master en gestion de projets, informatique, gestion des systèmes d'information ou dans un domaine équivalent
* Vous justifiez d'une expérience professionnelle d'au moins 5 ans dans une fonction similaire
* Vous disposez de solides connaissances en Service Management, ITSM, Service Level Management, Service Delivery Management et gouvernance des services IT
* Vous êtes capable de piloter des activités de conformité, d'audit, de continuité d'activité et de reprise d'activité
* Vous avez de bonnes connaissances des exigences liées à la sécurité du système d'information, notamment en lien avec NIS2, et travaillez efficacement avec les équipes spécialisées telles que le CISO
* Vous êtes à l'aise dans la création de modèles de systèmes, de diagrammes et d'une documentation complète
* Vous possédez des compétences en gestion de projets, planification, coordination, gestion des risques et suivi budgétaire
* Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des publics techniques et non techniques
* Vous êtes capable de recueillir les besoins, d'analyser les demandes des clients et utilisateurs et de transmettre des informations de manière claire et structurée
* Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, d'esprit d'équipe, de résistance au stress et d'une bonne capacité d'écoute
* Vous avez une forte orientation résultats et sécurité, tout en démontrant de bonnes capacités d'organisation, de planification, de supervision et de délégation
* Vous faites preuve de leadership et êtes capable de fédérer, responsabiliser et accompagner les équipes dans un environnement IT exigeant et en constante évolution
* Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. La maîtrise de l'allemand et du luxembourgeois constitue un atout
* Vous avez la nationalité d'un pays membre de l'Union européenne.

À la recherche d'un nouveau défi professionnel ?

Vous pouvez déposer votre candidature via ce site pour le 15/10/2026 au plus tard.

Votre recruteuse, Caroline HORNBECK reste à votre entière disposition par e-mail pour tout renseignement complémentaire :





Vos obligations administratives :

* Une preuve de l'intégralité de vos activités professionnelles passées (certificat de travail, certificat d'affiliation, relevé de carrière, etc.) devra être fournie au cours du processus de recrutement. Ces documents devront être fournis sous format électronique avant le premier entretien.
* Un extrait de votre casier judiciaire luxembourgeois (bulletin numéro 3 et éventuellement numéro 4), - ainsi que de votre pays de résidence si vous ne résidez pas au Luxembourg - datant de moins de 3 mois sera également à fournir sous format électronique avant le premier entretien.

Envie de découvrir les CFL de l'intérieur ?

Découvrez notre blog dédié à nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices, à leurs métiers et leurs passions : www.WEARECFL.lu

Le Groupe CFL, employeur de l'égalité des chances

Au sein du Groupe CFL, nous nous engageons en faveur de l'égalité et de l'inclusion. Nous œuvrons pour un environnement de travail respectueux et adapté, où la diversité prend racine et où l'inclusion est la norme, car nous savons que le sentiment d'unité permet à chacun et chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel.

jobs.title: Educateur Gradué Expérimenté (H/F/X) - 32h/sem - CDI - BEO - Rumelange
jobs.description:
Nous sommes une association luxembourgeoise forte de ses 38 ans d'engagement dans le secteur social luxembourgeois. Nous comptons plus de 750 collaborateurs répartis sur plus de 40 structures et services et sommes présents dans 19 communes du pays. Nous sommes membres de la Bientraitance a.s.b.l. signifiant que nos actions, projets et postures professionnelles s'inscrivent dans une culture bientraitante et bienveillante. Nous portons notre mission dans chacune de nos actions - Grandir ensemble. Toutes nos actions sont guidées par les principes de la Déclaration universelle des Droits de l'Homme et de la Déclaration des Droits de l'Enfant. Nos collaborateurs travaillent quotidiennement dans les secteurs de l'enfance, de la jeunesse et de la famille afin de créer un environnement serein où chaque enfant, adolescent ou jeune adulte peut trouver toutes les chances de s'épanouir, quelles que soient sa situation et sa différence.

Nous recherchons notre Educateur Gradué Expérimenté (H/F/X) pour intégrer l'équipe du Foyer d'accueil d'urgence BEO à Rumelange.

Sous la supervision directe du Responsable de Service, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes :

• Participer à la conception et la mise en œuvre du projet pédagogique,
• Coordonner les activités, assurer le bien-être et le développement des bénéficiaires,
• Créer un cadre structurant, contenante et bienveillant,
• Gérer la dynamique du groupe : activités, rythmes de vie, règles de vie collective,
• Respecter les procédures internes et les exigences légales de la protection de l'enfance,
• Développer un partenariat professionnel avec les parents,
• Collaborer avec les familles, les instances externes (ONE... )
• Conception et pilotage de projets éducatifs
• Être à l'écoute et répondre aux besoins psychiques et physiologiques des enfants,
• Travailler dans le respect des normes de sécurité en vigueur.

Votre Profil :

• Titulaire d'un Bachelor en Sciences sociales et éducatives ou d'un diplôme équivalent reconnu au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg,

jobs.title: Assessment & Examinations Coordinator part-time (m/f)
jobs.description:
Are you someone who brings clarity, accuracy and calm to complex processes? Do you enjoy coordinating many moving parts while keeping people informed, supported and confident?
The International School of Luxembourg (“ISL”) is looking for an Assessment & Examinations Coordinator to support well-organised, inclusive and student-centred examination experiences across Grades 9–12. Working closely with the Assistant Principal for High School Academic Pathways / DP Coordinator, the Upper School Student Records and Schedule Specialist, and Faculty members, you will coordinate examination and assessment processes, including those of the IB Diploma Programme (“DP”).
This role combines careful organisation with a strong human focus. You will help students and families navigate examination processes, support individual access needs and ensure that important assessment milestones are managed with care, accuracy and integrity.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.
What will you do?
You will use your skills to:
● Plan and coordinate IB DP, mock and internal examinations, including schedules, venues, materials and invigilation;
● Communicate examination requirements, schedules and procedures clearly to students, families, colleagues and invigilators;
● Collaborate with Learner Support and IT colleagues to implement approved inclusive access arrangements;
● Recruit, prepare and coordinate external examination invigilators;
● Maintain confidentiality, examination security and accurate records within IB and school systems;
● Respond calmly and practically to changing circumstances during examination periods;
● Coordinate CAT4 testing across the Upper School; and
● Work collaboratively across Academic Pathways, Data Management, Learner Support, IT and teaching teams.
You will work an average of 16 hours per week in a two-week reference period, and these hours must be worked between 07:00-17:00h during the work week. Your actual schedule can be finalised through discussion with the Assistant Principal for High School Academic Pathways / DP Coordinator based on your personal situation and school needs.
The workload follows the examination cycle, with busier periods around registration, mock examinations, the May IB examination session and the release of results. Flexibility is therefore important, and some additional hours, early mornings, evenings or occasional public-holiday work may be required during peak periods.
What skills will you bring?
Essential:
We are interested in what you can do and how you work, rather than one career path.
● Organisation and prioritisation – coordinating complex processes, managing competing deadlines and following through reliably;
● Accuracy and attention to detail – handling data, documentation and processes carefully and consistently;
● Communication and relationship-building – communicating clearly and respectfully with young people and adults from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds;
● Collaboration and ownership – working effectively across teams while taking responsibility for your own work;
● Problem-solving and composure – thinking clearly, adapting and finding practical solutions under pressure;
● Integrity and discretion – handling confidential information and examination materials responsibly;
● Inclusive practice – working with colleagues to ensure students can access assessment equitably;
● Digital confidence – using and learning digital systems, including Excel, Word, Outlook and databases;
● Full professional fluency in English; and
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.
Valued Experience:
Your transferable skills may have been developed in education or in another complex, deadline-driven environment.
● Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:
● Coordinating administrative processes, assessments, examinations or events;
● Working in a school, university or similarly regulated environment;
● Supporting students, young people or families;
● Working with confidential data, databases or student information systems;
● Working within an international or multicultural environment;
● The IB Diploma Programme, external examinations or standardised testing such as CAT4.
● Working knowledge of French or German, and Luxembourgish, would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management (m/f)
jobs.description:
Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10552964 | Amazon Europe Core SARL - LUX

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. Our systems are built entirely in-house, and are on the cutting edge in automated large-scale business, inventory and supply chain planning and optimization systems. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.

The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Responsibilities may include:

- Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
- Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
- Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
- Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
- Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
- Developing dashboards and insight products
- Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

jobs.title: Senior AML/KYC Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior AML/KYC Officer to join a Luxembourg-based specialised PFS operating within the Private Capital fund administration space, covering Private Equity, Real Estate, Infrastructure and Private Debt.

The role combines hands-on AML/KYC expertise, investor due diligence and senior-level oversight, with exposure to sophisticated investors and complex, multi-jurisdictional structures. You will work closely with the RR/RC and senior management, acting as a key escalation point on complex and high-risk matters.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the investor onboarding and KYC process, from documentation and risk classification through to approval and set-up.
• Perform and review CDD/EDD on complex and high-risk investors, including UBO identification across multi-layered structures.
• Conduct PEP, sanctions and adverse media screening, investigate alerts and document decisions.
• Assess Source of Wealth / Source of Funds, investor eligibility and reliance on third-party or delegated CDD.
• Monitor AML risks throughout the investor lifecycle, including capital calls, distributions, transfers, novations and bank account changes.
• Review AML considerations across Private Equity, Real Estate, Infrastructure and Private Debt structures, including SPVs, feeders, co-investments and other holding structures.
• Contribute to the ML/TF risk assessment, investor risk methodology and periodic/eventdriven KYC reviews.
• Investigate unusual activity and support the RR/RC with suspicious activity reporting and regulatory requests.
• Maintain and enhance AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls in line with the Luxembourg regulatory framework and CSSF requirements.
• Ensure the effective application of the four-eyes principle, conduct quality reviews and follow up on remediation.
• Prepare AML/CFT reporting, KPIs and KRIs for senior management and the Board.
• Support CSSF inspections, audits and AML incident management.
• Deliver AML/CFT training and act as a technical escalation point for the wider administration team.
• Act as a key KYC contact for investors, GPs, AIFMs, depositaries and legal advisers.

Profile

• 7+ years of experience in AML/KYC, including at least 4 years in Luxembourg.
• Background in fund administration, transfer agency, AIFM/ManCo or a regulated PFS.
• Strong exposure to Private Capital investors, ideally across Private Equity, Real Estate, Infrastructure and/or Private Debt.
• Proven experience with complex multi-jurisdictional structures and UBO analysis.
• Strong technical knowledge of Luxembourg AML/CFT requirements applicable to fund administration and investor services.
• Hands-on expertise in EDD, PEP and sanctions screening, Source of Wealth / Source of Funds and ongoing KYC monitoring.
• Good understanding of closed-ended fund mechanics, including commitments, capital calls, distributions, transfers and subscription lines.
• Experience interacting with CSSF, CRF, auditors and/or depositaries.
• Ability to review fund documentation such as LPAs and subscription agreements from an AML perspective.
• Fluent English, with strong analytical skills, rigour and independence.
• A confident and challenging approach, with the ability to escalate issues and decline relationships where regulatory requirements are not met.

As a Bonus

• CAMS, ICA or LSFI/ABBL AML certification.
• Experience with KYC/screening and transfer agency platforms such as eFront Invest, Investran, Allvue or equivalent.
• Exposure to Private Debt, Real Estate or Infrastructure counterparty due diligence.
• Experience in building, enhancing or migrating an AML framework.
• French and/or German.

jobs.title: Inventory Planner, AMXL Supply Chain (m/f)
jobs.description:
Inventory Planner, AMXL Supply Chain
Job ID: 10518468 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Are you passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges that directly impact customer experience? Do you thrive in a role that combines analytical rigor with hands-on execution? Join Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) as an Inventory Planner where you'll define and lead placement initiatives that optimize our inventory network.

This role offers an exciting blend of analytics, execution, automation, and stakeholder management. You'll work on optimization exercises that improve how we position inventory across our network, ensuring customers receive their large items efficiently. Your work will directly influence operational performance and customer satisfaction, making a measurable impact across the entire customer journey.

Key job responsibilities

- Define and lead the execution of placement initiatives that optimize inventory positioning across the AMXL network
- Design and implement automation solutions to streamline inventory planning processes and improve operational efficiency
- Conduct complex optimization exercises analyzing inventory flows, demand patterns, and capacity constraints to drive data-informed decisions
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including operations, transportation, and fulfillment teams to align on placement strategies and resolve inventory challenges
- Develop and maintain analytical models and tools that enable proactive inventory management and support strategic planning initiatives

A day in the life

You'll start your day analyzing inventory performance metrics and identifying opportunities for optimization. You might spend time building automation tools to streamline repetitive processes, then shift to collaborating with operations partners on implementing a new placement strategy. Throughout the day, you'll tackle customer-facing challenges that require deep analysis, run optimization models to test different scenarios, and work with stakeholders to execute improvements that enhance the customer experience.

About the team

AMXL is Amazon's first true end-to-end organization for extra-large items, with visibility and impact across every mile of the customer journey. From the moment an order is placed to final delivery, our team orchestrates the complex logistics of getting bulky items to customers efficiently.

Our team culture thrives on knowledge sharing, mutual support, and continuous learning. We tackle unique challenges in the large-item space, innovating solutions that haven't been solved elsewhere. You'll work alongside passionate professionals who are committed to improving operations while supporting each other's growth and development.

Basic Qualifications

- English C1
- Bachelor's or Master's degree

Preferred Qualifications

- Excel

jobs.title: Network Planning Manager, MMNC - Middle Mile Network Control (m/f)
jobs.description:
Network Planning Manager, MMNC - Middle Mile Network Control
Job ID: 10498296 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

This role tagged as one of Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to Retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities

Define the Amazon outbound network planning (Legs, Sorts, CPT) for one of the UK sub-regions covered by 3-5 Sort Centers.
Analyse the best design based on forecast, and historical flows to improve cost, speed and DEA across E2E network.
Partner with teams to align on network changes to solve operational challenges.
Support the planning and organization of complex projects including Peak network transformations

A day in the life
Being a Network Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.

As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both on-the-ground tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.

This role is based in Luxembourg headquarters.

About the team

Amazon couldn't deliver at pace without the STEP TNO team. As part of STEP TNO MMNC, you'll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you'll help Amazon's transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.

We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel (m/f)
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Corporate counsel

Job Description:  

It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.   

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.  

But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that. 

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Corporate Counsel. Reporting to a Senior Manager, this full-time, permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers local coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact on our Funds business and its growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Client servicing through means of an in-depth knowledge of client files, client communication and internal procedures:
• Draft/review of legal documentation in terms of incorporation of companies, day-to-day operations, liquidation
• Monitor the various steps of the transactions, ensure adherence at all times with Luxembourg law as well as internal Vistra processes
• Debt collection of outstanding Vistra invoices
• Coordinate with central operations team to resolve issues concerning taxes, administration and banking of client companies
• Detect possible corporate and tax issues
• Handle client requests regarding transactions/statutory and outflow
• Work in close collaboration with team members, law firms, auditors, tax advisors and other relevant parties
• Organise the preparation shareholder and board meetings together with the Accountants and Corporate Secretarial Assistants
• Maintain communication with clients, including the planning of the Corporate Calendar
• Monitor completeness of client files
• Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of Luxembourg market/regulations (legal, tax, accounting, reporting, market developments)
• Take up directorship mandates in client's companies, if requested
• Take up client payroll, if requested
• Collect KYC documentation (as required)
• Record the working hours/client in the time billing system according to the objectives set
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Strong communication skills
• Ability to solve problems, work independently and as a member of a team
  
Relevant Experience

• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulation
• Minimum of 3 years of experience with a professional services firm
• Strong communication skills
• Ability to solve problems, work independently and as a member of a team

Education and Professional Qualification

Law, Economics and/or Tax degree

If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

jobs.title: Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI (m/f)
jobs.description:
Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI

(Valid from 08/09/2026 to 23/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SEDAN
Job Number: UOL08342
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/08/2026

Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Open Position
Job Level: level 1
  
About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
