Relationship Manager, Institutional Banking

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction—we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our corporate and institutional business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Head of Banking, Luxembourg, you will manage and grow ana portfolio of Luxembourg-registered subsidiaries of international institutional clients, including asset managers, hedge funds and sponsors.
You will originate and coordinate opportunities across HSBC's capabilities, with particular emphasis on Cash Management (GPS) and Securities Services (SSv), while identifying opportunities across Global Markets (GM), Credit & Lending and Asset Management. Working closely with product teams, risk partners and HSBC's international network, you will deliver tailored, coordinated solutions and build long-term client value.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Manage and develop an existing portfolio of institutional clients, grow sustainable revenues and originate New To Bank relationships, with increasing exposure to senior decision-makers.
• Act as the principal point of coordination between clients, their headquarters, home-country Global Relationship Managers and relevant product teams to deepen relationships and deliver a consistent client experience.
• Define and execute client strategies focused on revenue generation, disciplined capital deployment, cross-selling and long-term value creation, while monitoring portfolio performance and applying appropriate risk-based pricing.
• Support Senior Relationship Managers with their client base, including preparing credit proposals, portfolio management and KYC renewals.
• Develop a deep understanding of clients' businesses, credit structures, and financial crime-related risks.
• Collaborate effectively with key product partners and functional teams, including Wholesale Client Services, Client Operations, Credit Analysts Unit, Risk, Legal and Client Documentation teams, to deliver a coordinated, responsive, and positive client experience.

You should apply if you have:

• Relevant experience in Corporate and Institutional Banking, ideally in relationship coverage, a product team or the treasury or markets division of a financial institution, with the ability to engage confidently with corporate and institutional clients.
• Strong understanding of financial institutions and transaction banking products, particularly Cash Management and Payment Solutions (GPS), Securities Services (SSv) and Global Markets (GM), with familiarity across credit and investment solutions.
• Knowledge of onboarding, KYC and CDD processes.
• StrongIT skills, with the ability to produce quality presentations and other materials for client meetings and pitches (Copilot, Excel, Powerpoint).
• Proven commercial judgement and the ability to build long-term client relationships, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and operate successfully in a demanding international environment.
• Strong execution capabilities, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities; experience conducting credit analysis of funds and drafting credit applications would be an advantage.
• Fluent written and spoken English; knowledge of French or German would be an advantage.

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is €87,200 – €120,000.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous définissez et pilotez la stratégie du département Property Management. Vous êtes garant(e) de la performance globale de l'activité, de la qualité des services délivrés aux clients, de la rentabilité du département et du développement du portefeuille sous gestion.
Véritable manager, vous encadrez et fédérez les équipes en charge des volets administratifs, comptables, techniques et opérationnels, en veillant à la cohérence et à la fluidité des actions menées au service des clients et des immeubles gérés.

Ce poste combine un fort volet management d'équipes, un rôle actif dans le développement commercial et la croissance du portefeuille immobilier, ainsi qu'une dimension stratégique auprès de la Direction.

Vos principales responsabilités

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie, les objectifs et les priorités du département Property Management.
• Piloter la performance opérationnelle et financière de l'activité au moyen d'indicateurs de suivi pertinents.

• Superviser l'ensemble du portefeuille immobilier sous gestion et assurer le respect des mandats, engagements contractuels et standards de qualité.
• Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les propriétaires, investisseurs et principaux clients.
• Superviser les dossiers complexes, sensibles ou présentant des enjeux financiers, juridiques, techniques ou réputationnels.
• Contribuer activement au développement commercial, au property development, aux appels d'offres et à l'intégration de nouveaux mandats afin d'accroître le portefeuille sous gestion.
• Garantir la rentabilité du département, le suivi budgétaire et la maîtrise des risques.
• Veiller à l'amélioration continue des processus, à l'harmonisation des pratiques et au respect des procédures internes.
• Piloter les projets de transformation digitale et favoriser l'adoption des nouveaux outils par les équipes.
• Intégrer les enjeux ESG, réglementaires et de conformité dans les pratiques de gestion.
• Assurer une communication régulière avec la Direction et favoriser les synergies avec les autres départements.

Votre profil

• Formation supérieure en immobilier, gestion, finance, droit, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée dans le secteur immobilier et dans une fonction de management en Property Management, Property Development ou dans une activité comparable.

• Véritable expertise en management d'équipes, avec une expérience solide dans l'encadrement de collaborateurs, la gestion de clients institutionnels et de portefeuilles immobiliers complexes.
• Track record démontré en développement commercial.
• Leadership affirmé, forte orientation client et capacité à fédérer.
• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, d'analyse, de négociation et de communication.
• Esprit entrepreneurial, rigueur, sens des responsabilités et goût pour l'amélioration continue.
• Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais ; la connaissance de l'allemand et/ou du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Office Administrator
====================

**JOB DESCRIPTION – OFFICE ADMINISTRATOR**



**Location: Zürich**

**Division: Ticketmaster Central Europe Market, Switzerland**

**Manager: Managing Director, Switzerland**

**Contract Terms: 80\-100%, Full Time 42\.5 hours per week**



**THE JOB**


You are the organisational backbone of Ticketmaster Switzerland and run our office in Dübendorf to a high standard. You keep the market's administrative processes running, supporting Finance, HR and Customer Service, and you own our Experience Management, VIP guests, lounges, complimentary tickets and invitations.

In addition, you keep calendars, meetings and deadlines on track and provide administrative support to the Managing Director.




**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**



Office Management



* Run the office to a high standard, supplies, mail, keys/keycards, parking and pool car, visitor welcome.
* Liaise with the landlord and external contractors, oversee facility topics and health \& safety.
* Maintain office policies, internal manuals and process documentation.
* Organise team events and maintain the team vacation and absence overview.




Team Support



* Support HR administration, on\-/offboarding, personnel files, coordination with insurance and payroll partners, in collaboration with the global HR Operations team.
* Support Finance with preparatory accounting, support in digitalising accounting processes, and payment follow\-ups.
* Contract and vendor management, deadlines, filing and coordination with external vendors.
* Maintain the weekly event outlook so all functions can plan ahead.
* Support the team with administrative tasks and cross\-department coordination.
* Ad\-hoc tasks and projects as required.




Experience Management



* Manage VIP guests, lounges and hospitality at concerts, festivals and sports events.
* Administer complimentary tickets, invitations and guest lists for clients and partners.
* Coordinate hospitality logistics with promoters and venues.
* Organise internal occasions (e.g. employee events and recognition).




Administrative Support \& Coordination



* Manage the Managing Director's calendar and inbox, prioritise and schedule with foresight.
* Prepare meetings, briefings and presentations (Management Team meetings, Town Halls), take minutes and manage follow\-ups.
* Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines and follow up proactively.
* Plan and book travel and handle expense reporting for the team and the Managing Director.
* First point of contact for internal and external requests, handling confidential matters with discretion.




**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**



* Experience as an office manager, executive assistant or in a comparable organisational role.
* Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, calm and structured under multiple demands.
* High discretion and reliability in handling confidential information.
* Advanced Outlook and MS Office skills.
* Fluent and English; French is a plus.
* Affinity for live entertainment and hosting, willingness to attend selected evening/weekend events.
* Proactive, hands\-on and service\-minded personality.




YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)



* You are a highly organised, proactive and dependable professional who enjoys being the trusted go\-to person in a fast\-moving environment.
* You anticipate needs, bring structure to complex priorities and follow through reliably, even when several stakeholders and deadlines compete for attention.
* You communicate with confidence, warmth and tact at all levels—from senior leadership and external partners to colleagues across the business.
* You handle confidential information with sound judgement, absolute discretion and a strong sense of ownership.
* You are service\-minded and naturally create positive experiences for colleagues, clients and VIP guests, with a genuine eye for detail.
* You remain calm, flexible and solutions\-oriented under pressure, especially around events and changing schedules.
* You enjoy working independently while being a collaborative, hands\-on team player who is happy to step in wherever support is needed.
* You take pride in creating an efficient, welcoming and well\-run office environment.
* You have an affinity for live entertainment and enjoy contributing to memorable experiences for fans, partners and the team.




LIFE AT TICKETMASTER



We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.



Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.



We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.



**Our work is guided by our values:**



**Reliability** \- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.



**Teamwork** \- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team



**Integrity** \- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent



**Belonging** \- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive



EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES



We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.



HIRING PRACTICES


The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.



Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.



\#TMSwitzerland

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

(Exklusiv) HR Fachfrau/\-mann als HR Generalist/in (100%) / Fest
================================================================







### Einleitung



Im direkten Auftrag unserer Mandantin, einem renommierten, sympathischen Handels\- und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen mit Sitz im Herzen der Stadt Zürich (zentrale , zudem Teile Homeoffice gegeben), suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n



### der Arbeit



In der Funktion als HR Generalist/in übernehmen Sie in einem kleinen, sympathischen HR Team vielseitige Aufgaben für ca. 150 Mitarbeitende in allen operativen HR Themenfeldern und wirken auch in konzeptionellen/strategischen Themen/Projekten mit. Sie beraten/betreuen verschiedene Business Units in HR Fragen, sind in der HR Administration von tätig, und übernehmen Aufgaben in der Rekrutierung/Interviewführung. Auch die Mitarbeit in der Personalentwicklung sowie in diversen HR Projekten (z.B. Optimierung HRIS, C\&B etc.) gehört, wie auch die gemeinsame Vorbereitung der monatlichen Lohnläufe (Payroll bei externem Provider), zu Ihrem Tätigkeitsbereich. Als Teil eines sympathischen, dynamischen HR Teams sind Sie für Ihre Abteilungen/Linienvorgesetzten die kompetente HR\-Ansprechperson von A\-Z. Die Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung interner HR Prozesse macht Ihre Funktion zusätzlich spannend und abwechslungsreich. Unsere Mandantin bietet Ihnen die Mitarbeit in einem kollegialen Team in einem dynamischen, stark wachsenden Umfeld eines renommierten Unternehmens mit attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen.



### Anforderungsprofil



Um diese interessante Herausforderung optimal zu meistern, bringen Sie die Weiterbildung zur HR Fachfrau/Fachmann mit (denkbar ist auch eine Weiterbildung als HR Assistentin/Sachbearbeiterin kombiniert mit langjähriger relevanter Berufspraxis) und verfügen über vielseitige Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen, generalistischen HR Funktion (z.B. HR Fachfrau, HR Generalist) inkl. Payroll\-Admin Praxis. Berufspraxis aus einer ähnlichen Branche (Finanzbranche, Treuhand, Immobilien etc.) ist von Vorteil, aber nicht Bedingung. Sie kommunizieren stilsicher in Deutsch sowie gut in Englisch, weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil. Im Umgang mit den MS Office Anwendungen sind Sie versiert und durften bereits Praxis mit HRIS (ideal Abacus und/oder MS Dynamics) sammeln. Wenn Sie zudem eine offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit sind, die auch in hektischen Zeiten einen kühlen bewahrt, sollten Sie sich baldmöglichst bei uns bewerben.  

Suchen Sie eine neue Herausforderung in einer vielseitigen HR Funktion in einem Team, welches den ´Team Spirit´ lebt und gemeinsam optimale HR Dienstleistungen im Unternehmen erbringt? jobs.title: Customer Success Partner (EMEA)
jobs.description:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Customer Success Partner, Enterprise (Paris)

As a Customer Success Partner at CreatorIQ, you will serve as a strategic advisor to a portfolio of high-level enterprise customers, helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through their creator marketing programs. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their goals and align them with CreatorIQ’s platform capabilities, driving long-term adoption, value realization, and program success.

You’ll build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders—both virtually and in person—and serve as a proactive partner throughout the customer lifecycle. Customer Success Partners are experts in the CreatorIQ platform, fluent in creator and influencer marketing strategy, and passionate about delivering measurable business impact.

You will own the health and retention of your portfolio and will be measured on outcomes including gross retention, platform adoption, customer health, and value realization.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for a portfolio of customers, aligning CreatorIQ’s capabilities to their business goals and driving measurable value.

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day users to executive stakeholders.

  • Drive platform adoption and customer success by understanding each customer’s strategy, analyzing engagement, and identifying opportunities to increase value.

  • Lead strategic engagements including success planning, business reviews, roadmap discussions, and in-person meetings as appropriate.

  • Own customer health and retention across your portfolio, proactively identifying risk and coordinating action plans to support long-term success.

  • Maintain strategic account plans that capture customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, risks, and growth opportunities.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Implementation, Services, Support, and Product to deliver a cohesive customer experience and resolve needs effectively.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally while staying current on CreatorIQ capabilities and industry trends to bring relevant insights and best practices to customers.

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • Passionate about creator and influencer marketing, social media, and helping customers build successful programs.

  • 3+ years of experience in a strategic customer-facing role, ideally within influencer marketing, an agency, brand, SaaS, or marketing technology environment.

  • Proven ability to manage toward business KPIs, retention goals, customer health, and customer advocacy metrics.

  • Skilled at navigating customer organizations and building relationships across multiple levels, from daily users to executive sponsors.

  • Comfortable translating customer goals into actionable success strategies and measurable outcomes.

  • Able to use customer, adoption, and performance data to identify risk, uncover opportunities, and tell compelling stories.

  • Strong strategic thinker who can also manage the day-to-day execution and follow-through required to move customer initiatives forward.

  • Confident leading structured customer engagements including success planning, business reviews, executive conversations, and roadmap discussions.

  • Highly organized and proactive, with the ability to effectively prioritize and manage a portfolio of customers with varying needs and levels of complexity.

  • Curious, solutions-oriented, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Collaborative and experienced working cross-functionally with teams such as Implementation, Support, Product, Services, Insights, and Sales.

  • Comfortable with customer success and productivity tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Notion, Jira, or similar platforms.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you’ll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days vacation, floating and set holidays, wellness allowance, and paid parental leave.

  • Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Healthcare coverage, encompassing mental health, physical therapies, dental, vision, cancer coverage, and more.

  • Comprehensive perks program providing stipends for wellness, cell phone and internet, home office setup, mental wellness, professional development, plus occasional company-funded meal opportunities throughout the year.

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth. Trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies—including Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé, and Sephora—CreatorIQ unifies creator marketing across paid, owned, earned, commerce, and community into one seamless, enterprise-grade ecosystem. With industry-leading intelligence infrastructure, rigorous compliance and security standards, and integrations with Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, and more, CreatorIQ empowers brands and agencies to harness the creator economy as a strategic growth engine. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Financial Accountant (m/w, 80–100%)
jobs.description:
IN KÜRZE

Du begeisterst dich für Zahlen, legst Wert auf Präzision und möchtest aktiv das Wachstum von FELFEL mitgestalten? Als Financial Accountant (80–100%, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung) in Zürich Wiedikon übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem agilen Finance Team. Hier formst du nicht nur Zahlen, sondern gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens.


DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

  • Führe das Tagesgeschäft inklusive Haupt- und Nebenbücher (Debitoren, Kreditoren, Bank- und Zahlungsabstimmungen) für unsere Schweizer Gesellschaft und unterstütze das Tagesgeschäft unserer US-Gesellschaft.
  • Erstelle Verrechnungen an Kunden und wirke bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen nach Schweizer Recht mit.
  • Pflege und optimiere unser ERP-System (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC), um dessen kontinuierliche Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen.
  • Agiere als Ansprechperson für interne sowie externe Stakeholder bei Fragen zur Rechnungsstellung und Kreditorenbuchhaltung.
  • Wirke an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finanzprozesse mit.
  • Steuere die Kommunikation als Schnittstelle zu externen Partnern wie ERP-Support, Behörden und Lieferanten.
  • Unterstütze bei der Erstellung von MWST-Abrechnungen, Sales and Use Tax Meldungen für unsere US-Gesellschaft sowie bei der jährlichen Steuererklärung.


WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen in einem ähnlichen Umfeld.
  • Abschluss als Eidg. Finanzfachmann/frau im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (oder aktuell in entsprechender Ausbildung).
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC von Vorteil).
  • Leidenschaft für Zahlen, Strukturen und Prozesse in einem agilen Umfeld.
  • Selbstständige, exakte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und Fähigkeit, mit internen sowie externen Partnern professionell zu kommunizieren.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nichtraucher:in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenterminen. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.
  • Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung für die Schweiz oder Schweizer Pass.


WAS WIR BIETEN

  • Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...
  • Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine
  • 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag
  • Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV
  • Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten
  • Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings
Klingt das nach dem perfekten Job für dich? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mehr über dich zu erfahren! BEWIRB DICH JETZT mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen auf Deutsch oder Englisch.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Dutch Speaking
AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a tight-knit team with high product standards and direct access to production deployment: our models are tested in real-world conditions, with several million users each month, with very short cycles between prototyping, integration and deployment.

In this context, you'll work on the next generation of agentic and recommendation systems: building the pipelines, agents, and models that sit at the core of our product.

Your Mission

Your goal is to build and scale the agentic infrastructure that powers Lemrock's commerce intelligence: turning raw signals into automated, self-improving systems at production scale.

Concretely, you will:

  • Analyze large-scale conversational interaction datasets (100M+ events/month) to uncover behavioral patterns, intent signals, and performance drivers.

  • Design and deploy agentic pipelines end-to-end, from data ingestion and enrichment to model orchestration, monitoring, and continuous improvement, integrated into systems exposed to millions of requests daily.

  • Build autonomous agents that keep our knowledge infrastructure accurate and current.

  • Translate insights into iteration loops in production, by updating, fine-tuning, and improving our existing recommendation and ranking algorithms with tight constraints on latency, robustness, and business outcomes.

  • Design and train new recommendation models from scratch when needed, with a focus on scalability, evaluation rigor, and deployability in real-world traffic.

Candidate Profile

  • Strong academic background (MVA, ENS, X, Central…)

  • 2+ years of experience in AI, Agentic Systems, ML / Deep Learning, statistics or NLP

  • Experience prototyping and deploying AI models into production

  • Experience with production systems (APIs, monitoring, optimization)

  • Strong interest in LLMs, recommendation and conversational systems: building agentic pipelines, agent orchestration, fine-tuning

  • Comfortable with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments

  • Fluent in English; French is a plus

Tech Stack

ML/AI (required)

  • Agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain) and/or native SDKs like OpenAI/Anthropic

  • Observability and evaluation for LLM/agent workflows

  • Vector search, scoring, prompting, LLM orchestration

  • Hybrid recommender systems, causal inference, probabilistic models

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • TypeScript

  • Engineering: Docker, GCP, PostgreSQL, Redis, Vector DBs, PostHog

  • CI/CD

Why Join Us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

Package

Competitive salary disclosed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Team Lead Website
jobs.description:
Why this role exists ?

At Pennylane, our website is a key engine for acquisition and conversion, transforming traffic from SEO, paid acquisition, media, and partnerships into demo bookings and self-sign-ups.

 

With over 450,000 monthly visits, our website already brings together conversion, product management, engineering, and tracking. We are seeking a Team Lead Website to provide clear leadership, structure the team, and scale our conversion performance.

 

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will lead a multidisciplinary squad and ensure the website’s speed, quality, and business impact.

 
 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising clients.

 

A few figures illustrating our scale and ambition:

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 
 

What You’ll Do

You will lead our Website squad and collaborate closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Demand Gen, Data, Brand, and Automation teams.

 

Lead and Grow the Website Squad

  • Set clear roles, objectives, and rituals

  • Manage and develop multidisciplinary profiles across conversion, product, and engineering

  • Foster growth in autonomy and seniority

  • Integrate AI into daily work to accelerate processes (e.g., backlog management, landing-page creation)

  • Recruit additional talent as needed

 

Drive Conversion

  • Define and prioritize initiatives that improve demo bookings and self-sign-ups

  • Frame, challenge, and unblock projects while empowering owners

  • Monitor conversion KPIs and ensure focus on measurable business impact

  • Share results and learnings with Growth, Sales, and Product teams

 

Scale Experimentation

  • Enhance the pace and quality of our A/B testing program

  • Structure identification, prioritization, design, and analysis of hypotheses

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

 

Deliver Strategic Projects

  • Lead brand redesigns and update commercial messaging

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

 

Protect Technical and Data Foundations

  • Partner with Engineering to ensure website performance, reliability, and security

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

 
 

What You Bring

  • 7–10 years of experience in Growth, Conversion, or Product, including people-management

  • Strong expertise in CRO and/or product management for a high-traffic website

  • Proven track record in delivering measurable conversion improvements

  • Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

  • Ability to collaborate with Engineering on performance, tracking, and security (coding not required)

  • Experience leading complex projects with multiple business and technical stakeholders

  • Strong leadership, communication, and prioritization skills

  • Hands-on experience using AI to enhance personal and team operations

  • Fluent English

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, self-sign-up models, or fast-growing e-commerce (plus), along with tracking and analytics knowledge

 
 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

 
 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, and learning

 
 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 
 

🔎 Recruitment Process

  1. Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  2. Interview with the Head of Growth (45 min, remote)

  3. Case study and presentation (1 hour, preferably in person)

  4. Interview with future direct reports (45 min, remote or in person)

  5. Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

jobs.title: Researcher in artificial intelligence for future healthcare solutions

jobs.description:
The position

An exciting position as Researcher is available in the Department of Computer Science within the TRUSTING project (https://trusting-project.eu/). The project is funded by the EU until 31st December 2028. The position is for one year initially. The research focuses on voice and language-based AI for psychosis relapse detection and will be conducted within a thriving research group that has recently received grants of excellence.

The goal is to contribute broadly to research on applications of AI in medicine, specifically to the development and validation of novel computational language models, algorithms, and tools for spoken language-based detection of schizophrenia relapse in 6 different languages.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. Ideally, you can start as soon as possible but must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer. 


The project

TRUSTING is a research project where an international interdisciplinary team are developing a machine learning based monitoring system that leverages spoken language processing (SLP) and natural language processing (NLP) of speech recorded at home to calculate relapse risk. The developed monitoring system will be used in a forthcoming randomized clinical trial where the goal is to validate the clinical outcomes of those affected by schizophrenia. Within this project, we are seeking a researcher with a strong computer science background to take an active role in developing novel machine learning based systems and tools on the path towards clinical use and implementation of AI for the treatment and care of patients. The candidate will contribute broadly to the project to enable the development of new algorithms for clinical AI based on patient data from heterogeneous sources notably language/speech-based sources. The activity will focus on the development of a prototype implementation of early warning- and other AI-based decision support systems to study the effectiveness and safety of a novel clinical decision tool that is based on SLP/NLP and utilizes large language models. The monitoring system has three main parts, namely a secure backend for recording sounds from mobile phones, a platform for data cleaning and machine learning model development, and a front-end app used by the patients. Therefore, an interest in working with state-of-the-art MLOps technology is an advantage. The project will focus on interaction with clinicians, with a goal of closing the gap between foundational research in machine learning and the clinical use of machine learning methods for the benefit of patients from a healthcare point of view. Hence, the work will be conducted in a highly interdisciplinary research environment and the candidates will collaborate with an international team consisting of clinicians, researchers in science and technology, health, industry partners, as well as personnel responsible for ICT, data security, privacy concerns and more. 

The UiT team will collaborate with the other research teams within the TRUSTING consortium. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting: 

  • Professor Brita Elvevåg: phone +47 91993063; email: brita.elvevag@uit.no 
  • Professor Lars Ailo Bongo: phone +47 92015508; email: lars.ailo.bongo@uit.no 
  • Associate Prof. Sandra Just, phone +49 1771966546; email: sandra.a.just@uit.no

General and administrative questions: 

  • Head of administration Martin Fjellvang Osima, phone +47 77 64 62 44; email: martin.osima@uit.no 

Qualification requirements

We are looking for applicants with a strong background, interest and expertise in computer science research with a focus on machine learning methods for the health domain, with strong coding skills and familiarity with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks. We would like an interested, active and highly motivated candidate who likes to explore new technologies, and who is an independent thinker but also a team player who will enjoy collaborating with other researchers and clinicians. 

The position requires 

  • a PhD degree in computer science or a related field (e.g., computational behavioral science) 
  • a publication record that document solid expertise in computer science
  • strong technical skills 
  • since the position is part of an interdisciplinary project, close interaction with other project participants will be required.
  • good communication skills in English are necessary and documented fluency in English is required.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working
      environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

 

An advantage:  

  • previous experience in natural language processing, sound-based machine learning, development and deployment of health technology software is considered a benefit. 
  • experience with explainable and interpretable AI methods applied within medical contexts, notably in clinical decision systems, would be an advantage. 
  • previous experience in systems development, data management, networking, and applied machine learning is also considered an advantage. 
  • it is also beneficial if the applicant has an interest and previous experience with inter-disciplinary or industry collaboration. 
  • candidates with research experience and relevant publications in conferences and journals will be considered with higher priority

For a permanent position as researcher it requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.

During this assessment process, emphasis will be placed on your potential for research as evidenced by a thesis and any other academic works. In addition, we may consider work experience or other activities of significance. The assessment will emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position.

 At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

UiT wishes to increase the proportion of females in academic positions. In cases where two or more applicants are found to be approximately equally qualified, female applicants will be given priority. 


Application

We will evaluate you based only on the documentation that you submit with the application. 

The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no and must contain:

  • Letter of application – this should include a short description of your background and its relevance to the advertised position, as well as a summary of your motivation for applying for this position. Please make it clear why you consider yourself qualified for this position and describe how you will strengthen the research activity in the research team (e.g., a vision statement).
  • CV with complete overview of education, supervised professional training, professional experience, and list of scientific publications.
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important and of relevance to this position. A brief description of the other listed works should also be included to demonstrate breadth of production. These descriptions shall be an attachment to the application. 
  • Description of your academic and software production and links to any open-source code.
  • Up to five academic works. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all academic degrees) 
  • Contact information to 2-3 references 
  • Documentation of English proficiency 

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. We only accept applications and documentation sent via Jobbnorge within the application deadline. The applicant will be assessed by an expert committee. 


We offer
  • Participation in an excellent and thriving research group that has recently received a prestigious ERC Synergy grant (https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/synergy-grants-2023-examples-projects) 
  • A productive, collaborative, and stimulating environment with researchers working on cutting-edge medical applications of artificial intelligence and speech technologies
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement 
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The possibility to balance professional development with a location to experience the liberating arctic nature: ski under the northern lights, hike and bike along the fjords 
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services. 
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details
    regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


General information

applicants.

  • Souveränes Auftreten, hohe Verbindlichkeit und die Fähigkeit, Standards ohne direkte Linienführung durchzusetzen
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Was wir Dir bieten

jobs.description:
Insinööritoimisto 2K Oy on rakennusalan asiantuntijatoimisto. Teemme kosteus- ja sisäilmateknisiä kuntotutkimuksia, kuntoarvioita, asbesti- ja haitta-ainekartoituksia, kosteuden- ja puhtaudenhallinnan koordinointia sekä rakennuttamista ja valvontaa. Hankkeet ovat sekä korjaus- että uudisrakentamista. Tilaajina on julkista sektoria, yrityksiä ja yksityisiä.

Toimipisteet ovat Joensuussa ja Kuopiossa. Teemme töitä tarpeen mukaan koko Suomen alueella, mutta pääpaino on Itä- ja Keski-Suomessa.

Haemme nyt uutta tekijää joukkoomme. Toimipiste voi olla kumpi tahansa, sen mukaan kumpi sinulle paremmin sopii.

**Työ**

Vastuu hankkeista arvioidaan osaamisen ja oman haluamisen mukaan. Työ on monipuolista ja tehtävänkuva voi koostua mm. seuraavista osa-alueista:

– kosteus- ja sisäilmatekniset kuntotutkimukset

– kuntoarviot

– asbesti- ja haitta-ainekartoitukset

– kosteuden- ja puhtaudenhallinnan koordinointi (KOPU)

– rakennuttajan tehtävät hankesuunnittelusta takuuaikaan

– rakennustöiden valvonta

Kohteina on julkisia rakennuksia, liike- ja toimitilakiinteistöjä sekä asuinkohteita. Iso osa työstä on raportointia, mihin sisältyvät tutkimusraportit, muistiot ja lausunnot.

**Toivomme sinulta**

Rakennustekniikan koulutusta, eli esim. RI, DI tai LVI-insinööri. Ajokortti ja auton käyttömahdollisuus tarvitaan.

Eduksi katsottavia pätevyyksiä ovat mm.:

– Rakennusterveysasiantuntija (RTA)

– Kosteudenhallintakoordinaattori

– Asbesti- ja haitta-aineasiantuntija

– Rakennuksen kuntoarvioija (PKA)

Näitä ei tarvitse olla valmiina. Jokaiselle tekijälle tehdään oman osaamisen kehittämisen ohjelma, missä kuunnellaan työntekijän omia toiveita esim. kouluttautumisesta.

**Mitä tarjoamme**

– Vakituinen kokoaikainen työ. Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan. Kerromme haarukan heti, kun pystymme arvioimaan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi.

– Suunnittelu- ja konsulttialan ylempien toimihenkilöiden työehtosopimus.

– Liukuva työaika. Osittainen etätyö on mahdollista ja siitä sovitaan henkilökohtaisesti. Kohdekäynnit, mittaukset ja näytteenotot tehdään paikan päällä, raportointia voi tehdä muualta.

– Monipuolinen työnkuva, johon on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa.

– Oman osaamisen kehittämisen ohjelma ja pätevöitymiskoulutukset yhtiön kustannuksella.

– Vahvuutena meillä on tiivis ja yhtenäinen työporukka. Vaikka ollaan pieni toimija, olemme mukana monessa maakunnan kärkihankkeessa.

Aloittaa voi milloin vain. Sovitaan ajankohta yhdessä.

**Hakeminen**

Lähetä hakemus ja CV osoitteeseen miikka.korhonen@insinooritoimisto2k.fi viimeistään 10.11.2026. Kerro hakemuksessa kumpi toimipiste kiinnostaa.

Hakemus on täysin vapaamuotoinen. Hakemuksessa voit halutessaan osoittaa oman raportointikykysi, koska iso osa työstä koostuu myös tästä.

Luemme hakemukset sitä mukaa kuin niitä tulee ja haastattelemme jo hakuaikana. Kannattaa siis lähettää hakemus heti kun se on valmis. Otamme yhteyttä jokaiseen hakijaan hakuajan päätyttyä.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Role description

As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress.
  • Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit.
  • Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1).
  • Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
  • IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment.
  • Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation.


Why you'll love working here

  • Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model
  • 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries
  • 30 days paid vacation per year
  • Salary bands for a fair corporate culture
  • Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV
  • Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path
  • Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth
  • Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis
  • Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party
  • Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year
  • Free parking right outside the door
  • Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass
  • Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

This is a vacancy for a hybrid role based at our coworking office in Paris (9th arrondissement, Opéra). We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender identity. You will be on-site in Paris 2 days per week for close collaboration and alignment; the remaining 3 days can be worked remotely.

We're a small, fast-moving French team backed by a German HQ. We need someone genuinely entrepreneurial who thrives on ownership rather than process, and who is both commercially sharp and technically curious – a strong communicator able to translate technical value into business outcomes.

Ready to make an impact?


You’ll get to take ownership of:

  • Full sales cycle: owning qualification through close on the French market. Typical deals run €33–40k ACV, with occasional enterprise opportunities above €150k.
  • Net-new business in a lean setup: driving new-logo pipeline generation in a 3-person French sales team, where sourcing outside your own network matters as much as closing.
  • Partner-led scaling: building and activating the strategic partner ecosystem (Hardis, Horus, Acelys, CGI, Devoteam) as a lever for sourcing and co-selling – partner-sourced deals count at a 1.2× accelerator toward quota.
  • Technically credible selling: running discovery and value conversations around data integration, EDI and IT/SI architecture, engaging both business and technical stakeholders (IT, architecture, CISO).
  • Cross-functional deal-shaping: working closely with Sales Engineering and Partnerships on complex, multi-stakeholder deals, RFPs and consortia.


We’d love to meet someone with:

  • Proven track record: consistently closing software/SaaS deals with a documented win history – not just pipeline.
  • New-logo generation: a track record of opening new business outside your own existing network, through mapping, partners, events or an installed base.
  • Technical affinity: strong understanding of data, integration and IT system architecture; able to hold your own in a technical discovery conversation.
  • Industry knowledge: domain exposure to logistics, supply chain, retail, manufacturing, automotive or pharma.
  • Scale-up selling: experience in a small / scale-up structure – high autonomy, hands-on, comfortable without heavy sales infrastructure.
  • Partner / channel selling: demonstrated success selling through or with strategic partners and system integrators (co-sell, ecosystem-led growth).
  • Languages: French native or bilingual; professional/fluent English (internal working language; HQ in Germany). 


You can look forward to:

  • No closed territories – this is a meritocracy: the more you win, the more scope you get.
  • Uncapped variable compensation, with quotas designed to be achievable.
  • An AI-equipped sales workflow, including deal coaching and prospecting support.
  • Direct access to the Head of France and to how decisions get made.
  • A coworking office in Paris (Opéra)
  • A personal learning and development budget
  • 30 vacation days per year
  • Up to 20 days of remote work per year from any EU country
  • Opportunity to work flexibly from home

If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply! 

Lobster is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where empathy and respect guide our interactions.

jobs.title: Cloud and Data Platform Lead
jobs.description: Cloud and Data Platform Lead. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt joukkoomme Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajaa vastaamaan Helenin yhteisten pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta ja niiden kehittämisestä. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Pilvi- ja data-alustan omistajana huolehdit siitä, että alustapalvelut muodostavat liiketoimintaa ja digitaalisten ratkaisujen kehittämistä tukevan, hallitun ja jatkuvasti kehittyvän kokonaisuuden. Tehtävä ei ole ensisijaisesti syvällinen tekninen asiantuntijarooli, vaan sinun tulee ymmärtää pilvi- ja dataratkaisujen toimintaympäristöä ja mahdollisuuksia. Pilvi- ja data-alustojen kehittämistä tehdään Helenissä virtuaalitiimin voimin. Roolissasi Vastaat Helenin pilvi- ja data-alustapalveluiden kokonaisuudesta, niiden elinkaaresta ja suunnitelmallisesta kehittämisestä.Määrität yhdessä liiketoiminnan, arkkitehtuurin ja teknisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa alustapalveluiden tavoitetilaa.Vastaat alustapalveluiden laadusta, jatkuvuudesta, kustannustehokkuudesta, tietoturvasta ja tarkoituksenmukaisesta elinkaarenhallinnasta.Rakennat selkeitä palvelumalleja ja huolehdit siitä, että alustojen tarjoamat kyvykkyydet ovat niitä hyödyntäville tiimeille helposti ymmärrettäviä ja käytettäviä.Ohjaat palveluiden tuottamiseen ja kehittämiseen osallistuvia kumppaneita ja varmistat, että tekeminen etenee yhteisten tavoitteiden mukaisesti.Varmistat aktiivisen yhteistyön liiketoiminnan, IT:n, data- ja analytiikkatoimintojen, arkkitehtuurin, kyberturvan sekä muiden keskeisten sidosryhmien välillä.Toivomme sinulta Vähintään noin viiden vuoden kokemusta laajojen IT-palveluiden, alustojen tai digitaalisten kyvykkyyksien omistamisesta ja kehittämisestä.Hyvää kokonaisymmärrystä pilvi- ja data-alustoista liiketoiminnan ja digitaalisten palveluiden mahdollistajana sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeiden ja teknologian yhdistämisestä.Kykyä tarkastella palveluita myös kustannusten, riskien, jatkuvuuden ja käyttäjäkokemuksen näkökulmista.Kokemusta toimittaja- ja kumppanijohtamisesta sekä kykyä ohjata useiden toimijoiden muodostamaa kokonaisuutta.Hyviä yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja vaikuttamistaitoja sekä kykyä rakentaa yhteistä ymmärrystä erilaisten sidosryhmien välillä. Emme etsi tehtävään yksittäisen pilviteknologian syväosaajaa, vaan suunnannäyttäjää, joka pystyy johtamaan alustapalveluita kokonaisuutena ja tekemään niiden kehittämisestä liiketoimintalähtöistä. Tarjoamme sinulle Pilvi- ja data-alustat ovat keskeisiä mahdollistajia Helenin digitaalisten palveluiden, datan hyödyntämisen, analytiikan ja uusien AI-ratkaisujen kehittämisessä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia yhteisiä kyvykkyyksiä Helen tarjoaa kehittäjille ja liiketoiminnoille sekä miten niitä kehitetään tulevaisuudessa. Saat vastuullesi kokonaisuuden, jossa onnistuminen ei tarkoita vain teknisesti toimivaa alustaa. Tavoitteena on rakentaa palveluita, jotka ovat käyttäjilleen selkeitä, helposti hyödynnettäviä, kustannustehokkaita ja turvallisia ja jotka kehittyvät Helenin liiketoiminnan mukana. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jarmo Ojamo / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 11.10.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Piha-, koti ja mökkitalkkari lisätulona - Helppo yrittäjämalli ilman kiinteitä kuluja
jobs.description:
Haluatko ansaita joustavasti ja tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Tarjoamme sinulle helpon yrittäjämallin, jossa voit toimia omassa kunnassasi tai lähialueellasi täysin oman elämäntilanteesi mukaan. Haemme yrittäjää seuraaville alueille: **Vaasa, Mustasaari, Pietarsaari, Laihia, Isokyrö, Kristiinankaupunki, Kokkola, Maalahti**

- Ei aloituskustannuksia

- Ei kiinteitä kuluja

- Ei sitoutumista

- Päätät itse työmäärän, hinnat ja aikataulut


Voit aloittaa kevyesti ja halutessasi laajentaa yrittäjyyttä - samalla auttaen perheitä ja senioreita arjessa.

**Sopii sinulle, jos haluat:**

- lisätuloja työn, eläkkeen tai opiskelun rinnalle juuri sen verran kuin sinulle sopii

- kasvattaa omaa asiakaskuntaa vähitellen ja päättää itse, paljonko teet töitä

- aloittaa yrittäjyyden kevyesti ja ilman isoja alkuinvestointeja

- täydentää nykyistä yritystoimintaa joustavalla lisäansaintamallilla

- tehdä merkityksellistä työtä auttamalla senioreita ja perheitä omalla alueella


**Mitä palveluita voit tarjota?**

Voit tarjota asiakkaille laajasti**talkkaripalveluita ja pihatöitä**, kuten esimerkiksi:

- pihanhoitoa ja lumitöitä

- kiinnitys- ja asennusapua

- huonekalujen kasausta ja pieniä korjaustöitä

- kiinteistöhuoltoon liittyviä tehtäviä

- terassin, pihakalusteiden ja rännien huoltoa

- pieniä pintaremontteja (maalaus, tapetointi yms.)


**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Valmiin ja helpon yrittäjämallin ilman kiinteitä kuluja

- Sähköiset työkalut: ajanvaraus, verkkokauppa, automatisoitu maksuliikenne

- Markkinoinnin tuki ja näkyvyys omalla alueellasi et jää yksin

jobs.title: Kiinteistönhoitajaksi Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietarille
jobs.description:
Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari etsii aktiivisen työotteen ja palveluasenteen omaavaa, ammattitaitoista kiinteistönhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Valittava henkilö tulee hoitamaan nimettyjen asuntokohteiden kiinteistönhoitajan tehtäviä. Tehtävän keskeinen sisältö alla:

A. Palkkaus: Kiinteistöhoitajan mediaanipalkka on noin 2.500 euroa/kk (keskiarvo on palkkatilaston mukaan noin 2.785 euroa/kk). Palkka tarkentuu valittavan henkilön koulutuksen ja kokemuksen perusteella. Jos henkilö osallistuu päivystystehtäviin, maksetaan päivystämisestä erilliskorvaus TESin mukaisesti (varallaolo ja ylityöt).

B. Noudatettava työehtosopimus: Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimus, jossa palkka määräytyy tehtävän vaativuusluokan (PR-ryhmät 1–10) mukaan. Kajaanin Pietarilla työntekijöillä on ns. pitkät lomat, eli lomaa kuluu 5 arkipäivää/viikko (muutoin yksityissektorilla 5+1 päivää/viikko).

C. Tehtävään vaadittava koulutus: Puhtaus- ja kiinteistöpalvelualan perustutkinto, jonka laajuus on 180 osaamispistettä ja kesto yleensä 2–3 vuotta. Tai vastaava koulutus.

D. Osaamisvaateet: LVI-järjestelmien (lämmitys, vesi, ilmanvaihto) kunnossapito ja seuranta; huolto- ja korjaustyöt = rakennustekniset korjaukset, koneiden käyttö ja pienehköt kunnossapitotyöt; ulkoalueiden hoito: piha-alueiden puhtaanapito, käsilumityöt; asiakaspalvelu = asukkaiden ja kiinteistön käyttäjien opastus (edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja); IT-taidot (toimisto-ohjelmien ja huoltokirjan (Tampuuri) käyttö.

E. Ajokortti ja valmius oman auton käyttöön: Tehtävä sisältää työajoja Kajaanin kaupungin alueelle sijaitsevien asuntokohteiden välillä päivisin. Työajoista maksetaan kilometrikorvaus verottajan hyväksymien ohjeiden mukaisesti.

Yhtiö tarjoaa työntekijöilleen laajat työterveyspalvelut, virkistyssetelin (E-passi) 200 euroa (vuonna 2026), kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia soveltuvin osin sekä asianmukaiset työvaatteet. Kiinteistönhoitajalla on selkeät kohdevastuut. Teet työtä mukavien työkavereiden kanssa ja sinulle on esimiehenä nimetty kiinteistöhoidon työnjohtaja. Kiinteistö Oy Kajaanin Pietari on savuton työpaikka ja 1.10.2026 alkaen noudatamme tupakkalain 2026 määräyksiä kaikissa asuntokohteissamme.

Tervetuloa mukaan tekemään tärkeätä työtä kohtuuhintaisen asumisen parissa Kajaanissa! Ryhdymme käymään läpi saapuneita hakemuksia heti! Kerro meille hakemuksessasi, miksi juuri sinä olet hakemamme henkilö ja mitä osaamista tarjoat meille.

På Kløverbakken Friplejehjem står vi foran en spændende udvikling. I starten af december åbner vi 6 nye plejeboliger, og vores hjem vokser fra 24 til 30 boliger. Derfor søger vi nu to sundhedsfaglige medarbejdere til faste stillinger i primær aftenvagt.

På Kløverbakken er beboerne altid i centrum. Vi arbejder ud fra den enkeltes ønsker, behov og livshistorie og lægger stor vægt på tryghed, respekt, værdighed og medbestemmelse.

Vi er en engageret medarbejdergruppe med høj faglighed og et stærkt sammenhold. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden, løfter i fællesskab og tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem tillid, respekt og anerkendelse.

Vi forestiller os, at du er social- og sundhedshjælper, social- og sundhedsassistent eller har en anden relevant sundhedsfaglig baggrund. Du sætter beboeren først, arbejder selvstændigt og trives samtidig i et tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer.

Hos os ved vi, at livskvalitet ofte skabes gennem de små ting i hverdagen. Den gode samtale, et smil, nærvær, aktiviteter og fællesskab betyder meget for vores beboere.

Vi tilbyder

·        Faste stillinger på 30-34 timer ugentligt i blandet vagt.

·        En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og engagerede kollegaer.

·        En hverdag præget af nærvær, humor og fællesskab.

·        Grundig oplæring og støtte fra erfarne kollegaer.

·        Mulighed for sundhedsforsikring gennem vores medarbejderordning.

·        Mulighed for at blive en del af Kløverbakkens spændende udvikling.

Hvem er vi? Kløverbakken er et friplejehjem, hvor hjemlighed, nærvær og relationer er omdrejningspunktet for hverdagen. Her er plads til grin, forskelligheder og nye idéer.

Ansøgningsfrist: 16. oktober,

Samtaler: Afholdes løbende, så hold dig ikke tilbage med at sende din ansøgning.

Ansættelse: Ønskes hurtigst muligt eller senest den 1. januar 2027.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Paris
jobs.description:
About H:

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

 

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

 

What you'd be doing

  • Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

  • Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

  • Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

  • Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

  • Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

  • Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

 

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

 

Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

 

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

  • Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

  • Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

  • Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.

  • Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

Stronger still if you have

  • Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.

  • Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.

  • Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.

  • Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.

  • Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.

 

You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

 

How we hire

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

 

Practicalities

Paris posting: Hybrid in Paris. That means 3 office days a week and a London trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a London posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.
